jobs.description:
Senior Computer Vision / ML Engineer


Full-time | Remote | Australia


About the Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions helps organizations assess and manage risk across identity verification, fraud prevention, financial crime compliance, credit risk, and customer data management.


About Our Team

IDVerse builds identity verification technology to fight fraud at global scale. Our systems must stay effective against evolving attacks including spoofing, deepfakes, injection attacks, and AI-generated fraud. We are a team of researchers and engineers who think from first principles, experiment rigorously, and invent new approaches as we continuously improve our systems.


What You'll Do

  • Research and invent: Investigate difficult problems in computer vision, biometrics, liveness, anti-spoofing, deepfake detection, generative AI, and adversarial attacks. Form hypotheses, run controlled experiments, and develop conclusions that can be trusted. Understand not only whether something works, but why it works, where it fails, and what to try next.
  • Red Team Mindset: Develop novel presentation, injection, deepfake, synthetic-media, and AI generated attacks against our systems. Build adversarial evaluations, expose weaknesses, understand their underlying causes, and develop robust defenses.
  • Build advanced CV/ML models: Design, train, evaluate, and optimize deep learning approaches across image, video, and multimodal data, applying techniques such as representation learning, transformers, generative models, 3D/geometric vision, where appropriate.
  • Own research through production: Take ideas from research and prototyping through benchmarking, optimization, deployment, and real-world evaluation.
  • Push the state of the art: Stay close to emerging computer vision and AI research, reproduce and challenge promising ideas, and identify opportunities to turn research advances into meaningful improvements to IDVerse products.

Required qualifications

  • Deep knowledge of computer vision, machine learning, and deep learning, backed by strong foundations in mathematics, statistics, optimization, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve open-ended research and engineering problems, rather than only implementing established solutions.
  • Strong experience with Python and PyTorch or equivalent modern deep-learning
  • frameworks.
  • Experience designing controlled experiments, analyzing model behavior and failure modes, and evaluating models against challenging datasets.
  • Ability to translate research concepts into efficient, reliable production systems.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals. Experience with C/C++, CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics,
  • Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.

Highly Desirable

  • PhD or equivalent research experience in computer vision, machine learning, AI, mathematics, or a related field.
  • Publications, patents, significant open-source contributions, competition results, or other evidence of original technical or research contributions.
  • Experience with biometrics, liveness / presentation attack detection, deepfakes, synthetic media, adversarial ML, or AI security.
  • Red-team or adversarial research experience, particularly discovering novel ways to attack, manipulate, or stress-test ML/CV systems.
  • Familiarity with biometric security and presentation-attack standards such as ISO/IEC 30107.

Location and collaboration

The team is remote and globally distributed. Candidates must have full working rights in Australia.

Full-time, 30 to 40 Hours/Week (US business hours)

Job Title: Medical Virtual Assistant (Credentialing)

We are hiring a Medical Virtual Assistant with hands-on credentialing experience. You will own provider enrollment and credentialing from start to finish: Medicare enrollment through PECOS, commercial payer applications, CAQH upkeep and re-credentialing deadlines. This role is for an experienced credentialing specialist. It is not an entry-level Medical VA role.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare, submit and track Medicare enrollments in PECOS: initial enrollments, revalidations, reassignments (CMS-855I, 855B, 855R), changes of information and practice location updates.
  • Manage NPPES records: apply for and update NPIs (Type 1 and Type 2), and keep taxonomy codes and addresses accurate.
  • Manage CMS Identity & Access (I&A) connections and surrogacy so providers and staff have the right PECOS access.
  • Complete commercial payer credentialing and contracting applications (e.g., UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, Cigna, BCBS, Humana) and state Medicaid enrollments.
  • Create, update and re-attest CAQH ProView profiles, and authorize payer access.
  • Follow up with payers by phone, email and portal until each application is approved, then record effective dates and provider IDs.
  • Track licenses, DEA, board certifications, malpractice insurance and other expiring documents, and start renewals and re-credentialing before deadlines.
  • Keep a credentialing tracker and provider files current, and send regular status reports to the client.
  • Handle hospital privileging and facility credentialing paperwork when needed.
  • Work with billing teams to resolve enrollment-related claim denials.
  • Protect provider and patient information and follow HIPAA rules at all times.

Requirements

  • Experience as a Credentialing Specialist or Provider Enrollment Specialist for US healthcare providers.
  • Hands-on PECOS experience: you have submitted Medicare enrollments and revalidations yourself.
  • Working knowledge of CAQH ProView, NPPES and CMS I&A.
  • Experience with commercial payer credentialing and at least one state Medicaid enrollment.
  • Strong attention to detail. One wrong date or missing document can delay an approval by weeks.
  • Organized, persistent follow-up habits, with comfort calling US payers.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Reliable home office setup: a stable internet connection, a backup connection and a quiet workspace.
  • Willing to work US business hours.

jobs.title: Program Delivery Lead, Benefit Enablement & Execution
jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community Humana’s Consumer Product Management team is seeking an experienced Program Deliver Lead, Benefit Enablement & Execution, to join working remote anywhere in the US.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana’s Consumer Product Management team is seeking an experienced Program Deliver Lead, Benefit Enablement & Execution, to join working remote anywhere in the US. In this role, you'll serve as a critical delivery connector across Insurance Product Management, Growth and Strategy, and the functional teams responsible for bringing Medicare Advantage products to market. You'll translate portfolio priorities into structured programs, clear milestones and coordinated workstreams that support accurate, timely and compliant execution. If you enjoy turning big-picture strategy into well-managed programs and helping teams deliver successfully, this role is for you.

As the Program Deliver Lead, Benefit Enablement & Execution, you'll lead complex bid initiatives and enterprise projects that span product strategy, benefit design, regulatory requirements, operational readiness, technology and process enablement. This includes coordinating initiatives such as benefit standardization, portfolio segmentation, plan naming, service area expansion and the evaluation of new product and benefit opportunities.

You'll also help strengthen how Product Management operates. You'll establish practical delivery disciplines, maintain governance and program documentation, improve processes and tools, and provide timely training as requirements change. Through research, analysis and cross-functional leadership, you'll help teams understand complex issues, evaluate implications and move toward clear, executable decisions.

This is a highly collaborative individual-contributor role for someone who can create clarity from ambiguity, lead complex work without relying on formal authority and keep multiple teams aligned through demanding Medicare Advantage and CMS delivery cycles.


Key Role Functions


Lead Medicare Advantage Bid Initiatives

  • Partner with Growth and Strategy, Insurance Product Management and functional teams to define objectives, scope, deliverables, decision points and measures of success for bid-related initiatives
  • Lead coordinated delivery of initiatives involving benefit standardization, portfolio segmentation, product guiding principles and other enterprise or portfolio priorities
  • Translate strategic direction into executable workplans, milestones, dependencies, ownership and decision requirements
  • Establish delivery approaches that create consistency across portfolios while allowing for appropriate product, market and regulatory differences
  • Facilitate cross-functional discussions needed to evaluate options, surface tradeoffs and move initiatives toward timely decisions
  • Monitor initiative progress and ensure key decisions, dependencies and risks are identified before they affect bid submissions or downstream implementation
  • Capture lessons learned and incorporate them into future bid and product cycles

Lead Feasibility Assessment and Decision Support

  • Lead structured evaluation of proposed products, benefits and portfolio opportunities across product, regulatory, operational, clinical, technology, system and financial considerations
  • Define the questions, information and functional expertise needed to assess whether an opportunity can be executed accurately and within required timelines
  • Bring together subject-matter experts to identify dependencies, constraints, assumptions, unresolved questions and downstream impacts
  • Distinguish between identified facts, assumptions and areas requiring additional validation so leaders can make informed decisions
  • Develop clear recommendations and decision-support materials that explain options, risks, tradeoffs and execution implications
  • Facilitate alignment among partners with different priorities while recognizing that final product, financial or strategic decisions remain with the appropriate accountable leaders
  • Maintain documentation of recommendations, decisions, rationale, owners and follow-up actions

Lead Enterprise Research and Product Impact Analysis

  • Lead research and analysis related to Stars, Clinical, Regulatory Compliance, the Complaints Tracking Module and other enterprise priorities affecting Medicare Advantage products
  • Identify relevant product, member, regulatory, operational and delivery implications
  • Synthesize complex information into concise findings, recommendations and decision points for Product Management leaders and partner teams
  • Evaluate how enterprise initiatives could affect benefit design, product processes, portfolio priorities, filings, systems or the member experience
  • Serve as the Product Management program delivery lead on assigned enterprise initiatives
  • Coordinate Product Management participation, consolidate feedback and ensure Product requirements and impacts are represented accurately
  • Communicate conclusions, open questions and recommended actions in a format appropriate for working teams and senior leaders

Own Program Governance and Delivery Discipline

  • Maintain program documentation for active portfolio opportunities, including objectives, scope, status, decisions, risks, dependencies, accountable owners and next steps
  • Gather requirements and prepare backlog opportunities so they are sufficiently defined for prioritization and future planning
  • Establish appropriate governance routines, status reporting, decision logs, risk tracking and escalation approaches for assigned initiatives
  • Create clear visibility into program health, milestone performance, unresolved decisions and delivery risks
  • Ensure commitments and decisions are documented and communicated to affected teams
  • Provide concise and actionable updates to Product Management leaders and cross-functional stakeholders

Improve Processes, Tools and Ways of Working

  • Partner with Process Improvement, Program Delivery and Product Management teams to create, maintain and improve process documentation, templates, workflows and delivery standards
  • Evaluate existing processes to identify unclear handoffs, unnecessary complexity, recurring defects, manual activity and opportunities for standardization
  • Lead implementation of practical improvements that strengthen accuracy, efficiency, transparency and user experience
  • Identify opportunities to use tools such as Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot, SharePoint and other approved technologies to reduce administrative work and improve access to information
  • Partner with technology and process owners to evaluate solutions and support responsible implementation
  • Establish appropriate controls, documentation and ownership so process improvements are sustainable
  • Measure the effectiveness of changes and adjust approaches based on user feedback and delivery results

Build Product Management Capability

  • Provide timely training, guidance and support to Product Managers as processes, tools, systems and requirements change
  • Translate complex process or regulatory changes into clear instructions, practical examples and job aids
  • Determine the appropriate training approach based on the complexity, timing and impact of the change
  • Facilitate working sessions that help teams understand new expectations and apply them consistently
  • Provide technical and process guidance to associates working across related programs and workstreams
  • Reinforce disciplined documentation, milestone management, issue escalation and adoption of standard processes
  • Gather feedback after implementation and refine training or documentation where additional clarity is needed


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional healthcare experience
  • 7+ years of relevant healthcare, health plan, product management, or related experience
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex projects, programs or processes across multiple functional areas
  • Experience establishing delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, governance and risk-management approaches
  • Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and drive alignment without formal authority
  • Experience researching complex business, regulatory or operational topics and translating findings into clear recommendations
  • Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, including the ability to distinguish facts, assumptions, risks and unresolved questions
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor information for working teams, functional partners and senior leaders
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver through ambiguity, changing requirements and compressed timelines
  • Advanced proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams and related digital collaboration tools

Preferred Qualifications

  • Medicare Advantage product management, program delivery, implementation or operational experience
  • Experience with the annual Medicare Advantage bid cycle, benefit design, service-area expansion or product implementation
  • Knowledge of CMS Medicare Advantage requirements, bid processes, PBP or HPMS
  • Experience evaluating product or benefit feasibility across regulatory, operational, system, clinical and financial considerations
  • Knowledge of Stars, the Complaints Tracking Module, member experience or regulatory compliance programs
  • Experience developing or managing enterprise milestone calendars, governance routines, decision logs or program dashboards
  • Experience with process documentation, workflow design, training development or change enablement
  • Experience using Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot or similar tools to improve processes, reporting or administrative efficiency
  • Process improvement experience or training, including Lean, Six Sigma or another structured improvement methodology
  • Experience presenting complex findings, recommendations and program risks to senior leaders

Additional Information

  • This role typically operates on Eastern Standard Time business hours.
  • The work follows the annual Medicare Advantage and CMS regulatory cycle. Certain periods of the year require additional flexibility, including extended hours and occasional weekend work, to meet critical regulatory and business deadlines

What Success Looks Like

  • Create clarity from complexity. Translate broad portfolio priorities, regulatory requirements and enterprise initiatives into clear objectives, deliverables, milestones and accountability
  • Connect strategy to execution. Help teams understand how bid initiatives, benefit decisions and process changes support portfolio goals, member value and operational readiness
  • Lead without relying on authority. Build alignment, maintain momentum and create shared accountability across teams with different responsibilities and priorities
  • Use sound judgment. Evaluate complex issues across product, regulatory, operational, clinical, technology and financial considerations and clearly explain the reasoning behind recommendations
  • Enable good decisions. Bring together the right information and expertise, clarify tradeoffs and help accountable leaders reach timely, executable decisions
  • Anticipate rather than react. Identify dependencies, risks and emerging requirements early enough for teams to respond effectively
  • Deliver reliably. Maintain accurate plans, governance records and milestone calendars and follow through until commitments are completed or appropriately escalated
  • Communicate for the audience. Provide the right level of information to working teams, functional partners and senior leaders at the right time
  • Keep work simple. Reduce unnecessary complexity, clarify ownership and use technology to make processes easier, faster and more reliable
  • Strengthen the operating model. Leave processes, tools, documentation and delivery standards stronger and more sustainable after each initiative
  • Learn and adapt. Use feedback, performance information and lessons learned to improve future planning and execution
  • Maintain a member-centered perspective. Consider how product and delivery decisions ultimately affect the clarity, quality and reliability of the member experience

How You'll Lead

How you achieve results matters as much as what you deliver. You'll model Humana's values by being Caring, Curious and Committed, and you'll put the Humana Way into practice by living the Golden Rule, keeping work simple, playing to win, keeping your eyes on the horizon and playing as one team.


You'll listen before assuming, seek diverse perspectives and remain open to learning. You'll turn complexity into clarity, focus teams on meaningful outcomes and identify opportunities to replace manual work with technology-enabled solutions. You'll establish clear endpoints, anticipate risks and adjust as conditions change. You'll explain recommendations and decisions transparently, build trust across organizational boundaries and create shared accountability for outcomes that help people achieve their best health.


Role Expectations

  • Operate with substantial independence within established Product Management, Medicare Advantage, regulatory and enterprise strategies
  • Serve as a subject-matter resource for complex program delivery, bid enablement, process activation and cross-functional execution
  • Determine the appropriate methods, delivery approach, priorities and timelines for assigned programs with minimal instruction
  • Exercise independent judgment on complex program and delivery issues while recognizing when decisions must be elevated to accountable leaders
  • Lead through influence and technical guidance rather than through direct people-management authority
  • Direct and coordinate the work of cross-functional contributors for assigned initiatives while remaining accountable for program integration and delivery
  • Manage multiple complex programs and workstreams with competing timelines, stakeholders and dependencies
  • Translate complex research, regulatory information and functional input into clear recommendations and execution plans
  • Influence functional strategies and operating practices by identifying recurring issues and recommending sustainable improvements
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of program needs while remaining accountable for near-term milestones and deliverables
  • Use advanced digital tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams and approved automation or reporting platforms, to manage work and communicate effectively
  • Adapt quickly as priorities, requirements and business conditions change

Key Partnerships & Reporting Relationship

You'll report to the Director, Insurance Product Management and work closely with Growth and Strategy, Insurance Product Management, Process Improvement and Program Delivery, Stars, Clinical, Compliance, Operations, Marketing, Technology and other enterprise and functional partners.

This role does not have direct people-management responsibility; however, you'll lead through cross-functional influence and program ownership.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$115,200 - $158,400 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 11-11-2026

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. jobs.description:
Chief Project Officer (CPO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Project Officer (CPO) is responsible for leading the organization's strategic project portfolio, enterprise-wide program management, and major transformation initiatives across its insurance and investment businesses.

The role ensures that strategic projects are properly planned, prioritized, funded, executed, and delivered in alignment with organizational goals. The CPO will oversee complex projects involving insurance operations, investment services, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, business expansion, mergers and acquisitions, and operational improvement.

Working closely with the CEO, Board, and senior management team, the CPO will establish effective project governance, optimize resources, manage delivery risks, and ensure measurable business outcomes from the organization's project investments.

2. Key Responsibilities

Strategic Project & Portfolio Management

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide project management and portfolio strategy.
  • Identify, assess, prioritize, and oversee strategic projects across insurance and investment business units.
  • Ensure project portfolios align with corporate strategy, growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Evaluate project feasibility, business cases, resource requirements, expected returns, and implementation risks.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and ensure projects deliver their intended strategic and financial benefits.

Insurance & Investment Project Delivery

  • Lead strategic initiatives involving life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, investment management, wealth management, and financial services.
  • Oversee projects involving new insurance product launches, policy administration systems, claims management, underwriting processes, and distribution expansion.
  • Manage investment-related initiatives involving portfolio management systems, investment operations, client reporting, and service delivery, where applicable.
  • Coordinate projects involving regulatory changes, business process modernization, and operational restructuring.
  • Support the implementation of new business models, financial products, and market expansion initiatives.

Project Governance & PMO Leadership

  • Establish and oversee the Project Management Office (PMO), including project standards, methodologies, policies, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, reporting structures, and escalation procedures.
  • Ensure consistent project management practices across business units and subsidiaries.
  • Monitor project scope, timelines, budgets, deliverables, and quality standards.
  • Present portfolio performance reports, major risks, and project recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Lead strategic technology implementation and digital transformation projects across the organization.
  • Oversee projects involving insurance technology (InsurTech), financial technology (FinTech), automation, AI, cloud platforms, CRM, and enterprise systems.
  • Coordinate implementation of digital insurance platforms, customer portals, mobile applications, and investment service platforms.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, and CDO teams to ensure technology projects meet business requirements.
  • Monitor technology implementation costs, timelines, system integration, and business adoption.

jobs.excerpt: Position Summary... Lead the analytics practice that changes how Walmart’s audit teams work.
jobs.description:
Position Summary...

Lead the analytics practice that changes how Walmart’s audit teams work. As Director, Data Analytics, you’ll turn data, automation and emerging technology into products that sharpen audit coverage, surface risk sooner and deliver results the business can measure. You’ll partner with audit teams across the organization to spark new ways of working, share what you learn and scale what works, all while leading a team in a space that never stands still. It’s an opportunity to pair deep analytical expertise with a product mindset and inspirational leadership at Walmart’s scale.



About the Team:

We’re an innovation-minded analytics team working alongside audit teams, business partners and technology functions. We treat analytics as products: we find the right problems, ship solutions people actually use, and measure the difference they make. We share what we build and what we learn, from reusable methods to new tools, so every audit team can move faster and see further. Our work supports trusted, accessible and responsible use of data, and we adapt quickly as risks, technology and priorities change.

What you'll do...

  • Drive innovation in how audit works: Spot opportunities to apply analytics, automation and emerging technology to audit planning, risk assessment, testing and reporting. Question long-standing assumptions, prototype quickly and turn the best ideas into solutions with clear success criteria, metrics and measurable return on investment.
  • Engage audit teams and drive change: Partner with audit teams across the organization to understand how they work, co-design solutions that fit and lead the adoption that makes change stick. Influence stakeholders at every level and turn early wins into new ways of working.
  • Share knowledge and raise the bar: Introduce new tools, methods and ideas to audit teams, and share what you learn through playbooks, demos, communities of practice and mentoring. Make good analytical practice easy for others to adopt, adapt and build on.
  • Run analytics like a product: Own a roadmap that connects audit priorities to analytics and technology delivery. Define the customer, the problem and the outcome; prioritize ruthlessly; assess costs and resource needs; deliver in increments; and report on adoption, quality, time saved and risk insight gained.
  • Drive technology governance and enterprise compliance: Ensure analytics products, AI solutions, and automation initiatives align with Walmart’s enterprise technology, security, and governance requirements. Lead and coordinate internal review and approval processes, including Solution Security Plan (SSP), Enterprise Privacy Risk Assessment (EPRA) and other applicable reviews for deployed solutions. Partner with Information Security, Privacy, Compliance, and Technology teams to identify risks, address requirements, and obtain necessary approvals before deployment, ensuring solutions are secure, compliant, and scalable.
  • Find the signal and tell the story: Identify fit-for-purpose data across existing systems and distributed data stores, perform data quality checks, and use exploratory analysis, statistical methods and models to test hypotheses and surface insight. Select the right visualization tools and build clear, compelling stories for analysts, audit leaders and executives, partnering with user experience designers and engineers when front-end applications are needed.
  • Advance data strategy, quality and responsible use: Apply and influence data strategy across audit and business domains. Define data quality rules, metrics and service-level strategies, recommend improvements to data governance policies and practices, manage user access as needed, and support requirements for data privacy, security, storage, retention and documentation.
  • Lead with energy and develop people: Recruit, develop and mentor talent, identify capability gaps and support succession planning and continuous learning. Build a curious, motivated team that is comfortable with change, and foster an environment grounded in Walmart’s standards of integrity and ethics, including the Open Door Policy.


What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven experience leading innovation and turning ideas into delivered solutions, with a strong product mindset and a record of defining success measures and reporting measurable impact and business value.
  • A strong analytical background, with experience in exploratory data analysis and statistical methods such as hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, correlation and statistical modeling, using tools or languages such as SQL, Python, SAS, Oracle, Apache Mahout or Excel.
  • Experience identifying and working with data across business systems and distributed data stores, including SQL and NoSQL technologies, with an understanding of data modeling, integration, storage and warehousing.
  • Experience creating visualizations and communicating insights using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Python or R, including libraries such as Matplotlib, Plotly or ggplot, and telling a compelling story to audiences from analysts to executives.
  • An inspirational, energizing leader with experience leading initiatives and developing others, including engaging peers and stakeholders across teams, driving change and sharing knowledge through mentoring, coaching and teaching.
  • Comfort in a dynamic, changing space: the ability to adapt as priorities, technology and risks shift, challenge assumptions constructively and keep teams focused on delivery.
  • Knowledge of data management and governance, including data quality frameworks, profiling and cleansing tools, access practices, and privacy, security and retention requirements, plus knowledge of business practices and metrics across functions such as product, finance, technology, business systems or audit.

jobs.description:
Job Description: Director of PMO – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Director of Project Management Office (PMO) is responsible for establishing, leading, and managing the organization's Project Management Office to ensure effective governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of strategic and operational projects.

The role oversees the project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate operations, technology, digital transformation, and business development functions. The Director of PMO ensures projects are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, and organizational objectives while maintaining effective risk management, resource allocation, and stakeholder engagement.

The successful candidate will drive project management excellence, strengthen governance frameworks, improve delivery performance, and ensure that project outcomes contribute to business growth, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and customer experience.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. PMO Strategy, Leadership & Governance

  • Establish, develop, and lead the organization's Project Management Office.
  • Define PMO strategy, policies, methodologies, standards, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement standardized project management processes, tools, templates, and reporting structures.
  • Establish project approval processes, stage gates, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Promote project management best practices across departments and business units.
  • Ensure alignment between project execution and corporate strategy.

B. Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the organization's project portfolio, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Evaluate project proposals, business cases, feasibility studies, and investment requirements.
  • Prioritize projects based on business value, financial impact, risk, and resource availability.
  • Monitor project dependencies, interdepartmental coordination, and portfolio-level risks.
  • Provide recommendations to senior management regarding project prioritization and resource allocation.
  • Track portfolio performance and ensure delivery of expected business benefits.

C. Project Planning & Execution

  • Oversee the planning, scheduling, budgeting, and execution of strategic projects.
  • Ensure project managers develop comprehensive project plans, milestones, deliverables, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress and identify delays, delivery challenges, and performance gaps.
  • Drive corrective actions and escalation processes to maintain project delivery commitments.
  • Ensure projects are completed within approved scope, budget, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure smooth project implementation.

D. Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee projects related to insurance operations, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution.
  • Coordinate initiatives involving investment operations, financial products, portfolio reporting, and client services, where applicable.
  • Support the implementation of regulatory, compliance, risk management, and internal control initiatives.
  • Monitor projects involving new product development, market expansion, operational improvements, and business integration.
  • Ensure project deliverables reflect the operational and regulatory requirements of the insurance and financial services industry.

E. Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Oversee technology-enabled transformation projects, including core insurance systems, CRM, ERP, digital platforms, and automation initiatives.
  • Coordinate with IT, technology, operations, and business teams to ensure successful implementation.
  • Monitor technology project budgets, vendor performance, implementation timelines, and delivery quality.
  • Support digitalization, process automation, data management, and operational efficiency initiatives.
  • Ensure technology projects deliver measurable business outcomes.

F. Financial & Resource Management

  • Develop and monitor project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure reports.
  • Ensure effective allocation and utilization of project resources.
  • Monitor project costs, financial variances, and budget performance.
  • Evaluate project financial risks and recommend cost-control measures.
  • Coordinate with Finance and Procurement teams on project funding, contracts, and vendor payments.
  • Assess project return on investment (ROI) and benefits realization.

G. Risk Management, Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Establish project risk management frameworks and escalation mechanisms.
  • Identify, assess, and monitor project risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery constraints.
  • Ensure projects comply with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and governance standards.
  • Monitor project quality and ensure deliverables meet agreed specifications.
  • Maintain project documentation, audit trails, and management records.
  • Coordinate with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit teams.

H. Performance Monitoring & Executive Reporting

  • Develop project dashboards, management reports, and portfolio performance metrics.
  • Present project status, risks, budget performance, and delivery updates to executive leadership.
  • Provide timely visibility into project delays, resource constraints, and critical dependencies.
  • Monitor project KPIs and ensure accountability among project managers.
  • Lead project review meetings and portfolio governance sessions.
  • Recommend improvements to project delivery processes and organizational performance.

I. Stakeholder & Team Management

  • Lead and develop project managers, PMO analysts, and project support professionals.
  • Build strong working relationships with senior executives, department heads, project sponsors, and external vendors.
  • Facilitate communication and coordination across business units and functional teams.
  • Develop project management capabilities through training, coaching, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Finance, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Project Management, Finance, or a relevant discipline is preferred.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum 10–15 years of progressive professional experience in project management, program management, or portfolio management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership or Director-level position.
  • Proven experience establishing, managing, or transforming a Project Management Office.
  • Experience overseeing complex, enterprise-wide projects and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Background in insurance, banking, financial services, investment management, or related industries is highly desirable.
  • Experience managing large project portfolios, budgets, resources, and multiple project teams.
  • Exposure to digital transformation, technology implementation, business process improvement, and organizational change initiatives.

Preferred Certifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Managing Successful Programmes (MSP).

  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

- Lean Six Sigma certification.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic project and portfolio management.
  • PMO governance and operational leadership.
  • Financial planning and budget management.

- Risk assessment and problem-solving.

  • Executive communication and stakeholder management.
  • Change management and business transformation.
  • Leadership, team development, and decision-making.
  • Project management systems and reporting tools.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance and delivery success rate.

- Project cost and schedule variance.

  • Achievement of project milestones and strategic objectives.

- Project benefits realization and ROI.

  • Effectiveness of project governance and reporting.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and resolution.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and project sponsor feedback.
  • PMO process maturity and continuous improvement.
  • Compliance with project management standards and regulatory requirements.

Sightline ADAPT is evolving from project-based analytical capabilities into a reusable platform that integrates customer, building, energy-usage, program, distributed-energy-resource, and grid data to support utility planning and implementation decisions. The team needs a senior software leader with demonstrated experience designing, launching, and scaling enterprise-grade analytical products.

This is not solely a hands-on development position. The successful candidate will establish the engineering practices, delivery model, technical direction, and governance needed to turn working prototypes and analytical methods into maintainable applications and shared platform capabilities.

Why you will love working here:

  • Quality of life: Flexible workplace arrangements, work-life balance
  • Investment of the community: Donation matching, volunteer opportunities
  • Investment in you: Tuition reimbursement, access to professional development resources, 401k matching, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • And many, many more (Ask your recruiter for more details!)

What you will be doing:

People and Team Leadership

  • Directly manage an initial team of three engineers, with responsibility for performance management, coaching, career development, hiring, onboarding, and future team growth.
  • Set clear expectations, roles, decision rights, and development responsibilities while fostering a collaborative, accountable, and inclusive engineering culture.
  • Plan team capacity, assign work, remove delivery barriers, and help engineers grow their technical and leadership capabilities.
  • Provide engineering leadership across collaborating product, data science, analytics, consulting, infrastructure, security, and client-delivery teams.

Product Strategy and Delivery

  • Partner with product, consulting, and client leaders to understand user needs and translate utility use cases into prioritized product capabilities, technical requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, release plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Co-own the product and engineering roadmaps, balancing client commitments, reusable platform capabilities, technical investments, delivery risk, and available team capacity.
  • Lead delivery from discovery through production deployment and ongoing support, developing realistic estimates, staffing plans, implementation approaches, and dependency plans.
  • Identify risks and tradeoffs early, present clear recommendations, and use client feedback, adoption, operational results, and engineering insights to guide priorities and continuous improvement.

Engineering Leadership and Technical Direction

  • Establish standards for coding, testing, documentation, version control, code review, release management, and software quality.
  • Guide major technical decisions and the evolution of applications, APIs, shared services, data products, and client-specific configurations.
  • Ensure that prototypes have a defined path to production rather than becoming unsupported standalone applications.
  • Oversee the cloud, data, deployment, monitoring, and production practices needed to operate Sightline ADAPT securely and reliably in partnership with internal technology and governance teams.

AI-First Engineering and Product Innovation

  • Set an AI-first approach for software development, testing, documentation, operations, analytics, and product capabilities.
  • Help the team adopt AI-assisted engineering workflows while maintaining quality, privacy, security, intellectual-property protection, auditability, and human accountability.
  • Guide the delivery of AI-enabled features, including appropriate evaluation, monitoring, data governance, and human oversight.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies pragmatically and identify where they can improve the product or engineering effectiveness.

Client and Commercial Support

  • Serve as a senior technical authority in selected client meetings, demonstrations, discovery sessions, and solution reviews.
  • Translate client integration, security, data, and operational requirements into practical implementation approaches.
  • Support proposals, scopes of work, estimates, technical narratives, and delivery plans.
  • Communicate capabilities, limitations, dependencies, roadmap decisions, and delivery tradeoffs clearly to technical, client, and executive audiences.
  • Build client confidence in ICF’s ability to deliver and support enterprise-scale analytical applications.

What we need you to have (minimum qualifications):

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field.
  • 5+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including experience leading complex engineering or product initiatives.
  • Prior people management experience directly leading software or data engineers, including coaching, performance management, hiring, and team development.
  • Experience leading data-intensive, client-facing software products from development through production, scaling, and support in cloud environments.
  • Strong experience with Python, SQL, APIs, data engineering, front-end technologies, cloud services, CI/CD, and modern software development practices.
  • Experience setting technical roadmaps, leading cross-functional engineering initiatives, and applying AI-assisted development tools or AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Strong ability to communicate technical decisions, priorities, risks, and tradeoffs to technical, client, and executive audiences.

What we would like you to have:

  • Master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, information systems, or a related field.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, Databricks, Apache Spark, Docker.
  • Experience developing data-intensive SaaS platforms, analytical products, or configurable multi-client applications.
  • Experience with React, Next.js, FastAPI, .NET, or comparable modern full-stack application frameworks.
  • Experience operationalizing machine-learning, optimization, digital-twin, generative-AI, or agentic capabilities, including evaluation and monitoring.
  • Experience navigating enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, software-governance, and production-readiness reviews.
  • Experience with utility-sector data and analytical use cases, including customer, AMI, programs, DERs, forecasting, or distribution planning.
  • Familiarity with utility planning and operational technologies such as OpenDSS, CYME, Synergi, DERMS, or ADMS.
  • Experience supporting technical sales, proposals, demonstrations, client discovery, and modernization of analytical codebases or prototypes.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.

Description

Channel Factory provides intelligent marketing solutions for the next generation of contextual safety, suitability, and performance for brands and agencies. Our platform helps marketers implement, automate, and scale their marketing programs across the world’s largest video library, YouTube, and emerging growth channels. We sit at the intersection of marketing and suitability and have a mission of enabling the world’s top brands to consciously connect with the right audience in the right context, maximizing suitability and contextual performance.

Channel Factory embodies a strong start-up culture that values diversity, collaboration, and results. Our bias towards execution balances critical thinking, analysis, and pragmatic problem solving. We expect a lot from one another and value our thoughtful and intellectually curious company culture. This position is a full-time role based in the United States. Remote work status is subject to change at any time.

We're looking for a detail-oriented and technically strong Media Buyer - Google Platforms to join our team. This role oversees the activation and management of YouTube advertising campaigns. You'll serve as a go-to resource for internal teams on buying best practices, platform policy, and campaign troubleshooting, all while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and responsiveness. The ideal candidate brings hands-on Google Ads experience, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to operate effectively within a fast-paced team.

Requirements

    • 3+ years of campaign management experience in Google Ads, including Google Ads Editor.
    • Experience with CM360 tracking and troubleshooting.
    • YouTube experience. Specifically, a working knowledge of different YouTube ad formats and their KPIs, including product mixes, Demand Gen, Shorts, and in-stream vs. in-feed ad types.
    • Proficiency in Google Sheets, including pivot tables, formula troubleshooting, and third-party integrations.
    • Comfortable working in a remote-ready tech stack including Slack, Salesforce, and Google Workspace.
    • Willingness to leverage AI tools that improve buying workflows, including setup, QA, bidding, and pacing.
    • Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities while consistently delivering accurate work and timely communication.
    • Ability to travel for team meetings, training, etc.
  • Bonus points for:
    • Working with conversion-based campaign goals, including online vs. offline conversion measurement, attribution and conversion reporting types, and conversion goal setup in Google Ads.
    • DV360 experience.
    • Bulk editing campaigns via spreadsheet imports and/or SDFs across Google platforms.
    • Familiarity with media deal types and their impact on pacing, including Guaranteed Outcomes, PMPs, and Auction vs. Reservation models.
    • Google Ads certifications.

Benefits

  • Work with a leading startup in a high-demand industry, and you would be working with like-minded experts aiming to transform video ad operations
  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive medical benefits (Medical, Vision, Dental, and Life Insurance)
  • Cell phone and Wifi Reimbursement
  • Work-life flexibility – we value your contributions above all

About Channel Factory

Founded in 2010, Channel Factory is an award-winning marketing technology company that helps top global brands and agencies maximize YouTube advertising. Recognized as a technology innovator by Cynopsis and one of the fastest-growing companies by Inc., Channel Factory has served over three hundred of the Fortune 500 in delivering scalable, brand-safe, contextually aligned YouTube advertising software and services. By tapping into the deepest proprietary data pool on the market, the company enables highly customized, contextually aware, and dynamically optimized campaigns and provides industry-leading performance for a portfolio of clients across all industries.

Channel Factory is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Channel Factory makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time. The company also has employee resource groups focusing on encouraging inclusion and diversity in the workplace, including an LGBTQ+ committee.

About Rimini Street, Inc.

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software.

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.

We are actively seeking an experienced Sr. Director, AI Powered Service Delivery & Automation to join our team. This remote Brazil –based role reports to the GVP of Global Service Delivery Operations.

Position Summary

The Sr. Director, AI-Powered Service Delivery & Automation is responsible for defining and executing Rimini Street's AI-powered managed services strategy and leading the transformation of AMS from a labor-based support model to an intelligence-driven, automation-enabled service delivery organization. Leveraging AI, agentic workflows, AIOps, observability, and autonomous operations, this leader will design and scale capabilities that improve engineer productivity, automate service delivery activities, accelerate issue resolution, reduce cost-to-serve, and enhance client outcomes across ERP and cloud platforms.

This role is accountable for establishing and achieving measurable automation, AI adoption, productivity, service quality, and service economics targets across the AMS portfolio while driving the adoption of next-generation delivery capabilities globally.

The successful candidate will bring a proven track record of deploying AI and automation at scale within managed services environments and delivering measurable business outcomes through operational innovation. Success will be measured by increases in automated and AI-assisted resolution rates, reductions in manual engineering effort and cost-to-serve, improvements in service margins, and the establishment of scalable autonomous support capabilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Lead AI-Powered Service Delivery Transformation

  • Define and execute the roadmap for AI-driven managed services across ERP and cloud platforms.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities to automate diagnosis, triage, resolution, knowledge creation, documentation, and client communications.
  • Establish business cases, governance, and measurable objectives for automated resolution, ticket deflection, engineer productivity, service quality, and margin improvement.
  • Partner across Delivery, Engineering, AI, Product, and Operations teams to drive innovation and adoption.

Build AI-Enabled and Autonomous Service Operations

  • Design and deploy AI-powered assistants, copilots, agentic workflows, and enterprise knowledge capabilities that improve support effectiveness and consistency.
  • Leverage AI, large language models, automation platforms, and knowledge assets to automate support activities and enable autonomous service operations.
  • Establish standards for AI governance, operational controls, performance measurement, and responsible AI adoption.
  • Drive the transition from reactive support to predictive, proactive, and autonomous service delivery.
  • Design and deploy capabilities that increase automated and autonomous case resolution while reducing manual engineering effort.

Drive AIOps and Intelligent Operations

  • Implement AIOps, observability, monitoring, and analytics capabilities to predict, prevent, and remediate service disruptions.
  • Advance self-healing operations through automated remediation, anomaly detection, event correlation, and predictive service management.
  • Partner with ServiceNow and infrastructure teams to mature ITOM, CMDB, service mapping, discovery, and operational intelligence capabilities.

Lead AMS Delivery Transformation

  • Build and lead a global AMS Automation & AI Center of Excellence responsible for AI engineering, intelligent automation, service innovation, and next-generation delivery capabilities.
  • Transform AMS delivery from manual, case-driven execution to AI-assisted and automation-enabled workflows.
  • Standardize scalable delivery patterns, automation frameworks, and operational practices across ERP and cloud service offerings.
  • Drive adoption across global delivery teams and leadership to ensure solutions are embedded into day-to-day operations.
  • Partner with Product, Sales, and Delivery leadership to develop AI-enabled service offerings that enhance client value and differentiate Rimini Street in the marketplace.

Improve Productivity and Service Efficiency

  • Deliver capabilities that reduce administrative overhead and improve resolution speed, throughput, first-contact resolution, and engineer productivity.
  • Implement AI-assisted troubleshooting, intelligent routing, knowledge recommendations, automated documentation, and reusable resolution patterns.
  • Establish measurable improvements in cost-to-serve, service quality, and operational performance.

Deliver Scalable Platform Automation

  • Design and implement reusable automation solutions across ERP and cloud platforms, including diagnostics, monitoring, integration management, configuration validation, and release impact assessment.
  • Modernize service management processes by embedding automation, improving workflow efficiency, and enhancing operational visibility and reporting.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, practical, and aligned to client, delivery, and business outcomes.

Desired Experience

  • 12+ years leading enterprise managed services, service operations, or technology transformation organizations.
  • Proven track record implementing AI-driven automation, autonomous operations, or digital labor solutions that materially improve service delivery performance and economics.
  • Experience deploying AI platforms, agentic workflows, enterprise knowledge systems, copilots, and intelligent automation capabilities at scale.
  • Strong technical leadership with credibility across architecture, engineering, AI, operations, and executive stakeholder communities.
  • Experience with AIOps, observability, ITOM, predictive operations, automation frameworks, and enterprise service management platforms.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise application support models across ERP and cloud platforms, including SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft technologies.
  • Demonstrated success building new capabilities and leading global transformation programs that improve automation rates, productivity, service quality, customer outcomes, and margin performance.
  • Experience delivering measurable reductions in support effort, ticket volume, or cost-to-serve through AI, automation, or autonomous operations.
  • Experience leading geographically distributed engineering, platform, or automation teams within a global managed services organization.

Desired Skills

  • Deep expertise in AI-driven service delivery, agentic automation, autonomous operations, AIOps, observability, and intelligent automation platforms.
  • Strong technical foundation in APIs, integrations, orchestration, automation frameworks, and enterprise service management technologies.
  • Ability to translate technology innovation into measurable business outcomes, including productivity gains, cost reduction, service quality improvements, and margin expansion.
  • Technology-first leadership style with the ability to lead at strategic, architectural, and operational levels.
  • Proven success driving organizational transformation, stakeholder alignment, and adoption across global teams.
  • Exceptional analytical, communication, and influencing skills with experience building and scaling high-performing teams and Centers of Excellence.

Education

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) required; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.

Location

Remote – Brazil

Why Rimini Street?

We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you.

Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs:

  • Company
    • We dream big and innovate boldly.
  • Colleagues
    • We work with extraordinary people who create a culture of mutual respect and collaboration.
  • Clients
    • We relentlessly pursue solutions that help clients achieve their goals. Our unmatched client care is rooted in our passion for exceptional service.
  • Community
    • We believe in leaving the world a better place than we found it. With the Rimini Street Foundation, we’ve made positive impacts in six continents for over 425 charities.

Accelerating Company Growth

  • Nasdaq-listed under ticker symbol RMNI since October 2017
  • Over 6,700+ signed contracts to date, including Fortune 500 and Global 100 companies
  • Over 2,000 team members in 23 countries
  • US and international recognition for industry leadership and philanthropic efforts. See all of our awards and recognitions here:

jobs.excerpt: Group Head of Project Management Office (PMO) – Insurance & Investments 1.
jobs.description:
Group Head of Project Management Office (PMO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Group Head of PMO is responsible for leading and overseeing the Group's project management function across all subsidiaries, business units, and geographical markets within the Insurance & Investments sector.

The role establishes group-wide project governance, portfolio management standards, delivery frameworks, and performance monitoring systems to ensure that strategic projects and transformation initiatives are executed effectively. The position provides centralized oversight of project priorities, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and expected business outcomes.

Working closely with the Group CEO, executive leadership, subsidiary CEOs, and business heads, the Group Head of PMO ensures that all major projects support the organization's strategic growth, operational efficiency, digital transformation, and long-term business objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

Group PMO Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and implement the Group's overall Project Management Office strategy, structure, and operating framework.
  • Establish standardized project management methodologies, governance policies, procedures, and reporting requirements across all subsidiaries.
  • Define project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Ensure project portfolios are aligned with the Group's strategic objectives and business priorities.
  • Establish consistent project management standards and controls across geographical markets and business units.

Strategic Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the consolidated project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate, and operational business units.
  • Evaluate, prioritize, and monitor strategic projects based on business value, financial impact, risk exposure, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress, milestones, dependencies, budgets, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Identify underperforming projects and recommend corrective actions or changes in resource allocation.
  • Provide executive leadership with a consolidated view of project portfolio performance.

Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee group-wide projects involving insurance product development, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution expansion.
  • Monitor investment-related projects involving portfolio reporting, investment operations, wealth management platforms, and client servicing, where applicable.
  • Coordinate strategic initiatives involving regulatory compliance, business process modernization, and operational efficiency.
  • Support the implementation of new financial products, business models, and market expansion initiatives.
  • Ensure projects meet relevant insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Provide governance and oversight for group-wide technology modernization and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Coordinate implementation of enterprise systems, CRM platforms, automation solutions, AI applications, and digital financial services.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, CDO, and business leadership to ensure successful technology project delivery.
  • Monitor system integration, implementation risks, technology budgets, and business adoption.
  • Ensure digital initiatives deliver measurable improvements in customer experience and operational performance.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Oversee consolidated project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure tracking across the Group.
  • Monitor project cost performance and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Coordinate resource allocation across subsidiaries, departments, and strategic initiatives.
  • Evaluate project business cases, cost-benefit analysis, ROI, and expected benefits.
  • Ensure effective utilization of internal teams, external consultants, contractors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Establish group-level project risk management and escalation frameworks.
  • Monitor operational, financial, regulatory, technology, and implementation risks across project portfolios.
  • Coordinate with group risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit functions.
  • Ensure projects comply with internal policies, governance standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Establish contingency and mitigation plans for critical projects and strategic programs.

Performance Reporting & Benefits Realization

  • Develop group-wide project dashboards, performance reports, and executive presentations.
  • Monitor project delivery against approved scope, budgets, timelines, milestones, and quality standards.
  • Track financial benefits, operational improvements, and ROI from strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare regular portfolio performance reports for the Group CEO, Board, and executive committees.
  • Recommend strategic interventions to improve project execution and delivery performance.

Stakeholder & Subsidiary Management

  • Work closely with subsidiary CEOs, managing directors, business unit heads, project sponsors, and program directors.
  • Facilitate group-level project steering committees and portfolio review meetings.
  • Coordinate project planning and delivery across subsidiaries and corporate functions.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, technology vendors, contractors, and implementation partners.
  • Ensure consistent communication, accountability, and reporting across all Group entities.

Leadership & PMO Capability Development

  • Lead and develop the Group PMO team, including PMO directors, project managers, project analysts, and project controls specialists.
  • Establish PMO structures, responsibilities, and reporting relationships across subsidiaries.
  • Develop project management training, mentoring, and capability-building initiatives.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, collaboration, and delivery excellence.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management maturity across the organization.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Business Strategy, Finance, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership position overseeing multiple business units, subsidiaries, or large project portfolios.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or diversified financial services.
  • Proven track record of establishing or leading enterprise-level or group-level PMO functions.
  • Strong knowledge of project portfolio governance, financial management, resource planning, risk management, and strategic execution.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-country or multi-entity projects and transformation programs.
  • Knowledge of PMI, PRINCE2, Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project management methodologies.
  • Strong leadership, executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Preferred Certifications:

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of group-wide projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance against Group strategic objectives.
  • Project cost variance and schedule variance.
  • Group PMO governance and reporting compliance.
  • Successful delivery of strategic insurance and investment initiatives.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and escalation effectiveness.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency across subsidiaries.
  • Benefits realization and ROI of major strategic projects.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of consolidated project reporting.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction across Group entities.
  • Improvement in project management maturity across subsidiaries.
  • Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.

jobs.title: Scrum Master (LATAM)
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support multiple Agile implementation teams—referred to as pods—within the Arc technology platform.
locationRestrictions: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support multiple Agile implementation teams—referred to as pods—within the Arc technology platform.
The ideal candidate will facilitate Scrum practices, improve sprint execution, remove delivery impediments, and promote transparency across the pods. This role requires close collaboration with Product Owners, technical leads, Technical Project Managers, and delivery leadership.
The candidate will help teams improve their Agile maturity, maintain consistent delivery practices, and strengthen collaboration across teams. We are looking for a self-driven, proactive, and responsive professional who can take initiative, anticipate delivery challenges, communicate effectively, and work collaboratively with distributed teams.

Please submit your resume in English.

Key Responsibilities

Agile Delivery and Facilitation

  • Serve as Scrum Master for multiple software development pods, guiding teams in Scrum practices and continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring meetings are productive, timeboxed, and outcome-focused.
  • Lead the refinement and planning process while ensuring Product Owners retain responsibility for backlog maintenance and prioritization, and teams retain ownership of their commitments.
  • Track sprint health and delivery metrics, including velocity, commitment versus completion, and carryover, working with technical leads to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date JIRA boards to ensure transparency of work, capacity, progress, and delivery status.
  • Proactively identify potential delivery challenges, dependencies, and risks, taking initiative to address them before they impact sprint commitments.

Risk and Stakeholder Management

  • Identify, track, communicate, and help resolve pod-level risks, dependencies, and blockers.
  • Escalate cross-pod risks and delivery concerns to the appropriate Technical Project Manager.
  • Provide timely daily, weekly, and sprint-level delivery updates to Product Owners, Technical Project Managers, technology leadership, and stakeholders.
  • Assist Product Owners with the triage of User Acceptance Testing (UAT) issues, production support tickets, and software defects.
  • Facilitate effective communication between stakeholders and development teams.
  • Ensure follow-ups and action items are tracked through completion, maintaining responsiveness and accountability.
  • Prepare and present sprint status, delivery metrics, risks, and key updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Team Coaching and Continuous Improvement

  • Coach teams toward self-management, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration to focus on outcome results.
  • Foster a collaborative environment that encourages transparency, open communication, and continuous learning.
  • Help resolve team conflicts and remove barriers to effective collaboration.
  • Identify process improvements through retrospectives and track agreed actions through completion.
  • Support the adoption of approved AI tools that improve Agile practices, in accordance with organizational data policies.
  • Collaborate with other Scrum Masters to share best practices and promote consistency across teams.
  • Take initiative, and encourage others, to identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness, communication, and delivery processes without waiting for direction.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of experience as a Scrum Master supporting software development teams.
  • Experience supporting multiple Agile teams simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve sprint execution and help teams deliver consistently.
  • Strong working knowledge of Scrum principles, roles, events, and artifacts.
  • Experience coaching teams toward self-management and continuous improvement.
  • Experience tracking, analyzing, and communicating sprint metrics.
  • Proficiency with JIRA, Smartsheet, or similar work management tools.
  • Familiarity with web technologies and the software development lifecycle.
  • Strong facilitation skills and the ability to keep meetings focused and productive.
  • Ability to resolve conflicts, build consensus, and influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to identify and remove blockers and determine when escalation is necessary.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to take ownership of responsibilities and independently drive activities to completion.
  • Responsive and dependable, with a strong sense of urgency in addressing team needs, stakeholder requests, and delivery issues.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong presentation skills, including the ability to prepare and present sprint updates, delivery metrics, risks, and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Scrum certification, such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), PSM – AI Essentials, or SAFe Scrum Master.
  • Familiarity with Kanban and scaled Agile practices, such as Scrum of Scrums.
  • Familiarity with Evidence-Based Management (EBM) or other outcome-focused approaches to measuring team performance.
  • Experience using AI tools to support Agile teams, including meeting summaries, backlog refinement, or sprint analytics.
  • Experience supporting UAT and production support triage.
  • Experience working with mission-driven or nonprofit organizations.
Please list any relevant certifications in your application.

Education

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related field, or equivalent professional experience

All our positions are Remote and are available as Full Time Employment or B2B Contracts
