AlphaGov delivers public-sector consulting for cities, counties, school systems, special districts, utilities, and related agencies. Our work spans classification and compensation, organizational and operational studies, research and program evaluation, economic and workforce analysis, surveys and community research, and applied data and infrastructure research.

We engage experienced practitioners as project-based collaborators. Engagements are remote-first with occasional client travel. When you authorize it, AlphaGov may name you as an expert collaborator or key personnel on proposals that match your expertise. We build ready teams for live pursuits - not speculative staffing banks.

AlphaGov is building a bench of executive recruiters who lead superintendent searches for K-12 school districts and boards of education. You would guide boards through a transparent, community-informed search, from the leadership profile through final selection and transition.

We confirm scope, schedule, and fee with you before any engagement begins.

What you'll do

  • Facilitate board planning sessions and set the search process and timeline
  • Run stakeholder engagement, including staff, parent, student, and community surveys, forums, and focus groups, to build the leadership profile
  • Write the position profile and advertise through education networks and associations
  • Source, recruit, and screen candidates, including diverse and nontraditional candidates
  • Conduct reference, background, credential, and media checks
  • Prepare interview questions and support board interviews, finalist visits, and deliberations
  • Support contract negotiation and transition planning for the new superintendent
  • Contribute qualifications and past-performance narrative to AlphaGov proposals when you authorize naming

Apply to be considered.

Requirements

Required

  • At least 5 years leading or co-leading superintendent or senior K-12 executive searches for school boards
  • A record of completed placements, with references from board chairs or district leaders
  • Experience running community engagement for a public search
  • Comfortable as a 1099 project-based consultant

Nice to have

  • Former superintendent, assistant superintendent, or school board member
  • Experience with open-meetings and public-records rules that apply to board searches
  • College president or city manager search experience

jobs.description:
Role: OCI Network Specialist
Job Ref Id: JD-1348
Competence level: 10 + Years
Start date: 2026-11-15
End date: 2027-05-31
Extension option: Yes
Scope: 100 %
Location: India
Remote work: Yes
Language: English
Application deadline: 2026-11-30
Number of consultants: 1
Security clearance: No

About the assignment

We are looking for an experienced OCI Network Specialist with strong expertise in designing, implementing and managing complex network infrastructures on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. The role is focused on architecting scalable, secure hybrid cloud network solutions, optimizing performance and providing advanced operational support. You will collaborate with cloud architects, security and DevOps teams to deliver end-to-end networking solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Network Architecture & Design:
  • Architect, design, and implement scalable and highly available network topologies on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  • Design Virtual Cloud Networks (VCN), subnets, gateways, route tables, security lists, and Network Security Groups (NSGs) as per best practices.
  • Plan and implement Hub-and-Spoke and other advanced network architectures for multi-region and multi-tenancy OCI environments.
  • Design and manage OCI Load Balancers (Public and Private) including Layer 4 and Layer 7 configurations.
  • Architect solutions for OCI Network Firewall, WAF, and DDoS protection.
  • Hybrid Connectivity:
  • Design and implement hybrid connectivity solutions using OCI FastConnect and Site-to-Site VPN (IPSec).
  • Manage BGP routing configurations for FastConnect and peering setups.
  • Configure and maintain OCI Dynamic Routing Gateways (DRG) for inter-VCN and on-premises connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize WAN, MPLS, and SD-WAN integrations with OCI.
  • Network Security & Governance:
  • Implement and manage network security policies using Security Lists, NSGs, OCI Network Firewall, and WAF.
  • Conduct network security assessments and ensure compliance with industry standards (CIS, NIST, ISO 27001).
  • Monitor network traffic and analyze flow logs using OCI VCN Flow Logs and third-party SIEM tools.
  • Implement Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) principles on OCI.
  • Performance & Optimization:
  • Monitor network performance metrics and resolve bottlenecks proactively.
  • Optimize OCI network configurations for latency, throughput, and cost.
  • Conduct capacity planning for network bandwidth and connectivity.
  • Leverage OCI Network Path Analyzer and Network Visualizer for diagnostics.
  • Operations & Support:
  • Provide Level 3 support for network incidents and escalations.
  • Develop and maintain network runbooks, SOPs, and architecture documentation.
  • Participate in change management and release planning for network changes.
  • Coordinate with Oracle support for network-related service requests and critical issue resolution.
  • Perform regular network audits and vulnerability assessments.
  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:
  • Work closely with cloud architects, security engineers, and application teams to ensure network requirements are met.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior network engineers.
  • Engage with clients and stakeholders to gather requirements and present network design proposals.
  • Participate in pre-sales activities and proof-of-concept (PoC) engagements.

Requirements

Mandatory

  • We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced OCI Network Specialist with 7 to 11 years of expertise in designing, implementing, and managing complex network infrastructures on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  • Strong expertise in OCI VCN, Subnets, Route Tables, Internet Gateway, NAT Gateway, Service Gateway, Local Peering Gateway (LPG), Remote Peering Connection (RPC).
  • Hands-on experience with OCI Dynamic Routing Gateway (DRG v2).
  • Proficiency in OCI FastConnect, IPSec VPN, and BGP routing.
  • Experience with OCI Load Balancer, Network Load Balancer, and Application Load Balancer.
  • Expertise in OCI Network Firewall and Web Application Firewall (WAF).
  • Knowledge of OCI DNS (Private and Public), Traffic Management, and Email Delivery services.
  • Experience with OCI Network Path Analyzer, Network Visualizer, and VCN Flow Logs.
  • Deep understanding of TCP/IP, OSI model, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, RIP), switching, and VLAN configurations.
  • Strong knowledge of network security concepts including firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, NAT, ACLs, and Zero Trust.
  • Experience with IPv4 and IPv6 addressing, subnetting, and CIDR.
  • Proficiency in network monitoring tools (Wireshark, tcpdump, Nagios, Zabbix, or equivalent).
  • Experience in hybrid cloud network design and implementation.
  • Knowledge of SD-WAN, MPLS, and WAN optimization technologies.
  • Familiarity with multi-cloud networking (AWS, Azure, OCI interconnects).
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform for OCI network provisioning.
  • Familiarity with OCI CLI and OCI SDKs for network automation.
  • Basic scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for network tasks.
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2024/25 Certified Networking Professional (OCI Networking Professional)
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2024/25 Foundations Associate (OCI Foundations Associate)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with CDN services and OCI Edge Services.
  • Exposure to Kubernetes networking (OKE - Oracle Kubernetes Engine).
  • Knowledge of OCI Observability and Monitoring services.
  • Understanding of OCI Identity and Access Management (IAM) as it relates to network resource governance.
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes and service management frameworks.
  • Experience with network compliance frameworks (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2).
  • Basic knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows server networking.
  • Exposure to cloud cost optimization strategies for networking workloads.
  • Understanding of microservices architecture and API Gateway networking.
  • Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) network configurations.
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2024/25 Architect Associate / OCI Architect Professional
  • Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) - Enterprise or Security
  • Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) - Enterprise Infrastructure or Security (Highly Desirable)
  • AWS Certified Advanced Networking - Specialty (Good to Have)
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate (Good to Have)
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) (Good to Have)
  • CompTIA Network+ or CompTIA Security+

﻿Records, Contract and Document Administration

About the company

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.

Project Highlights

  • Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
  • Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
  • Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All contributors are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

What this project involves

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
  • Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

En tant que Manager Smart Building, directement rattaché au directeur de la Squad Smart & Digital Building, vous aurez sous votre responsabilité des consultants. Vous intervenez comme directeur de projet auprès de directions immobilières, directions des environnements de travail et directions des systèmes d’information dans la définition de leur stratégie Smart Building et dans la transformation numérique de leurs bâtiments, depuis l’expression des besoins jusqu’au déploiement des solutions et à leur adoption par les utilisateurs.

1.Développement commercial et management

  • Analyser les enjeux usagers, immobiliers, énergétiques, environnementaux, numériques et organisationnels des clients.

    • expérience collaborateur ;
    • services aux occupants ;
    • sûreté et sécurité ;
    • pilotage multisite du patrimoine.
  • Élaborer des feuilles de route, scénarios de transformation et modèles de gouvernance.

  • Recueillir les besoins des directions métiers, immobilières, techniques et informatiques.

    • équipements et systèmes du bâtiment ;
    • GTB/GTC ;
    • IoT et capteurs ;
    • réseaux et connectivité ;
    • Building Operating System ou plateforme de services ;
    • BIM et BIM GEM ;
    • systèmes d’information immobiliers ;
    • outils Workplace ;
    • plateformes de données ;
    • applications destinées aux occupants.

Nous offrons des opportunités passionnantes grâce à des projets innovants dans la data et le digital, le cloud, l'IA, la cybersécurité, l'IoT, ou encore le digital workspace et le big data.

Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous !

Travailler chez Orange Consulting, c'est rejoindre un cabinet à taille humaine qui offre à ses collaborateurs des perspectives d'évolution claires et accessibles à travers des parcours de formations spécialement conçus par et pour nos consultants.

La direction Orange Consulting accompagne les entreprises et les institutions en France et à l'international sur leurs problématiques de transformation digitale et leurs enjeux métiers.

Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.

To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.

Role Overview

As a Staff Engineer (Backend) in the Platform team, you set the technical direction for the shared foundations that every Ajaib product runs on: identity, core services, API standards, observability and developer tooling. You treat the platform as a product whose customers are other engineers, solve the hardest cross-team problems, and make engineers across the company stronger. You stay hands-on where it matters most.

  • Define the technical direction and architecture for platform systems that span many teams.
  • Lead the design of scalable, secure, multi-tenant services and review critical designs from other teams.
  • Set API and contract standards across the company: versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation and documentation.
  • Lead the architecture of identity and access: authentication, authorization, token handling and service-to-service security.
  • Design for reliability: service level objectives, rate limiting, isolation between consumers, graceful degradation and disaster recovery.
  • Build the golden paths that make good engineering the easy path: service templates, shared libraries, CI/CD standards and observability defaults.
  • Architect and execute seamless, zero-downtime structural migrations across many teams, with clear timelines, tooling and support. E.g., identity providers, gateway layers across the organization using the Strangler pattern and backward-compatible proxying.
  • Identify technical risks early, weigh trade-offs and drive decisions that fit business and regulatory needs.
  • Lead investigations and root cause analysis for complex production incidents, and drive lasting improvements.
  • Partner with Engineering Managers, Product, Security, Infrastructure and Architecture on cross-team initiatives.
  • Mentor Senior Engineers and help grow technical leadership across the company.
  • Stay hands-on with implementation for critical components and complex problems.
  • Design and implement highly resilient, low-latency API Gateways that standardize authentication, routing, and rate-limiting across hundreds of microservices.
  • Drive the evolution of our identity platform (OAuth2, OIDC, Zero Trust) to support seamless, highly secure access patterns for millions of retail investors and internal services.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: 8+ years of professional software engineering, with a proven record of designing and running platform or shared services used by many teams, and leading technical work across teams.
  • Languages: Highly proficient in Java, Go or another modern backend language.
  • System Design & Architecture: Strong expertise in microservices, event-driven architectures, multi-tenant design, reliability engineering, observability and performance optimization.
  • Security: Deep knowledge of authentication and authorization (Keycloak / Ory Stack, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, mTLS) and secure system design.
  • Data & Messaging: Deep practical experience with Kafka, Redis, and relational and NoSQL databases, including query tuning and data consistency.
  • Infrastructure: Experience designing and operating applications on cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) and Kubernetes.
  • Mindset: Product mindset toward internal users. Strong communication, with the ability to influence technical decisions without direct authority. Experience in fintech or another regulated environment is a plus.
  • Proven experience migrating live, high-traffic consumer systems to modern identity providers (like Keycloak or Ory) without user disruption is a strong plus

Our work spans classification and compensation, organizational and operational studies, research and program evaluation, economic and workforce analysis, surveys and community research, and applied data and infrastructure research.

We engage experienced practitioners as project-based collaborators. Engagements are remote-first with occasional client travel. When you authorize it, AlphaGov may name you as an expert collaborator or key personnel on proposals that match your expertise. We build ready teams for live pursuits - not speculative staffing banks.

AlphaGov is building a bench of energy engineers who measure and verify savings from building efficiency, weatherization, heat pump, and electrification programs for state energy offices, public service departments, and utilities. You would lead the engineering side of program evaluations, from site measurement to savings calculations.

We confirm scope, schedule, and fee with you before any engagement begins.

What you'll do

  • Develop measurement and verification plans using IPMVP options and program technical reference manuals (TRMs)
  • Conduct or oversee site visits, metering, and data logging for heating, cooling, and building envelope measures
  • Build building energy models and engineering savings calculations for thermal and electric measures
  • Review TRM algorithms, deemed savings values, and baseline assumptions
  • Calibrate engineering estimates against billing and interval data with evaluation analysts
  • Write the engineering sections of evaluation reports and answer regulator questions
  • Contribute qualifications and past-performance narrative to AlphaGov proposals when you authorize naming

Apply to be considered.

Requirements

Required

  • At least 5 years in energy engineering, energy auditing, or M&V for efficiency or electrification programs
  • Building energy modeling experience (for example eQUEST, EnergyPlus, BEopt, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of IPMVP and technical reference manuals
  • Comfortable as a 1099 project-based consultant

Nice to have

  • PE, CMVP, or CEM credential
  • Residential retrofit, weatherization, or heat pump program experience
  • Vermont, New York, or New England program experience

Job Title: Sr. Director, Digital Pricing Strategy

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

GE HealthCare is undergoing a significant customer and business model transformation, driven by the acquisition of Intelerad and the expansion of innovative software, SaaS, and cloud-based solutions. These solutions are designed to address some of the most complex challenges in the healthcare industry.

This role is a critical leadership position supporting GE HealthCare’s transition to a SaaS-first software business model. As part of a global, cross-functional environment, the Sr. Director of Digital Pricing Strategy will define and operationalize pricing and monetization strategies across newly integrated organizations. This role will play a key part in aligning commercial, finance, and product teams while driving profitable growth and long-term scalability.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Pricing Design

Develop and lead global pricing strategies for SaaS and cloud-based offerings, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives across AI, digital, and enterprise software solutions. Drive pricing transformation as core products evolve to a cloud-first model.

SaaS Monetization & Business Model Transformation

Lead the design and implementation of modern SaaS monetization strategies, including ARR growth, net revenue retention (NRR), attach rate expansion, price realization, and margin optimization. Drive the evolution from legacy licensing models to scalable subscription, consumption, and platform-based pricing models.

Post-Acquisition Integration & Change Leadership

Partner across legacy organizations to harmonize pricing strategies, tools, and operating models following the Intelerad acquisition. Lead change management efforts to ensure adoption of new pricing frameworks and foster alignment across commercial, finance, and product teams.

Market Awareness & Competitive Intelligence

Analyze market trends, competitor pricing, and customer insights to inform pricing strategy. Stay current on industry trends, regulatory environments, and best practices in SaaS and healthcare software markets.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate closely with Sales, Finance, Product Management, Legal, Professional Services, and Marketing to ensure pricing strategies align with go-to-market objectives. Engage early in product development cycles to incorporate customer value and market needs into pricing models.

Product Pricing & Enterprise Structuring

Partner with product teams to design scalable pricing structures across multi-product portfolios. Ensure pricing models support enterprise agreements spanning multiple offerings, customer segments, and healthcare modalities.

Platform & Advanced Pricing Models

Develop and implement modern SaaS pricing approaches, including platform pricing, subscription models, consumption-based pricing, and outcome-based pricing for strategic enterprise customers. Utilize advanced pricing analytics, segmentation, and elasticity modeling.

Deal Structuring & Commercial Execution

Provide hands-on leadership in structuring complex enterprise deals, including pricing, packaging, and multi-solution offerings. Translate pricing strategy into actionable sales tools, guidance, and scalable frameworks to support field execution.

Performance Forecasting & Financial Partnership

Collaborate with Finance to develop revenue forecasts, financial models, and KPI tracking frameworks for SaaS products. Ensure pricing decisions directly support margin expansion and long-term profitability.

Executive Communication & Reporting

Develop clear, data-driven pricing dashboards and insights for executive leadership. Present pricing strategies, forecasts, and performance metrics to senior stakeholders.

Change Management & Enablement

Lead organizational adoption of pricing strategies through change management, training, and communication. Equip Sales and Commercial teams with tools and frameworks to support complex SaaS transactions.

Annual Pricing Strategy

Design scalable pricing adjustments and annual increase strategies based on market data, customer value, and financial performance, ensuring measurable impact to revenue growth.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • Minimum of 10+ years of experience in pricing strategy, monetization, or related fields, preferably within SaaS or cloud-based environments
  • Proven experience building or transforming pricing models in SaaS or subscription-based businesses
  • Demonstrated success driving monetization strategy, including ARR, NRR, and margin optimization
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate market data into actionable pricing strategies
  • Extensive experience with financial modeling, forecasting, and pricing analytics tools
  • Experience structuring complex, enterprise-level deals and commercial agreements
  • Excellent cross-functional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare or healthcare technology
  • Experience in late-stage SaaS, cloud-first, or private equity-backed organizations
  • Exposure to post-M&A integration and business transformation initiatives
  • Experience working with large enterprise customers and global commercial teams

Leadership Expectations & Work Environment

  • Operates as a strategic leader without direct reports initially, with potential to build a team over time
  • Thrives in a highly cross-functional, global environment
  • Demonstrates strong influence across Product, Finance, and Commercial leadership
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building structure in a transforming organization
  • Balances strategic thinking with hands-on execution, particularly in deal structuring and pricing implementation

Why This Role

This is a unique opportunity to help define pricing and monetization strategy for GE HealthCare’s evolution into a SaaS-first enterprise. The role sits at the center of a major post-acquisition transformation and will directly impact revenue growth, margin expansion, and how digital solutions are delivered to healthcare systems globally.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $140,000.00-$210,000.00 Annual. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented and organized Remote Bookkeeper to support the finance team with day-to-day accounting and administrative tasks for a property management portfolio.

In this role, you’ll work primarily with AppFolio and QuickBooks Online to manage accounts payable and receivable, process payments, reconcile bank and trust accounts, maintain accurate financial records, and support month-end reporting.

You’ll handle a high volume of daily transactions and work closely with the Director of Finance, while communicating with vendors, tenants, property owners, and internal team members. The ideal candidate has bookkeeping experience, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage financial tasks independently in a remote environment.

What You’ll Own

Accounts Payable

  • Review, code, and enter vendor invoices in AppFolio.
  • Create in-house maintenance invoices and bill tenants for tenant-caused repairs.
  • Follow up on past-due invoices and respond to vendor payment inquiries.
  • Maintain accurate vendor records, including W-9s, insurance documents, and payment methods.
  • Prepare 1099 forms.

Accounts Receivable & Tenant Ledgers

  • Post and reconcile rent receipts, deposits, and chargebacks.
  • Prepare move-out security deposit dispositions within required timelines.
  • Track overdue tenant payments and follow established collection policies.
  • Maintain accurate collections logs and tenant account records.

Bank & Trust Reconciliations

  • Reconcile operating, rent trust, and security deposit trust accounts daily.
  • Investigate and resolve outstanding items, non-sufficient funds (NSF) transactions, and unmatched payments.
  • Ensure financial transactions are accurately recorded and reconciled.

Month-End & Administrative Support

  • Generate month-end reports and gather supporting documentation for the Director of Finance.
  • Process owner distributions once approved.
  • Monitor the finance inbox and respond to or route inquiries from owners, tenants, and staff.
  • Keep owner, tenant, and vendor contact and payment information up to date.

Company Bookkeeping – QuickBooks Online

  • Record receipts and expenses for company entities.
  • Review and accurately categorize financial transactions.
  • Prepare weekly billable-hours reports.
  • Support commission and payroll data preparation.

Required Experience & Skills

  • At least 2 years of experience in bookkeeping or accounting support, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations.
  • Proficiency in AppFolio and QuickBooks Online.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Strong data entry skills with excellent accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage a high volume of daily transactions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for working with owners, tenants, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and follow established procedures.
  • High level of professionalism and commitment to confidentiality when handling financial information.

Nice to Have

  • Associate's or bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Experience in property management accounting.
  • Familiarity with tenant ledgers, owner distributions, and security deposit accounting.
  • Experience maintaining vendor records and preparing 1099 forms.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You are highly organized and comfortable handling detailed, repetitive financial tasks.
  • You can manage multiple accounting priorities while maintaining accuracy.
  • You take ownership of daily responsibilities and follow established processes.
  • You proactively investigate discrepancies and follow up on unresolved transactions.
  • You communicate professionally and handle sensitive financial information with discretion.
  • You are reliable, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote setting.

What Success Looks Like

  • Vendor invoices, payments, and tenant transactions are processed accurately and on time.
  • Bank and trust accounts are reconciled daily, with discrepancies investigated promptly.
  • Tenant ledgers, vendor records, and financial information remain accurate and up to date.
  • Month-end reports and supporting documents are prepared reliably.
  • Owner distributions and other financial tasks are completed according to approval procedures.
  • The Director of Finance receives consistent and dependable bookkeeping support.

  • Initial Screening
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

Job Summary:

We are seeking a motivated Automation Engineer with 3-5 years of experience to replace repetitive manual tasks across our Steady State teams (Windows, Linux, Storage, and Backup) with reliable, reusable automation. The role focuses on automating patch management across the environment using tools such as Ansible, GitLab CI/CD, HashiCorp Vault, Terraform, and the JFrog Artifactory suite (Xray, Catalog, and Curation).


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Windows, Linux, storage, and backup teams to understand patch management cycles and identify opportunities to automate patching activities.
  • Analyze ServiceNow patching tickets to identify recurring manual tasks and quantify their frequency and effort across Windows, Linux, storage, and backup environments.
  • Prioritize patch management automation opportunities based on patch severity, operational risk, and impact across Windows, Linux, storage, and backup systems.
  • Develop reusable Ansible playbooks and roles to automate patch management procedures
  • Use Terraform to maintain repeatable infrastructure configurations that support patch management workflows.
  • Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines to package, test, and safely deploy patch management automation to production.
  • Manage secrets, credentials, and certificates required by automated patching workflows through HashiCorp Vault.
  • Use JFrog Artifactory, including Xray, Catalog, and Curation, to manage and secure artifacts used by patch management pipelines.
  • Validate automated patching workflows against existing manual procedures before replacing manual patching activities.
  • Track and report on patch automation coverage and reductions in manual patching effort and related ticket volume across Windows, Linux, storage, and backup systems.
  • Document patch management procedures, Ansible playbooks, and pipeline configurations for Windows, Linux, storage, and backup environments.
  • Regularly review patching ticket trends to identify recurring manual work and keep the patch automation backlog current.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience and 3-5 years of experience in infrastructure operations, patch management, or related engineering roles, including patching automation.
  • Hands-on experience using Ansible, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, and HashiCorp Vault to support production patch management workflows.
  • Experience analyzing patching tickets and incident data in ServiceNow or a similar ITSM tool to identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve patch delivery.
  • Ability to gather patching requirements from operations teams and translate patch cycles and procedures into repeatable workflows.
  • Working knowledge of Windows and Linux systems administration, storage, and backup operations, with experience supporting patch management across these environments.
  • Strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar languages to automate patching tasks and validation.

As a Layer1 software engineer, you will get to work on software that manages the physical layer, where packets meet the outside world. Stable and reliable physical connectivity is critical for any network and that is your challenge. You will get to write control software that brings to life everything from the ubiquitous 1GBASE-T connectors to 400G long reach optics that provide fiber connectivity across continents. Your software will need to work across a wide variety of forwarding engines, connectors and interface chips called gearboxes, which allow our hardware platforms to support diverse physical connectivity options within a product family. You will build instrumentation and telemetry tools that track physical link health parameters reported by the Layer1 components and enable operators to monitor and troubleshoot their links effectively. You will also work closely with our Optics teams to define standards for new media and bring them to market.

Arista Software Engineering roles demand a strong and broad software engineering background. While the primary focus area for this role is Layer1 software, the role will cover all aspects of software development spanning the addition of new features, debugging problems and fine tuning code for scalability and performance. You will own your projects from definition to deployment and customer interactions, and you will be responsible for the quality of everything you deliver.

Arista Software Engineering prides itself on a supportive and growth oriented culture. Over time, as your interests change, coupled with evolving business needs you will have the opportunity to switch from Layer1 to other areas, if you like.

What You’ll Do

  • Interface with customers, product management and hardware engineers to come up with innovative new Layer1 features.
  • Architect, design and manage the development of these features.
  • Develop and maintain features using C, C++ and Python, review and contribute to functional and design specifications. Build automated tests and test infrastructure to test the features.
  • Work with hardware and manufacturing teams to bring new Layer1 components like Phys and Transceivers to market.
  • Collaborate with hardware engineers to design optimal software control interfaces for managing Layer1 components.
  • Provide technical leadership across features, projects and tools.
  • Work with Customer Support Engineers and customers to analyze, mitigate and fix problems in customer networks.
  • Work with the System Test Engineers to analyze problems found in their tests and provide fixes for those problems.
  • Mentor new and junior engineers to bring them up to speed in Arista's software development environment.
  • BS Computer Science/Electrical Engineering/Computer Engineering + 8 years experience, or equivalent work experience
  • Expert knowledge of C or C++ and Python.
  • Knowledge of UNIX or Linux
  • Knowledge of digital communication technologies like modulation and signal encoding schemes is a plus.
  • Understanding of IP networking and/or distributed systems is a plus
  • Experience working with low level hardware components is a plus
  • Applied understanding of software engineering principles
  • Strong problem solving and software troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to design a solution and implement features independently.
  • Ability to work in small teams.

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges.

At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. jobs.description:
Pelago is the leading specialty substance use care provider, built on the belief that effective treatment means matching care intensity to what each member actually needs rather than defaulting to the most expensive intervention. Our programs guide members through every stage of the substance use spectrum, from unhealthy habits to active use disorders, delivering personalized treatment for tobacco, alcohol, opioid, cannabis, and stimulant use based on individual health, habits, genetics, and goals.

With Sona, our voice-first AI Mental Health Specialist, Pelago now applies that same clinically-driven model to mental health, pairing deep clinical expertise with technology to expand access without compromising care quality. We believe technology should make clinical care more precise and more human, not replace the judgment behind it.

Pelago has scaled to helping hundreds of employers and health plans and has already helped more than 750,000 members better manage their substance use. If you're passionate about AI and making an impact on the health of others, join us and make it happen!

Overview of the Role


We are seeking a Care Specialist to join our digital clinic and help members achieve healthier, more fulfilling lives. As the first point of contact, the Care Specialist plays a vital role in creating a welcoming onboarding experience and helping members successfully begin their care journey at Pelago. This role is primarily focused on conducting intake assessments, welcome calls, and initial clinical screenings, educating members on Pelago's care model, and connecting them with the appropriate ongoing care team.

Approximately 70% of this role is dedicated to member onboarding activities, including intakes, welcome calls, and care coordination. The remaining 30% focuses on maintaining a small ongoing caseload and providing flexible clinical support through temporary member coverage, pilot initiatives, and other operational needs. The ideal candidate is clinically strong, adaptable, enjoys variety, and is passionate about improving access to high-quality substance use care.
This is a direct-service, remote clinical role based anywhere in the USA.

In this role you will…
  • Serve as the first clinical point of contact for members entering Pelago, creating a welcoming, supportive onboarding experience.
  • Conduct initial screenings and intake assessments to evaluate behavioral health history, substance use, symptoms, and member goals.
  • Understand all Pelago care pathways, effectively communicate treatment options to members, and guide them toward the most appropriate level of care.
  • Facilitate warm transitions by connecting members with their assigned counselor or coach and sharing relevant clinical information to support continuity of care.
  • Conduct welcome calls and other early member touchpoints to build rapport, answer questions, increase engagement, and ensure a smooth transition into ongoing care.
  • Maintain a small ongoing caseload by providing individual counseling, monitoring progress toward behavior change goals, and supporting members as needed.
  • Provide temporary member coverage during clinician leave, staffing transitions, or other operational needs.
  • Support special projects, pilot programs, and new clinical workflows as needed.
  • Document member interactions thoroughly and contribute to ongoing quality improvement efforts.
  • Utilize evidence-based approaches including CBT, Motivational Interviewing (MI), mindfulness-based interventions, harm reduction techniques, and relapse prevention.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (including Product, Clinical, and Operations) to optimize the member experience and inform service improvements.
  • Maintain active licensure(s)/certification(s) in good standing and ensure compliance with all applicable regulations.

The background we are looking for...

  • 3+ years of clinical experience working with individuals with substance use disorders, with demonstrated expertise in CBT, MI, and relapse prevention.
  • Hold an active and unrestricted state credential (license/certification), issued via a state credentialing board. Multi-state licensure is preferred.
  • Credentialing recognized by IC&RC or NAADAC is required (e.g., AADC, CAADC, LADC, LCSW with SUD treatment scope, etc.).
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

Additional Qualifications

  • Experience providing SBIRT care for people with SUDs.
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.
  • Experience in program development and quality assurance in clinical settings.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills, with a track record of managing competing priorities.
  • Technologically proficient with experience leveraging virtual tools for care delivery.
  • Bonus: Experience with research, data analysis, or program evaluation.
  • Reliable home office setup with 50–100 Mbps internet bandwidth and a confidential workspace.

The provided range reflects our US target salary range for this full-time position, which is part of our broader total compensation package, including incentive bonus program, stock options, comprehensive benefits, and incentive pay applicable to eligible roles. Individual pay within the range will vary based on a variety of factors like role-related experience and education, internal pay equity, and other relevant business factors. At Pelago, we are committed to an equitable and fair pay philosophy and review total compensation for our employees at least twice a year.

Base Pay Range
$59,000—$62,000 USD

jobs.excerpt: Job Summary The Remote Physician Pro Fee Coding Specialist-Hospital Medicine NICU and ICU is responsible for reviewing, analyzing, and assigning accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes for professional fee services documented in the medical record.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Remote Physician Pro Fee Coding Specialist-Hospital Medicine NICU and ICU is responsible for reviewing, analyzing, and assigning accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes for professional fee services documented in the medical record. This role ensures proper sequencing, modifier use, and place-of-service coding in compliance with governmental regulations, third-party payer policies, and corporate standards. The Physician Coder plays a key role in revenue cycle accuracy by identifying documentation gaps, ensuring coding integrity, and working collaboratively with internal teams to support physician coding compliance and reimbursement.

Essential Functions

  • Assigns accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes for professional services, procedures, diagnoses, and treatments based on provider documentation.
  • Ensures compliance with governmental regulations, third-party payer policies, and corporate coding protocols, following National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits, Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), and National Coverage Determinations (NCDs).
  • Performs coding audits and quality reviews, verifying accuracy of documentation and identifying areas for provider education.
  • Works coding-related claim edits, holds, and scrubs in the electronic billing system (e.g., Athena Collector), ensuring timely claim resolution and reimbursement.
  • Collaborates with physicians, revenue cycle teams, and coding education staff, requesting clarification when necessary to ensure optimal documentation and compliance.
  • Performs edit checks on coded data before transmittal, identifying and correcting errors as needed.
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of patient records, provider information, and financial data, adhering to HIPAA and corporate compliance policies.
  • Escalates documentation or coding issues to the coding education team for provider training and improved documentation practices.
  • Assists in coding-related special projects, ensuring accurate reporting and analysis of coding data for operational improvement.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • H.S. Diploma or GED required
  • Associate Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred
  • 2-4 years of experience in physician coding, professional fee coding, or medical billing required
  • Experience with multiple specialties, surgical coding, or high-volume professional fee coding preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems for physician/professional fee services.
  • Understanding of modifier usage, place-of-service coding, and payer billing guidelines.
  • Experience with electronic health records (EHR), coding software, and claim processing systems.
  • Ability to identify documentation deficiencies and escalate for provider education.
  • Familiarity with NCCI edits, LCD/NCD guidelines, and medical necessity requirements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, ensuring accurate coding and optimal reimbursement.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, working with providers, revenue cycle teams, and compliance staff.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Certified Coder-AHIMA or AAPC (CPC) required or
  • CCS-Certified Coding Specialist (CCS-P) required
  • Additional certifications such as Certified Evaluation and Management Coder (CEMC) or Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) preferred

jobs.description:
💫Про RIA.com

Ми — українська продуктова ІТ-компанія RIA.com, яка розвиває відомі маркетплейси AUTO.RIA, DIM.RIA, AGRO.RIA та RIA.com. Нашими продуктами користуються мільйони українців, тож команда фахівців наполегливо працює над покращеннями та пошуками інноваційних рішень.

Ми шукаємо Клієнт-менеджера в команду Служби турботи про користувачів. На цій позиції ти будеш допомагати клієнтам швидко та якісно вирішувати їхні запити.

🔷Які задачі стоять перед Клієнт-менеджером:
  • Телефонні консультації: відповідає на вхідні та здійснює вихідні дзвінки клієнтів та допомагає у вирішенні їх запитів щодо продуктів компанії: AUTO.RIA, DIM.RIA, AGRO.RIA та RIA.com.
  • Письмові консультації: опрацювання звернень від користувачів в чатах та електронній пошті.
  • Сервісні запити: робота з CRM системою Creatio та взаємодія з іншими командами.
В середньому клієнт-менеджер отримує 60-80 звернень за робочий день.

⚡️Тепер про очікування до кандидата, якого шукаємо:
  • Досвід роботи з клієнтами: телефонні консультації або офлайн-взаємодія.
  • Турботливий підхід та емпатія: вміння розуміти потреби клієнта й прагнення допомогти.
  • Орієнтація на високий рівень сервісу: здатність забезпечити якісний клієнтський досвід навіть у складних ситуаціях.
Буде перевагою:
  • Досвід роботи з CRM-системами.
  • Досвід роботи у сфері підтримки клієнтів або контакт-центрі.
🔗Про етапи інтерв'ю:
  • Після відбору твого резюме — телефонний дзвінок з рекрутером.
  • Співбесіда в онлайн форматі з Лідеркою команди та тренером.
  • Запрошення на оплачуване стажування віддалено або в офісі (2-3 тижні)
📌Що на тебе чекає в RIA.com?
  • Практичне втілення командних цінностей: відкрита комунікація, індивідуальні тренінги з тренером, фідбек, підтримка наставника із першого дня для швидкої адаптації, без мікроменеджменту чи тайм-трекерів.
  • Комфортні умови роботи: віддалений або гібридний формат роботи, плаваючі 8-годинні зміни (4/2; 3/2; 3/1; 2/1) зі стартом між 08:00 та 14:00 та обідньою перервою, офіційне працевлаштування.
  • Здоров’я та турбота про себе: онлайн-консультації корпоративного лікаря та підтримка ментального здоров’я з психологом, оплачувані лікарняні та 20 робочих днів оплачуваної відпустки.
  • Можливості розвитку:перехід між категоріями для кар'єрного зростання, отримання бонусів за чітко визначеною системою KPI. Індивідуальні тренінги та участь у внутрішніх конкурсах для розвитку професійних навичок. Компенсація вивчення іноземних мов та бонусна програма для підтримки хобі та відпочинку ріакомівців.
RIA.com — соціально відповідальна українська компанія. «Авто для ЗСУ» від AUTO.RIA — це фандрейзинговий проєкт, який офіційно працює з 2023 року. Завдяки активному залученню команди, креативним ініціативам і колабораціям із зірками та українським бізнесом, ми придбали та відправили більше 40 автівок: пікапи, позашляховики, тягачі та вантажівки для військових у найгарячіші напрямки.

Більше про те, як ми працюємо, можна дізнатися тут:

jobs.description:
Unser Kunde ist einer der führenden Internetanbieter Deutschlands und baut und betreibt ein Glasfasernetz in ländlichen und vorstädtischen Gebieten Deutschlands. Wir suchen Customer Care Specialists für ein spezialisiertes Team im Bereich Kundenbindung und Vertragsmanagement.

Das Team arbeitet in zwei Kernbereichen: der Bearbeitung von Kündigungen und Widerrufen sowie der Bindung von Kunden durch einen beratenden, bedarfsorientierten Ansatz. Du bist die Stimme, die Kunden verbunden hält — im wörtlichen wie im übertragenen Sinne.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entgegennahme eingehender Anrufe von Bestandskunden mit dem Ziel, ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und sie durch echte, beratende Gespräche zu halten

  • Bearbeitung von Kündigungen, Widerrufen und allgemeinen Kundenanliegen — einschließlich Rechnungsanfragen, Tarifanpassungen und Stammdatenänderungen

  • Betreuung eines ausgewählten Kundenstamms und Bearbeitung von Anfragen per Telefon und schriftlich — die Rolle ist überwiegend telefonisch (~85 %), mit einem Anteil an schriftlicher Ticketbearbeitung (~15 %)

  • Arbeit mit mehreren Tools und Plattformen um Kundenanliegen effizient zu lösen und Interaktionen sorgfältig zu dokumentieren

  • Einhaltung von Qualitätsrichtlinien und Beitrag zu Teamzielen in den Bereichen Kundenzufriedenheit, Conversion und Serviceverfügbarkeit

Was wir suchen

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau - sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich. Eine angenehme Stimme und ein klarer, beratender Kommunikationsstil sind essenziell

  • Berufserfahrung im Kundenservice, idealerweise in einer Rolle mit Schwerpunkt Kundenbindung, Upselling oder beratender Verkauf

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten - du hörst aktiv zu, drückst dich klar aus und gehst empathisch auf dein Gegenüber ein

  • Sicherer Umgang mit mehreren Softwaretools gleichzeitig - der tägliche Wechsel zwischen verschiedenen Plattformen gehört zum Alltag

  • Eine zuverlässige, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise — ob im Homeoffice oder im Büro

  • Bereitschaft zur Arbeit in Schichten von 8:00 – 20:00 Uhr

  • Bereitschaft zur Teilnahme an einer strukturierten, 14-tägigen und bezahlten Schulung zu Beginn, bestehend aus einer Kombination aus Präsenztraining im Büro (Zagreb) und Remote-Trainings.

Von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung mit Salesforce

  • Kenntnisse in der Telekommunikations- oder Glasfaserbranche

  • Erfahrung mit Kundenbindung oder Rückgewinnungskampagnen

  • Grundkenntnisse in gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen

SVP Growth -Insights Strategy

About the Role
We are looking for an exceptional SVP Growth-Insights Strategy to join our Growth team. This is one of the most senior strategic roles within FINN Partners and is suited to an experienced agency strategist with deep research expertise and the judgment to turn findings into clear, actionable strategy. Research is the foundation of this role, and it exists to drive decisions. This person will move fluidly across primary and secondary research, digital and social listening, and AI-enabled methods, using whichever combination best answers the question at hand, and will translate what they learn into insight that reframes how clients see their business, audience, market, or competition. From there, they will make clear strategic recommendations, working closely with specialists across the agency to ensure those recommendations are realistic and implementable. While the role sits within the Growth team and plays a critical part in winning new business, it extends beyond RFPs and pitches. This person will also provide strategic and research leadership on existing client accounts, including engagements they were not involved in winning.

The role requires intellectual curiosity, strong research capability, commercial judgment, and the confidence to make clear recommendations often with limited information and tight deadlines.

Responsibilities
Research & Insight
  • Lead the design and execution of research across methodologies choosing the right mix for the question, timeline, and budget at hand.
  • Shape research methodology around the business question and the strategic decisions the client needs to make.
  • Move quickly and resourcefully in new business contexts without compromising the credibility of the findings.
  • Develop surveys, questionnaires, sampling approaches, and analytical frameworks when primary research is warranted.
  • Personally conduct executive stakeholder interviews, customer interviews, and other in-depth qualitative research.
  • Analyze findings alongside market, audience, competitor, and performance data.
  • Translate findings into insight that drives a decision: what the evidence says, why it matters, and what the client or FINN should do next.
  • Work effectively with specialist researchers, analysts, and external vendors while maintaining strategic ownership of the engagement.
  • Develop segmentation models, personas, journeys, and messaging frameworks that can be used and defended in front of senior leadership.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of evolving industry landscapes, methodologies, and cultural trends so recommendations stay current.
Strategy & Growth
  • Lead the strategic development of new business opportunities and RFP responses, using research to identify the central business challenge and build the case for why FINN is the right partner.
  • Develop insight-led strategies that differentiate FINN's proposals and create competitive advantage.
  • Translate research and strategy into practical recommendations that client and agency teams can implement.
  • Collaborate with creative, digital, PR, media, and account teams to ensure recommendations are realistic and well-supported.
  • Present strategic recommendations to prospective clients and senior FINN leadership.
  • Build measurement frameworks and KPIs aligned with client objectives.
  • Remain engaged following successful pitches to preserve continuity and support implementation.
  • Manage multiple opportunities and engagements simultaneously, balancing competing priorities and deadlines.
Client Leadership
  • Serve as a trusted research and strategy adviser to senior clients.
  • Provide strategic leadership on existing client accounts, including those where you were not involved in the original pitch.
  • Quickly get up to speed on unfamiliar businesses, industries, and operating environments.
  • Communicate complex findings and recommendations clearly and confidently, earning stakeholder buy-in through the credibility and rigor of the work rather than force of personality.
  • Identify opportunities to grow existing client relationships through additional research or strategic consulting.

Skills & Experience

The successful candidate will have:
  • Minimum 15 years of strategic experience, with the majority gained in an agency or consulting environment.
  • Significant experience designing and leading research across a range of methodologies.
  • Strong judgment about data quality and rigor, balanced with the scrappiness to move fast when new business timelines demand it.
  • Strong knowledge of survey design, sampling, research methodology, analysis, and insight development.
  • Experience personally conducting executive, stakeholder, and customer interviews.
  • Proven track record leading strategy for complex pitches, RFPs, and new business opportunities.
  • Ability to synthesize large volumes of information into a clear strategic point of view.
  • Excellent strategic storytelling, presentation, and facilitation skills, grounded in command of the evidence and the ability to defend a recommendation under scrutiny.
  • A track record of earning the confidence of senior stakeholders through the quality and credibility of their work.
  • A strong point of view on where marketing, media, and culture are heading.
  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to connect research and strategy to measurable business outcomes.
  • Comfort working with ambiguity, limited information, and evolving client requirements.
Personal Attributes
The ideal candidate will be:
  • Intellectually curious and insight driven.
  • Methodologically flexible and resourceful, with good instincts for when data is solid enough to act on.
  • Decisive, with the judgment to make a clear recommendation rather than present a list of options.
  • Commercially minded and focused on business outcomes.
  • Confident and credible in the room, earning trust through command of the work rather than salesmanship.
  • Structured and analytical, without losing sight of the bigger picture.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and incomplete information.
  • Proactive and self-directed.
  • Passionate about solving complex business and growth challenges.
Success in This Role
Success will be measured by the ability to:
  • Win new business through differentiated, research-backed strategic thinking.
  • Lead credible research that uncovers meaningful business and audience opportunities.
  • Translate research into decisions clients act on and business FINN wins.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders.
  • Grow existing client relationships through valuable strategic consulting.
  • Create measurable business impact for FINN and its clients.

Anticipated Salary:
$150,000 - $200,000
Commensurate with experience and depending upon the workplace.

Please upload your resume and cover letter, along with your desired salary in $USD.
While we appreciate the interest of all applicants, we will only respond to those whose qualifications closely align with the role.

FINN Partners is a global integrated marketing agency recognized as a top employer and an award-winning workplace. We are entrepreneurial, collaborative, and committed to shaping a bold future with clients across technology, healthcare, education, travel, and more. We celebrate creativity, curiosity, and the pursuit of meaningful, impactful work.

About the Team

Our engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments. We operate on a T-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems. This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross-domain code reviews, and dependable on-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work.

We develop primary control plane software in Rust and Go, leverage Kubernetes operators, and foster an OpenTelemetry-first operational culture.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with deep technical domain expertise in Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. Fitting into our T-shaped engineering model, you will drive the development of control planes powering high-density, high-throughput infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads. Familiarity with automated bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management is a strong asset.

Core Responsibilities

  • Control Plane Development: Design, build, and maintain production-grade control plane microservices, custom Kubernetes operators, and robust reconciliation engines in Rust and Go.

  • Architecture & API Design: Author clear Functional (FR) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), architectural specs, system sequence diagrams, and clean gRPC/Protobuf and REST API schemas.

  • Network Integration: Develop custom integration modules and integrations for modern network operating systems (SONiC, NVUE, Cumulus) and DPU hardware platforms.

  • Observability & Diagnostics: Instrument services end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (OTel) traces and metrics, performing systematic root-cause analysis across polyglot distributed systems.

  • Quality & Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous, review-gated pull request workflows across Rust, Go, and SQL codebases while ensuring high test coverage via mock-driven testing.

  • Language Proficiency: Primary mastery of Rust (Tokio async runtime, Tonic, Axum, sqlx) and strong proficiency in Go.

  • Data & APIs: Advanced SQL / PostgreSQL fluency, gRPC/Protobuf contract design, and schema evolution.

  • Concurrency & Reliability: Strong background in async concurrency models, lock-free patterns, distributed state handling, and mock-driven testing discipline.

  • Datacenter Protocols & OS: Expertise in BGP, MP-BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, L3VNI, route targets, and route server design. Hands-on experience with SONiC, Cumulus Linux, and NVUE (featuring a first-class NVUE client).

  • DPU & Fabric Ecosystem: Deep knowledge of NVIDIA DOCA, Host-Based Networking (HBN), BlueField DPU architectures, and the DPF (DOCA Platform Framework) operator model (BFB, DPUSet, DPUNode CRDs).

  • High-Performance Interconnects: Understanding of InfiniBand fabrics, NVLink / NMX-M partitioning, and RoCEv2.

  • Linux Kernel Networking: Advanced grasp of Linux netlink, network namespaces, routing tables, and internal DHCP/DNS service implementations (the project ships its own services).

  • Cloud & Kubernetes Networking: Familiarity with CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium). OVS and DPDK experience is a plus.

  • Provisioning & Boot Infrastructure: Expertise in PXE/iPXE, UEFI, Secure Boot, measured boot, and TPM attestation.

  • Hardware Management: Proficiency in Redfish, IPMI, and BMC abstractions across heterogeneous hardware platforms (Dell, Lenovo, NVIDIA reference hardware).

  • Linux Systems Internals: In-depth knowledge of boot chains, systemd, initramfs, BIOS configuration matrices.

  • Identity & Security: Practical experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, TLS, SPIFFE/SVID, Vault, KMS, Keycloak (OAuth2/JWT), and RBAC.

  • Virtualization: Experience with KubeVirt / KVM.

  • Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube-rs or controller-runtime with CRD-driven reconciliation loop patterns.

Universal Requirements

  • Testing Discipline: Commitment to test-driven design, writing highly testable code with mock interfaces for external hardware and network dependencies.

  • Collaborative Architecture: Proven track record of writing crisp architectural specs and engaging in constructive, cross-functional design reviews.

Educational & Experience Baseline

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in cloud-native platforms, systems programming, networking, or infrastructure automation.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Site Reliability Engineers keep GitLab's user-facing services and production systems running reliably at scale. They combine software engineering with operational excellence, applying sound engineering principles, automation, and continuous improvement to build, operate, and evolve our production infrastructure.

This is a single application for Site Reliability Engineering opportunities across Infrastructure Platforms. Rather than asking you to choose the right team or level upfront, we evaluate your skills holistically and match you to the opportunity that best aligns with your experience and our hiring needs. We hire Site Reliability Engineers from Intermediate through Senior Staff across multiple Infrastructure Platforms teams.

We don't expect every candidate to have experience with every technology in our environment. We're looking for engineers with strong technical fundamentals, a growth mindset, and the ability to learn quickly. We'll support you in becoming successful with GitLab's tools, systems, and ways of working.

Please note: This position is open to candidates based in the United Kingdom only. Candidates based in the United States or Canada can apply to this posting:Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Platforms — AMER (Intermediate to Senior Staff)

How our SRE hiring works

Because this is a single application for SRE roles across Infrastructure Platforms, our process is built to evaluate you once and match you well, rather than interviewing separately for every team.

  • Recruiter Screen: A conversation about your background, what you're looking for, and the level and teams that fit, so we can point your process in the right direction.
  • Core Technical: The shared assessment every SRE candidate takes, regardless of eventual team. A low-stress, collaborative discussion covering system architecture and incident review.
  • Hiring Manager Interview: A conversation about ownership, judgment, execution, collaboration, and growth, the non-technical signals that make an SRE effective at GitLab.
  • Peer Technical: Team-specific depth, run by SREs from the team you're most likely to join, focused on the problems that team actually works on.
  • Skip-Level Interview: A conversation with a senior leader on values alignment, and how you'll work across teams.

After your interviews, we consider your performance alongside our current hiring needs to confirm the level and team where you'll do your best work. Interview results are a major factor, and final placement also reflects our active hiring priorities at the time.

We’ll calibrate your level throughout the interview process based on the scope and impact of your experience.

  • Intermediate: You independently deliver meaningful reliability improvements within a defined area.
  • Senior: You own complex reliability work end to end and raise the effectiveness of your team.
  • Staff: You shape reliability across multiple teams, solving systemic problems and creating approaches others can reuse.
  • Senior Staff: You set technical direction across a broader Infrastructure area and influence reliability strategy at organizational scale.

What you'll do

  • Keep user-facing services and production systems reliable, scalable, and efficient
  • Build automation and tooling that reduces toil and replaces manual work with repeatable, infrastructure-as-code-driven workflows
  • Operate and troubleshoot production systems on Kubernetes, including deployments, rollouts, and scaling
  • Write and maintain infrastructure as code, and ship changes safely through CI/CD and GitOps
  • Participate in on-call, triage alerts, follow and improve runbooks, and escalate appropriately
  • Contribute to the observability stack, using metrics, logs, and SLOs to detect symptoms early rather than just outages
  • Take part in incident response and post-incident reviews, turning learnings into changes in automation and process
  • Document runbooks, architecture decisions, and reviews so your findings become repeatable practices

What you'll bring

  • Experience keeping production systems reliable, combining an operations mindset with real software engineering practice
  • Experience building net-new infrastructure tooling and automation, not just configuring existing tools. For example, Terraform modules, Kubernetes operators or controllers, or production automation and services written from scratch
  • The ability to read, debug, and reason about code. Most of our teams work in Go; some work in Ruby. You can discuss a piece of code's behavior, performance, and failure modes
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, and with Kubernetes and its ecosystem, at a depth appropriate to your level
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (GCP or AWS)
  • Familiarity with observability practices, including metrics, logging, alerting, and SLOs or SLIs, and using data to inform operational decisions
  • Comfort participating in on-call and incident response, with a structured approach to troubleshooting under pressure
  • Strong written communication and the ability to operate as a manager-of-one in an async, distributed environment
  • A track record of using automation, and increasingly AI, to reduce toil and improve how you and your team work
  • Alignment with GitLab's values and a commitment to working in accordance with them

About the team

Infrastructure Platforms is responsible for the availability, reliability, performance, and scalability of GitLab’s user-facing services, most notably GitLab.com. The organization spans teams across Production Engineering, GitLab Dedicated, GitLab Delivery, and Developer Experience, covering everything from the production fleet and networking platform to observability, incident response, deployment infrastructure, tenant scale, and our single-tenant Dedicated offering.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first organization that works asynchronously, favors automation over toil, and uses monitoring, metrics, and clear ownership to continuously improve the reliability of GitLab at scale. For more on how we work, see the Infrastructure Handbook Page.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund

When the Tarr Steps, a footbridge assembled of heavy stones in Exmoor National Park in England, washed away in a flood in 1942, the Royal Engineers rebuilt it. Then it washed away again in 1952. So the Royal Engineers heaved in more stones: on and on, like a Sisyphean lesson in absurdity.

Of course, they do this because the Tarr Steps are a historical monument, believed to be built during the Bronze Age. Modern bridge building looks a lot different and generally requires less upkeep. While we appreciate the charm of ancient things, Mercury is engineering the future of banking*. "Quaint" and "archaic" are not values we seek in our systems. Rebooting a tumbling server and hoping a flood of requests doesn't wash it away can be an emergency tactic, but we actively seek out durable solutions over monotonous ops work. You'll bring this ethos and teach others how to live it too.

Up to this point, the Stability team at Mercury has primarily built platform-level constructs that product teams adopt. However, those teams are asking for us to work more closely with them to mature their implementations and practices. We are creating an SRE team that will rotate through product teams. You will understand the team's domain, identify opportunities for improvements in reliability/observability/performance/preparedness and create self-reinforcing, virtuous cycles.

As part of this role, you will:

  • Embed with product teams, helping them improve their operational maturity by setting up and refining practices around on-call, monitoring, alerting, and run books
  • Run regular game day exercises with product teams, helping them feel more prepared to investigate and quickly remediate incidents
  • Jump into application code written in Haskell & TypeScript and implement reliability techniques such as retries, better error handling, better logging, circuit breaking, etc
  • Steer SLOs towards meaningful customer outcomes that product teams are accountable for. Those SLOs become a strong signal for whether the product is working as intended
  • Champion reliability practices through design document and code reviews
  • Identify observability gaps that hinder debugging, incident response, and business intelligence and help close those
  • Advocate for longer-term improvements that non-product engineering teams can drive
  • Participate in the product team's on-call rotation while embedding or as part of a more general engineering rotation, helping us improve processes and how we learn from incidents

The ideal candidate for the role:

  • Has past Site Reliability Engineering or DevOps experience
  • Has measurable examples of influencing an organization towards greater reliability
  • Has significant experience with PostgreSQL
  • Has authored and operated Temporal workflows
  • Has experience with observability platforms like Grafana or Honeycomb
  • Has familiarity with OpenTelemetry
