jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Meta Description:Explore entrepreneurship through acquisition with Rutherford: assessed leadership talent, career representation and entrepreneurial peer support.

Posting title:ETA Searchers & Operators — Acquisition Leadership

SEO Title:ETA Searchers & Operators | Rutherford International

Meta Description:Explore entrepreneurship through acquisition with Rutherford: assessed leadership talent, career representation and entrepreneurial peer support.

Keywords:entrepreneurship through acquisition, ETA searcher, ETA operator, search fund entrepreneur, acquisition entrepreneur, portfolio company CEO, family office, private equity

ETA Searchers & Operators — Acquisition Leadership
Evergreen Expression of Interest
Canada · United States · United Kingdom

Your next leadership opportunity could be a business that already exists

Building an enterprise does not always begin with a start-up. Entrepreneurship Through Acquisition offers another path: acquiring an established business—or joining an investment sponsor to lead one through its next chapter.

Rutherford International welcomes expressions of interest from ambitious professionals interested in becomingETA Searchers, Operators or Searcher–Operators.

Our proposition brings togetherassessed leadership potential, active career representation and entrepreneurial peer support. We help qualified prospects understand where their capabilities fit, develop their positioning and prepare for consideration by suitable investors and enterprise owners.

This is an Evergreen Expression of Interest, not a current vacancy, an investment offering or a promise of financing.

Two distinct routes

ETA Searcher — Find, acquire and potentially lead

You want to identify and pursue a suitable business acquisition. Your contribution may include developing an acquisition thesis, building relationships with owners and intermediaries, evaluating opportunities and working with investors and professional advisers through diligence and negotiation.

Where you intend to become CEO after acquisition, readiness for operating leadership is reviewed separately from search capability.

ETA Operator — Lead the acquired enterprise

You want to lead a business acquired—or being considered for acquisition—by an investment sponsor, family office or holding company.

Your focus is operating leadership: understanding the enterprise, earning the confidence of its people and customers, establishing priorities and building the management capacity required for its next stage.

Searcher–Operator

Some prospects may be suited to both responsibilities. Success in origination does not automatically establish suitability to run the acquired business; Rutherford considers each contribution separately.

Why Rutherford?

We represent talent and support its development.

Rutherford International is a talent management company, with an approach similar to the representation professional athletes receive from a talent agency.

For qualified members, our work extends beyond recording a résumé. It includes career advice, positioning, development priorities and consideration for relevant opportunities through employer and investment-sponsor relationships.

For an ETA prospect, this may include developing a clear acquisition or operating thesis: the businesses you are equipped to pursue or lead, the contribution you can demonstrate and the expertise you need around you.

Leadership fit comes before the introduction

A compelling acquisition thesis and strong financial analysis matter. So does the person who must earn an owner’s trust, make difficult decisions and lead after completion.

The RutherfordINTEL Assessment informs curator review of your behavioural profile and performance potential alongside your experience, achievements and objectives.

We distinguish:

  • The persistence, relationship-building and judgement required during a search.
  • The leadership and execution demands of operating an established business.
  • The enterprise’s ownership, stage, complexity and circumstances.
  • Your present readiness, development needs and supporting expertise.

A profile suited to a high-risk start-up is not automatically suited to an established acquisition. Matching begins with the actual mandate.

Bring an entrepreneurial peer circle into your journey

Qualified prospectsaged 18–28may also be considered forRising Young Stars, Rutherford’s assessed emerging-leadership programme.

Members join a facilitated entrepreneurial peer advisory circle—a continuing sounding board for examining decisions, sharing experience and challenging assumptions as their careers develop.

That means an eligible ETA prospect can develop alongside other ambitious, assessed emerging leaders, with access to experienced mentors and specialists where agreed.

Prospects outside the RYS age range may be considered separately for theCEO Peer Advisory / Mastermind Circleand individually matched support.

These relationships provide developmental support; they do not constitute a statutory board or replace transaction, legal, accounting or investment advisers.

Prepare for the business beyond the transaction

Acquisition is the beginning of operating responsibility.

Curator review may explore how you would approach the transition: learning the business, protecting customer relationships, understanding cash requirements, assessing the inherited team and establishing an effective operating rhythm.

Where appropriate, separately scoped support may be available through Rutherford’s network of executive mentors, coaches, fractional executives and specialist consultants.

Who should register?

We welcome prospects who can demonstrate relevant experience and judgement through operating roles, entrepreneurship, finance, investment, consulting, transactions or other consequential responsibilities.

You should be prepared to:

  • Explain the businesses and circumstances you want to pursue.
  • Support your claims with specific examples.
  • Examine opportunities critically, including deciding when to walk away.
  • Build trust with owners, employees, customers and investment partners.
  • Receive constructive challenge and address gaps in your capabilities.
  • Discuss geographic preferences, availability and willingness to relocate where relevant.

A credible path—with demanding selection and execution

Stanford’s 2026 study of US and Canadian search funds reports an aggregate acquisition rate of58%and aggregate investment returns of33.9% IRR and 4.75× invested capital. These historical results describe the studied funds, not an individual’s expected outcome or Rutherford’s performance.

The opportunity deserves serious preparation. Rutherford’s role is to help qualified talent become better understood, appropriately positioned and supported for the responsibilities ahead.

For ETA sponsors, private equity firms and family offices

Are you seeking a search entrepreneur or an operator for an acquisition?

Rutherford welcomes discussions with investment organisations interested in assessed leadership prospects, mandate-specific matching and continuing leadership-development support.

The investment organisation retains responsibility for its diligence, investment decisions and appointment requirements. Funding-partner enquiries should be directed to Rutherford International rather than submitted through the candidate application form.

Register your interest

Select“I’m interested”to complete Rutherford International’s Talent Registration form. Indicate whether your interest isSearcher, Operator or both.

Following initial review, a curator may invite you to provide further information, undertake assessment and discuss your thesis, development needs and potential membership pathway.

Initial registration is free and creates no payment obligation.Any subsequent assessment, membership or service fees will be explained before you commit.

Bring your ambition. Let’s examine the enterprise leadership opportunity you are equipped to pursue.

Registration does not guarantee membership, representation, an investor introduction, financing, an acquisition or an appointment.

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialisation of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies. We use our influence across the enterprise to craft our external interactions. Working across different markets and functions we listen to all voices, which allows us to optimally represent them when we communicate our products externally.

Business area

In the BioPharmaceuticals Business Unit team we thrive in our diverse and vibrant environment. Part of a global research-led enterprise, there’s always novel science to bring to market. It brings out the best in us – provided with all the support and tools needed and the agility to adapt quickly. Ignite your ambition and your true self. Part of our inclusive environment where there’s opportunity for global mobility, continuous learning, and building standard processes.

Join our industry-leading BioPharmaceuticals team, where our rich and diverse pipeline speaks for itself. Never complacent, we’re evolving and accelerating – growing Respiratory, Cardiovascular and Metabolism, moving into Immunology and Renal. We are proud of our growth because of the huge potential to build impact as well as our ability to address the unmet needs of more patients than ever with co-morbidities.

What you’ll do

In this role as a Respiratory Account Specialist (RAS) you will sell AstraZeneca inhaled respiratory brands to key secondary care customers, always representing AstraZeneca’s high ethical standards. You will:

  • Engage with key hospitals to expand sales volume and share through clinical and business-to-business selling
  • Generate customer / account insights and build account plans to increase the number of patients on AZ brands
  • Work with the cross functional team and with AZ customers to identify and deliver opportunities for practice change at a population level

Accountabilities:

  • To deliver and exceed sales targets for allocated brand/s
  • Accountable for the development and delivery of the account plan
  • Accountable for effective territory management – e.g. understand local NHS priorities to develop and implement effective call plans
  • Deliver against all agreed individual and team metrics in order to achieve Account goals, investing resources and budgets in line with agreed plans / expenditure. You will ensure impact from resource invested
  • Demonstrate and maintain high level of clinical, therapy area and environmental knowledge
  • Ensure compliance with all AZ Governance frameworks, SOPs and the ABPI Code of Practice

Crucial for the role

  • Strong interpersonal, communication and influencing skills (both with customers and colleagues)
  • Strong sales experience, including primary and secondary both f2f and virtual. Strong Pharma background – will also consider Pharmacists/Device Sales
  • Knowledge of the customer and therapy area within area of responsibility
  • High emotional intelligence confirmed through management of own demeanor
  • ABPI qualified (unless new to the representative role)
  • Experience of formulary applications at trust level
  • Experience in launching new medicines
  • Strong NHS knowledge and understanding
  • Demonstrable strategy implementation & pull through
  • Shows initiative and is self-starting
  • Strong results focus
  • Full driving licence

Desirable for the role

At AstraZeneca, we 're dedicated to being excellent Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and ignite your ambitious spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and teamwork, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

Job Title: Director of Marketing

Job Location: New York City, NY, US

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We are seeking a Marketing Director to lead global marketing for Veeva Safety, our industry-leading pharmacovigilance platform. Partnering closely with strategy and product management, you will develop the positioning, messaging, value propositions, and go-to-market strategy for Veeva Safety. You will translate product vision and innovation, customer needs, and market opportunities into compelling stories that drive awareness, customer adoption, and business growth.
You will own the product marketing strategy for Veeva Safety, working across product, strategy, sales, and regional marketing teams to bring new capabilities and innovations to market through product launches, release marketing, sales enablement, customer advocacy, and thought leadership—strengthening Veeva’s leadership in pharmacovigilance. You will shape how the market understands the value of Veeva Safety and help accelerate adoption across the life sciences industry.
Success in this role requires a strategic product marketer who combines deep customer and market understanding with exceptional storytelling. You can simplify complex technologies into clear customer value, influence product and go-to-market decisions, and partner across the organization to deliver measurable business impact. You thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and are equally comfortable developing long-term strategy and driving execution.

What You'll Do

    • Build and lead a global organization that delivers against marketing goals, with clearly defined roles, succession plans, and employee success strategies
    • Develop and drive global marketing strategy and go-to-market execution for Veeva Safety, aligning marketing initiatives with business objectives and market opportunities
    • Partner with product management and market strategy to develop differentiated positioning, messaging, and value propositions that resonate with safety operations, pharmacovigilance, and safety science leaders
    • Lead global product launches and release marketing, translating product innovation into integrated campaigns that drive awareness, customer adoption, and growth
    • Develop annual integrated marketing plans in partnership with regional field marketing teams, ensuring consistent global messaging while enabling regional execution
    • Create thought leadership, customer advocacy, and sales enablement programs that strengthen Veeva’s leadership in pharmacovigilance
    • Develop compelling marketing content—including customer stories, presentations, website content, videos, webinars, and sales tools—that supports every stage of the customer journey
    • Partner with sales to improve customer engagement through effective messaging, competitive positioning, and sales enablement materials
    • Collaborate across product, strategy, sales, services, and corporate marketing to ensure coordinated execution of global marketing initiatives
    • Represent the voice of the customer by bringing market insights, competitive intelligence, and customer feedback into product and marketing strategies
    • Measure marketing performance, evaluate business impact, and continuously optimize programs to improve awareness, pipeline, and customer adoption

Requirements

    • Progressive Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience leading marketing—including product marketing, go-to-market, integrated marketing, demand generation, field marketing—for complex B2B enterprise software or cloud solutions. Experience building global marketing programs and high-performing teams
    • Marketing Leadership: Proven success developing global marketing strategies and executing integrated go-to-market plans that drive market awareness, customer acquisition, adoption, retention, and business growth
    • Product & Go-to-Market Strategy: Experience developing product positioning, messaging, value propositions, and go-to-market strategies that differentiate products and successfully bring new innovations to market
    • Integrated Marketing: Experience leading integrated marketing programs across product launches, demand generation, customer marketing, sales enablement, thought leadership, digital marketing, events, webinars, and customer advocacy
    • Cross-functional Leadership: Proven ability to build trusted relationships and influence across product management, market strategy, sales, services, customer success, corporate marketing, and executive leadership to align priorities and deliver business outcomes
    • Global Marketing Leadership: Experience leading global marketing initiatives in partnership with regional teams, balancing a consistent global strategy with regional execution to maximize business impact
    • Customer & Market Focus: Strong understanding of customer needs, market dynamics, and competitive landscapes, with the ability to incorporate customer insights into marketing strategy, messaging, and go-to-market execution
    • Analytical & Results-oriented: Experience defining success metrics, measuring marketing performance, evaluating business impact, and optimizing programs based on data and customer insights
    • Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, executives, analysts, and internal stakeholders

Nice to Have

    • Experience marketing high-value solutions to the life sciences industry
    • Experience with Marketo

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A personality assessment
        3. A practical case exercise
        4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $125,000 - $225,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. Job Title: Senior Attack Surface Testing SMEJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: Public TrustEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking a Senior Attack Surface Testingsubject-matter expert to lead assigned continuous-assessment operations for federal cyber assets. This SME designs safe enumeration and validation approaches, directs junior engineers, adjudicates high-risk findings, and ensures rapid reporting and remediation guidance. This position works with the VM-ASE Technical Lead, customer process owners, Cloud/DevOps specialists, and AI-assisted analysis staff to deliver a repeatable, high-confidence assessment service.

This position will provide continuous technical assessment support for full‑time, proactive testing of externally and internally visible federal cyber assets. This expands federal visibility by conducting continual assessments of .gov domains, subdomains, and internet‑facing assets to uncover unknown exposures, validate vulnerabilities, and provide agencies with actionable remediation guidance. This role supports the Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) Program’s mission to safeguard and secure cyberspace in an environment where the threat of cyber-attack is continuously growing and evolving and is responsible for enhancing the security, resilience, and reliability of the Nation’s cyber and communications infrastructure. The CDM Program defends the United States (U.S.) Federal Information Technology (IT) networks from cybersecurity threats by providing continuous monitoring sensors (tools), diagnosis, mitigation tools, and associated services to strengthen the security posture of Government networks.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead continuous attack-surface enumeration, vulnerability discovery, controlled validation, change monitoring, triage, reporting, and remediation-support activities.
  • Design scan architecture, asset-attribution logic, rate limits, credential and API handling, validation procedures, and deconfliction safeguards for large-scale production assessment.
  • Direct and mentor junior engineers; review findings, evidence, false-positive determinations, attack paths, severity, and remediation recommendations.
  • Prioritize risk using exposure, exploitability, CISA KEV, EPSS, asset criticality, compensating controls, and mission impact rather than scanner severity alone.
  • Lead rapid analysis of newly exposed or high-risk assets and coordinate urgent notifications, customer clarification, and closure validation.
  • Define requirements for automation, data normalization, dashboards, AI-assisted triage, and integrations with customer tools and authoritative repositories.
  • Produce and technically approve recurring reports, trend analyses, high-risk findings, playbooks, standard operating procedures, and customer briefings.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • U.S. citizenship is required.
  • The selected candidate must meet eligibility requirements for access to sensitive information and be able to obtain a Public Trust fitness determination (High Risk).
  • Ability to work in customer-provided remote environments, use customer-approved tools, and comply with rules of engagement, data-handling requirements, evidence controls, deconfliction procedures, and stop-work criteria.
  • Five or more years of attack-surface management, vulnerability assessment, external reconnaissance, penetration testing, or exposure-management experience, including leadership of continuous or large-scale assessment work.
  • Deep knowledge of DNS, TLS/PKI, HTTP/S, TCP/IP, routing, service fingerprinting, cloud-hosting patterns, asset attribution, scanner behavior, and manual vulnerability validation.
  • Experience designing safe high-volume scanning and enumeration workflows with rate control, scope enforcement, evidence capture, false-positive adjudication, and operational deconfliction.
  • Strong automation and integration skills using Python, Go, Bash, APIs, structured data, source control, and repeatable pipelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical staff, make defensible risk decisions, write high-quality reports, and brief technical and senior stakeholders.
  • One or more relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSEP/OSCE, GPEN, GXPN, CISSP, GCIH, cloud-security certifications, or equivalent.

Desired:

  • Eight or more years in attack-surface, offensive-security, vulnerability-management, or internet-measurement roles.
  • Experience with federal .gov attack-surface monitoring, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, critical infrastructure, or high-value assets.
  • Advanced use of certificate-transparency, passive DNS, BGP/ASN, internet telemetry, cloud inventories, and exposure-management data sources.
  • Experience integrating findings with SIEM/data-lake, ticketing, visualization, or threat-intelligence platforms.
  • AWS, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD, container, or IaC-security experience sufficient to coordinate closely with platform specialists.
-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$90,300-$189,600

The Opportunity

As a Market Curation Editor for Culture, you'll support the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch. An automated pipeline drafts candidate prediction markets every night; you are the human judgment layer on top of it — deciding which go live, sharpening the ones that are nearly right, and catching the markets the pipeline missed entirely. This role calls for deep, current fluency in the U.S. entertainment and cultural landscape: its shows, its stars, its fandoms, and what people are actually talking about this week.

This beta is likely to extend into a planned Phase 2 regional expansion, alongside surge periods around awards season and major season finales. ** Will be removed prior to posting

What You'll Do

  • Review a daily queue of system-generated culture markets against a fixed completion deadline.
  • Assess each candidate for factual accuracy, clarity, and whether the resolution criteria can actually be adjudicated — often the hardest part in culture, since release dates move, awards categories change, and charts revise their methodology.
  • Verify that open and close timing matches the real event: an announcement, a broadcast, a release, a ceremony.
  • Make the relevance call — decide whether a market is genuinely live right now, or technically correct but culturally dead. This judgment is the core of the role.
  • Confirm policy fit against community standards and content guidelines. Culture sits closest to the line on markets about real people — escalate anything touching private life, health, minors, grief, or unverified allegations rather than making an unsupported call.
  • Approve, edit, or reject each candidate, recording a structured reason every time — this record is a product deliverable, not admin.
  • Rewrite questions and resolution language for precision and for how fans actually talk, including fandom vocabulary a generic writer would get wrong.
  • Author timestamped clarifications when ambiguity emerges in a live market, and handle settlement on markets with no authoritative feed.
  • Run proactive gap scans across social platforms, fan communities, and entertainment press for culturally live moments the pipeline missed.
  • Participate in weekly calibration reviews to stay consistent with published guidelines and fellow curators.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years in entertainment journalism, editorial, social or community management, or a comparable role requiring current subject-matter expertise.
  • Demonstrable current fluency in U.S. entertainment culture — television, film, music, celebrity, and fandom landscape — following it now, not historically.
  • Working knowledge of the U.S. media landscape: which outlets break news, which are reliable, and which announcements are real versus speculative.
  • Sound judgment on ambiguity: rumor versus confirmation, shifting release dates, contested awards outcomes, revised chart methodology.
  • Ability to interpret sources quickly and reach a defensible determination.
  • Exceptional written precision under deadline — able to write unambiguous rules that hold up after the outcome is known.
  • Strong instinct for where a market about a real person crosses from public interest into private life, and the discipline to escalate rather than guess.
  • Availability for evening, overnight, and weekend work around live events.

Nice to Have

  • Current or former entertainment journalist (outlets in the vein of Entertainment Tonight, Access Hollywood, People, BuzzFeed News, or a relevant Substack).
  • Experience trading on, participating in, or otherwise familiar with the workings of prediction markets.
  • Prior work in a newsroom, or managing large social platforms for a news or entertainment brand with a hard daily deadline.
  • Familiarity with content policy, moderation frameworks, or editorial standards — especially around coverage of private individuals.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Billing organization at Stripe builds and operates Stripe Billing, a growing product vertical inside of Stripe. Hundreds of thousands of businesses of all sizes and types use Stripe Billing to collect revenue for recurring and one-time payments across a variety of different pricing models—from selling SaaS subscriptions, to orchestrating multi-stage contracts, delivering business analytics, and providing recovery and retention tools to prevent customer churn.

To support even the most unique and complex business models, our technology and products must be configurable and programmable. This requires our team to innovate in how we model different types of businesses, and how we use technology to enable customers to piece together Stripe’s Billing’s platform primitives into holistic solutions that support any type of business. Through this work, Stripe Billing allows worry-free innovation and evolution of any customer’s business model. Stripe is defining the industry’s approach to Billing solutions; we’re looking for innovators to join us.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead a team within the Stripe Billing organization. In this role, you will manage a high-performing team of engineers and partner closely with product managers and other cross-functional leaders to shape the team’s strategy and roadmap. You will excel in this role if you’re a product-focused engineering manager who can collaborate effectively across multiple teams and functions to deliver results. If you enjoy building and nurturing high-performing engineering teams, helping guide the direction of product development, and engaging directly with users of the platform, this will be a great opportunity for your career.

You will:

  • Partner closely with engineering leaders, product managers, and designers to shape the team’s strategy and roadmap

jobs.excerpt: We Are:Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world's leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services, creating tangible value at speed and scale.
jobs.description:
We Are:

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world's leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services, creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent and innovation led company with 750,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries.


As a leader in Intelligent Operations, we help clients reimagine and transform their procurement and sourcing functions, making them more strategic, more efficient, and more resilient. Our Operations practice brings together deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, AI-powered tools, and a global delivery network to help clients move from transactional procurement to predictive, outcomes-driven enterprises. We don't just design solutions, we build and run them alongside our clients, driving measurable impact across every stage of the source-to-pay continuum.


You Are:

Accenture is seeking an Operations Solution Architect Senior Manager, Source to Pay to play a pivotal role in designing and implementing complex, outcomes-driven solutions for our clients. You are a seasoned procurement and sourcing professional who combines deep functional expertise with sharp commercial instincts and the ability to build trusted relationships at the senior client level.


You thrive in a client-facing environment, are comfortable leading conversations at the C-suite level, and have the credibility to position yourself as a subject matter advisor. You know how to listen, ask the right questions, and translate what a client is telling you into a solution that draws on the best of what Accenture has to offer, including its people, processes, technology, and AI capabilities.

You operate as a single point of contact, or as part of a team on larger deals, accountable from Stage 1 through deal closure and transition to the delivery organization.


The Work:

  • Architect end-to-end solutions for large-scale managed services deals, with a focus on strategic sourcing, spend analysis, category management, supplier relationship management, contract management, buy desk operations, purchase order creation, spot buys, tail spend management, and accounts payable
  • Lead client discovery and requirements-gathering sessions, building confidence with senior buyers by demonstrating deep domain knowledge and an ability to connect their business challenges to concrete, deliverable solutions
  • Orchestrate Accenture's full range of assets, including talent, processes, technology platforms, and AI and agentic tools, to design solutions that are commercially viable, operationally sound, and aligned to the client's desired business outcomes
  • Manage all industry group and vertical relationships, senior client buyer interactions, and functional owner engagements for the designated solution
  • Drive the necessary sign-off of the solution with proper input from industry groups and verticals on client business objectives, industry context, risk assessment, budget, and preferences
  • Manage the sales team and Subject Matter Experts required during the sales process, and coordinate communication and collaboration with the delivery organization
  • Direct and coordinate with legal, commercial and regulatory teams to ensure all solution components adhere to standards and contractual requirements
  • Collaborate with industry groups and verticals to provide input to Terms and Conditions, and in some cases be accountable for specific contractual terms
  • Develop cost model estimates working with delivery organizations and the pricing and commercial team to deliver the defined scope of services
  • Align the final solution architecture, including statement of work, schedules, and other contractual documents, with final terms and conditions
  • Identify leadership contacts for service transition and operations, and ensure appropriate solution plan handover for closed deals
  • Apply knowledge of AI and agentic tools to identify where intelligent automation, AI-assisted sourcing, and autonomous process agents can be embedded within client solutions to drive efficiency and outcomes
  • Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and evolving best practices in procurement managed services, bringing market-leading perspectives to every client engagement

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's What You Need:

  • Minimum of 8 years of experience as a Solution Architect, Business Consultant, or similar role within procurement, sourcing, or managed services, with hands-on knowledge across the source-to-pay continuum
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Procurement As-a-Service or procurement managed services
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in business development, sales strategy, and/or proposal development roles
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience with outsourcing, solution planning, and deal shaping
  • Minimum of 1 year and working knowledge of leading source-to-pay and procurement technology platforms, including but not limited to SAP Ariba, Coupa, JAGGAER, and Oracle Procurement Cloud. Candidates are not expected to be implementation specialists, but should have sufficient platform familiarity to engage credibly with a client's IT and procurement technology teams on integration requirements, system connectivity, and the role each platform plays within a managed services operating model
  • Minimum of 1 year and demonstrated proficiency in working with AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, GPT, or Copilot as part of day-to-day work, and an understanding of how AI and agentic solutions can be applied within procurement operating models
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus Points:

  • Advanced degree such as an MBA or equivalent
  • Knowledge of supply chain functions including planning and forecasting, order fulfillment, logistics, inventory management, and aftersales services, as a complement to procurement expertise
  • Experience with Negotiate to Close and Win Strategy Development
  • Value Proposition Development and Business Case Development
  • Solution Configuration and Solution Planning for Outsourcing Methodology
  • Pricing Strategy and Execution
  • Service Transition and Solution Realization methodology
  • Familiarity with leading procurement and supply chain technology platforms such as SAP, Coupa, Ariba, or Oracle
  • Understanding of automation and agentic AI trends in the procurement and operations marketplace
  • Strong analytical skills with advanced expertise in Excel and PowerPoint

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionIn ganz Europa stehen Fuhrparks unter enormem Druck.
jobs.description:
Description

In ganz Europa stehen Fuhrparks unter enormem Druck. Kraftstoffkosten steigen, regulatorische Anforderungen werden komplexer und der Umstieg auf emissionsärmere Fahrzeuge nimmt Fahrt auf. Gleichzeitig verwalten noch immer rund 70 % der europäischen Unternehmen ihre Flotten mit Excel-Tabellen, isolierten Tools und Prozessen, die für die heutigen Herausforderungen nie ausgelegt waren.

Shiftmove macht genau das einfacher. Wir sind ein profitables B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen und die am schnellsten wachsende Flottenmanagement-Plattform Europas. Entstanden aus dem Zusammenschluss von Avrios und Vimcar, unterstützen wir heute zehntausende Geschäftskunden in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien, der Schweiz, Polen und weiteren europäischen Märkten. Mit den jüngsten Akquisitionen von Optimum und Ocean in Frankreich haben wir unsere Präsenz weiter ausgebaut und unsere Position in einem der größten Flottenmärkte Europas gestärkt.

Unsere KI-gestützte Plattform verbindet Fahrzeugdaten in Echtzeit mit intelligenter Software, damit Unternehmen ihre Fahrzeuge smarter beschaffen, Kosten kontrollieren, Compliance sicherstellen und die Mobilitätswende aktiv gestalten können – alles an einem Ort.

Über die Rolle

Als Account Manager:in übernimmst du die kommerzielle Verantwortung für ein bestehendes Kundenportfolio und trägst aktiv zum Wachstum von Shiftmove bei. Dein Ziel ist es, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen nicht nur langfristig zu sichern, sondern ihr Potenzial gezielt auszuschöpfen – durch Renewals, Upselling, Cross-Selling und die Entwicklung neuer Umsatzmöglichkeiten.

Dabei betreust du ein umfangreiches Portfolio an B2B-Kunden mit einem Geschäftsvolumen von rund 4–5 Mio. €. Du erkennst kommerzielle Chancen, gehst proaktiv auf Kunden zu, führst Vertrags- und Preisverhandlungen und bringst Opportunities erfolgreich zum Abschluss.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Customer Success Team zusammen, übernimmst aber die eigenständige Verantwortung für die kommerzielle Entwicklung deiner Accounts.

Das erwartet dich

  • Account Management & Kundenentwicklung: Du betreust eigenverantwortlich ein Portfolio aus Mid-Market-Kund und ausgewählten Enterprise Accounts. Du behältst den Überblick über deine Accounts, priorisierst Chancen und Risiken und definierst klare nächste Schritte.
  • Renewal Management: Du verantwortest die Verlängerung bestehender Verträge – von der Vorbereitung des Angebots über die Abstimmung mit Kund bis hin zur Preisverhandlung und zum Abschluss.
  • Expansion: Gemeinsam mit Customer Success identifizierst du Upsell- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale und entwickelst daraus konkrete Opportunities. Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kund und kannst nachvollziehbar vermitteln, welchen Mehrwert zusätzliche Produkte oder Lösungen für sie schaffen.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du kommunizierst mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartner auf Kundenseite und lernst, auch komplexere Entscheidungsprozesse strukturiert zu steuern.
  • Pipeline & Forecasting: Du dokumentierst relevante Entwicklungen in Salesforce und Planhat, hältst deine Opportunities aktuell und erstellst realistische Forecasts für deine Pipeline.

Was du mitbringst

  • B2B Sales Erfahrung: Du bringst ca. 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit, idealerweise im SaaS- oder Subscription-Umfeld, z.B. im Account Management, Existing Customer Sales oder als Account Executive.
  • Verhandlungsgeschick & Closing: Du hast bereits eigenständig Verkaufsgespräche geführt, kommerzielle Verhandlungen gesteuert und Deals erfolgreich abgeschlossen, idealerweise im fünfstelligen Bereich.
  • Portfolio Management: Du hast Erfahrung in der Betreuung und kommerziellen Entwicklung eines größeren Kundenportfolios und weißt, wie du Accounts und Opportunities effektiv priorisierst.
  • Sales Drive & Proaktivität: Du gehst aktiv auf Kunden zu, erkennst Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und hast Freude daran, Umsatzpotenziale in konkrete Abschlüsse umzuwandeln.
  • Consultative Selling: Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden und kannst den Mehrwert einer Lösung überzeugend vermitteln, statt dich ausschließlich auf Produktfeatures zu konzentrieren.
  • Lernbereitschaft & Coachability: Du bist offen für Feedback, möchtest dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und probierst gerne neue Ansätze aus.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau.

Warum uns?

  • Produkte mit echtem Impact: Wir lösen reale Herausforderungen für tausende Unternehmen in ganz Europa und machen komplexe Flottenprozesse einfacher, effizienter und datengetriebener.
  • Etwas Sinnvolles skalieren: Als profitables, PE-finanziertes Scale-up mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen verbinden wir Stabilität mit Geschwindigkeit und Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Internationales Umfeld: Über 40 Nationalitäten, Englisch als Unternehmenssprache und Teams in ganz Europa sorgen für spannende Perspektiven und echte Zusammenarbeit.
  • Verantwortung statt Micromanagement: Wir geben Menschen den Freiraum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ideen einzubringen und Dinge voranzutreiben.

Benefits

  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Workation: Bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr remote von überall auf der Welt arbeiten
  • Hundefreundliches Büro: Weil tierische Kolleg einfach dazugehören 🐶
  • Weiterentwicklung: 2.000 € jährliches Budget für persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung
  • Benefits nach Wahl: Urban Sports Club, Hrmony, JobRad oder Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket/BVG-Ticket
  • Wellbeing: 1 Mental Health Day plus Zugang zu nilo.health
  • Für Foodies: Kostenloses Mittagessen einmal pro Woche, gemeinsames Frühstück alle zwei Wochen sowie Snacks und Getränke rund um die Uhr 🍕

We mean it!

Mit über 40 Nationalitäten verbindet uns vor allem eines: der gemeinsame Anspruch, Mobilität für Unternehmen einfacher zu machen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven machen unsere Arbeit besser.

Uns ist nicht wichtig, ob dein Lebenslauf perfekt aussieht. Uns interessieren Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Dinge ins Rollen bringen und Lust haben, gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen.

Du bist nicht sicher, ob du alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Und wenn du im Bewerbungsprozess etwas brauchst oder Anpassungen notwendig sind, sag einfach Bescheid – wir finden eine Lösung.

jobs.excerpt: How to Apply: 1.  Submit Your Resume 2.  Complete the short application form at the link provided.
jobs.description:
How to Apply:
1. Submit Your Resume
2. Complete the short application form at the link provided.
3. Only candidates who complete the form will be considered.

About the Job
As an Email Marketing Manager at CrucialPoint, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing our email marketing strategies to drive engagement, conversion, and customer retention.

This role requires a deep understanding of email marketing best practices, retention marketing principles, and analytics, along with a creative mindset to develop compelling content. If you have a passion for email marketing for enterprise-level accounts using Klaviyo, possess strong technical acumen, and excel at driving results, we would love to hear from you.

Why Work With Us
At CrucialPoint, we pride ourselves on creating exceptional results-driven retention programs for our diverse range of ecommerce clients. As an Email Marketing Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to work with amazing brands and be at the forefront of the industry. We foster a collaborative and supportive work environment, where your ideas and contributions are valued. Additionally, we offer room for growth, flexible scheduling, and a competitive salary / rate.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and Execute Email Marketing Strategies:

    • Create and implement comprehensive email marketing strategies using Klaviyo that align with business goals and industry best practices.

    • Optimize and improve automated email marketing flows (e.g., welcome series, abandoned cart, win-back) and signup forms in Klaviyo to maximize new customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and revenue generation.

    • Develop comprehensive content calendars aligned with client objectives, ensuring consistent and engaging messaging throughout email marketing campaigns.

  • Client Collaboration:

    • Collaborate closely with clients and Client Success Managers to translate requirements into effective Klaviyo email marketing campaigns, ensuring their success and satisfaction.

    • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, promptly addressing questions and concerns.

    • Partner with clients and internal teams to understand business needs and translate them into actionable strategies that help drive business growth.

  • Technical Optimization:

    • Manage Klaviyo setups, integrations (e.g., Shopify, CDPs, custom tech stacks), and account infrastructure, ensuring they are properly configured, segmented, and performing optimally.

    • Conduct regular audits in Klaviyo to identify and resolve technical issues related to email deliverability, responsive design, dynamic tagging, and personalization.

    • Identify technical issues and work diligently to resolve them in a timely manner.

  • Data Analysis and Reporting:

    • Monitor and analyze lifecycle and email marketing performance metrics via Klaviyo analytics and Google Analytics, such as repurchase rates, LTV, engagement rates, and list growth.

    • Provide insights and recommendations based on data analysis to optimize performance and drive continuous improvement.

    • Generate accurate and comprehensive reports, ensuring data-driven decision-making.

    • Continuously analyze data and metrics to identify revenue opportunities for clients, providing strategic recommendations to drive growth and maximize ROI.

  • Quality Assurance:

    • Perform quality assurance checks on all Klaviyo email marketing campaigns and flows, ensuring accuracy, consistency, dynamic data rendering, and adherence to industry best practices.

  • Collaboration and Team Support:

    • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including account management, copywriting, design, and implementation, to deliver seamless and impactful email marketing strategies.

    • Foster a positive and collaborative team environment, supporting and mentoring team members when needed.

  • Continuous Learning and Adaptability:

    • Stay up-to-date with Klaviyo features, updates, industry trends, and emerging technologies in retention marketing, incorporating them into our strategies to maintain a competitive edge.

    • Adapt to evolving industry trends, consumer behaviors, and email marketing regulations (e.g., GDPR, CAN-SPAM, CASL).

Requirements (Skills & Qualifications):

  • B2C experience is required, particularly with enterprise ecommerce businesses.

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience managing or having heavy involvement in running an Email Retention Marketing program for a B2C eCommerce brand—Email, SMS, Push, and/or direct mail.

  • Demonstrated expertise in identifying revenue opportunities, developing content strategies, and enhancing retention and loyalty marketing.

  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo. Demonstrated mastery of advanced Klaviyo features including predictive analytics, custom flow logic, complex segmentation, and SMS integration.

  • Knowledge of HTML/CSS and basic coding principles for email design and customization within Klaviyo.

  • Familiarity with CRM, CDPs, eCommerce platforms (such as Shopify), and Google Analytics.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to analyze data, generate insights, and make data-driven recommendations.

  • Previous experience working with larger brands as a retention marketing manager preferred.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build strong client relationships and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently.

  • Experience in remote work environments and self-motivation.

About CrucialPoint: CrucialPoint is a Full Service Retention Marketing Agency known for creating time-tested, effective Retention programs (Email, SMS, Push, Loyalty, Lifecycle) for amazing eCommerce brands. We thrive on solving intriguing challenges and delivering exceptional value to our clients. Join our team and be part of our mission to provide innovative solutions and drive success for our clients.

As a Partner Support Specialist, you'll own the support experience for a book of about 550 orthodontic and dental practices. You'll work alongside the Practice Growth Advisors who own each relationship, taking the operational and platform work off their plate so they can focus on growth.

If teammates hand things to you because they know you will get it done, this role was built for you.

What you’ll do

Job Title: Senior Medical Science Liaison, Solid Tumors - West Germany

Job Location: Germany Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.


Job Description

The Senior Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is the field-based Medical Affairs’ representative in relation to the external medical community.


This role is responsible for building and maintaining professional relationships and partnerships with Healthcare Professionals (HCPs), Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and other external stakeholders to exchange scientific and medical information related to BeOne’s therapeutic areas, products and pipeline.


The Senior MSL combines in-depth scientific expertise with strong external engagement to plan, develop and execute Medical Affairs tactics and activities within the assigned geographic area, and, through regular field interactions, collects, analyzes and communicates actionable medical insights, emerging trends and unmet medical needs to internal stakeholders, contributing to the definition and execution of medical affairs strategies.


The role collaborates closely within Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations, and other internal teams, while maintaining medical independence and ensuring full compliance with regulatory, ethical, and company standards.


MSLs contribute to advancing scientific knowledge, supporting the safe and appropriate use of BeOne products, and strengthening the company’s scientific credibility within the healthcare community.


West Germany area comprises Nordrhein-Westfalen, Rheinland-Pfalz, Saarland and parts of Hessen.

Essential Functions of the job:


SCIENTIFIC & MEDICAL COMMUNICATION

  • Deliver high-quality, accurate and non-promotional scientific exchange with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
  • Develop and execute tactics for communicating complex scientific information to the healthcare community, in communication with the TAL.
  • Provide accurate and up-to-date scientific communication on BeOne’s pipeline products and/or indications in development, at the request of Healthcare Professionals.
  • Facilitate responses to unsolicited requests for medical information, often in direct collaboration with BeOne Medical Information Services personnel as appropriate.
  • Provide first-line scientific communication on the assigned products/environment in response to requests from HCPs. Present data on BeOne products, including clinical data, development data, publications and, upon unsolicited requests, data outside the scope of marketing authorization, through ad-hoc field engagements or during scientific meetings.
  • Support, attend, and follow up on local, national, regional and international scientific congresses and events.
  • Support enterprise activities such as booth duty, session coverage, and insight gathering, as well as partaking in the planning and execution of omnichannel initiatives, thereby taking a shared responsibility for achieving our enterprise goals.

KOL ENGAGEMENT

  • Identify, map, develop and maintain engagement plans for medical experts and national or regional institutional networks (healthcare decision-makers, public health organizations, etc.) in the assigned therapeutic area and location.
  • Establish, develop and maintain long-term professional relationships with HCPs and cooperative groups in BeOne's therapeutic areas.
  • Propose, initiate, implement and monitor scientific partnerships in line with the cross-functional strategy established for the key clinical sites and hospitals in the assigned region.
  • Participate in the planning, organization and execution of medical events (e.g. congresses and advisory boards) according to needs.

EVIDENCE GENERATION & CLINICAL SUPPORT

  • Identify and support the identification and verification of investigators and clinical sites for company-sponsored clinical trials.
  • Contribute to or conduct monitoring on developments in the therapeutic area landscape and standards of care.
  • In collaboration with clinical operations, participate in site feasibility assessments, planning and onboarding of clinical trials sites, and continuous follow-up of sites and ongoing trials in the assigned region.
  • Serve as the primary territory liaison for the receipt, preliminary review, and submission of Investigator Sponsored Research proposals, facilitating the process from concept submission through publication.

MEDICAL INSIGHTS & STRATEGIC INPUT

  • Collect, analyze and communicate field-based medical insights to internal stakeholders.
  • Provide scientific input and field-based feedback to define, update and support medical affairs strategies.
  • Identify unmet medical needs and emerging trends in the therapeutic area.
  • Plan, organize and chair clinically relevant local medical meetings, such as advisory boards, consultancy and local investigator meetings, in collaboration with the TAL.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

  • Build strong relationships with the Medical Affairs Department and collaborate with BeOne's European and Global Medical Affairs teams.
  • Provide scientific and medical expertise to cross-functional teams.
  • Interact with sales teams on cross-functional projects unrelated to products.
  • Organize local scientific events, review scientific literature, and support the Medical Manager (where applicable) or take the lead in the development and delivery of scientific training programs and medical updates to the Field Sales Force.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to develop and execute a medical plan designed to meet shared objectives.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Not applicable.

Qualifications:

  • MD, PhD or PharmD with a minimum of 4 years’ experience, or Master’s degree with a minimum of 6 years’ experience, with a proven track record in the Pharmaceutical Industry, ideally with relevant clinical, scientific and/or medical affairs experience in the relevant therapeutic area.
  • The candidate should bring experience in medical affairs with previous positions in Lung Cancer and/or upper-GI Cancer. Previous work with Immunecheckpoint inhibitors is considered a plus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong stakeholder engagement capabilities.
  • Deep understanding of the relevant therapeutic area landscape and local market dynamics
  • In-depth understanding of disease states, differential algorithms for treatment decisions, treatment guidelines, compliance standards, and local/regional regulatory requirements.
  • Ability to identify and address unmet medical, educational and research needs within the medical community
  • Proven ability to translate scientific and clinical data into actionable medical insights.
  • Clinical research experience is preferred.
  • Strong project management skills with demonstrated ability to manage projects and/or colleagues in successful implementation of business-critical projects.
  • Ability to effectively collaborate in a dynamic and global environment.
  • Exhibits high degree of emotional intelligence and appreciation of diversity and multiculturalism.
  • Proven ability to drive results at a high level of quality as a strategic and creative thinker.
  • Demonstrates ability to deal with ambiguity and thrive in an ever-changing environment.
  • Strong time management and organizational skills.

Salary Range Germany: 109,100.00 EUR - 136,400.00 EUR

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity, and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

The Opportunity

Our Abbott story is one of delivering bold solutions in the face of complex healthcare challenges. At Abbott Electrophysiology (EP), we’ve been a leader for over 20 years, pioneering one of the first mapping systems, introducing the first contact force ablation catheter and creating a portfolio of products trusted in millions of procedures around the world. We have and will continue to redefine what’s possible in an evolving and challenging EP landscape.

When you join Abbott EP, you become part of a passionate group of individuals who are dedicated to driving the EP space forward and helping people live longer, fuller lives. We are committed to building a foundation for our people to be successful, investing in their development and growth, and creating a diverse, inclusive culture that welcomes different perspectives, experiences and backgrounds.

What You’ll Work On

Identifies and routinely uses the most effective, cost efficient and best business practices to execute processes; continually evaluates their effectiveness and appropriateness. Exercises independent judgment in planning, organizing and performing work; monitors performance and reports status to manager.

You will join a high-functioning, collaborative team, partnering closely with physicians and hospital staff to support the diagnosis and treatment of abnormal heart rhythms to achieve better patient outcomes. In this role, individuals will exercise independent judgment in planning, organizing, and performing day-to-day tasks. You will identify and routinely use the most effective, cost-efficient, and best business practices to execute processes, regularly communicating insights, feedback, and results to managers and team.   • Providing management with feedback on market trends and customer insights to inform strategic decisions and guide next-generation product development.
  • Participating in occasional travel for in-person instruction and live procedure coverage.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • An established network of senior decision-makers across Saudi brands, media agencies, and advertisers.
  • Experience selling digital advertising solutions through global platforms, media owners, publishers, or ad tech companies.
  • Familiarity with X's advertising products, paid social, video advertising, and campaign measurement solutions.
  • A proven track record of exceeding sales quotas, expanding client portfolios, and securing new advertising investment.
  • Experience leading quarterly business reviews, developing joint business plans, and managing strategic accounts.
  • Strong analytical capabilities and familiarity with CRM tools such as Salesforce.
  • A collaborative, coachable mindset combined with commercial ambition and the ability to deliver results with minimal supervision.

What Success Looks Like

  • Revenue Performance: Consistently achieve quarterly and annual sales targets through strategic account growth and new business development.
  • Portfolio Growth: Increase advertiser investment through upselling, renewals, and account expansion.
  • New Business: Develop a strong pipeline and convert new opportunities into sustainable revenue.
  • Client Partnerships: Build trusted, long-term relationships with leading advertisers, agencies, and senior decision-makers.
  • Commercial Excellence: Maintain accurate forecasting, disciplined account planning, and effective collaboration across teams.
  • Market Growth: Strengthen X's advertising presence and expand commercial opportunities across Saudi Arabia.

Why Join?

  • Global Platform Exposure: Represent X, one of the world's most recognized social media platforms, and help brands unlock new advertising opportunities.
  • Commercial Ownership: Take responsibility for strategic client relationships, revenue growth, and business development.
  • Professional Growth: Strengthen your expertise in digital advertising, consultative selling, and strategic account development.
  • International Environment: Collaborate with experienced professionals in a dynamic, multicultural digital advertising business.
  • Market Impact: Play a key role in expanding digital advertising partnerships across Saudi Arabia.

If you're a results-driven digital advertising sales professional who combines strategic client relationships with a passion for business growth, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Associate Vice President, Risk Measurement, Governance & Reporting
jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community The Associate Vice President, Risk Measurement, Governance & Reporting leads the design, implementation, and ongoing operation of enterprise risk measurement, governance, and reporting capabilities within Enterprise Risk Management.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Associate Vice President, Risk Measurement, Governance & Reporting leads the design, implementation, and ongoing operation of enterprise risk measurement, governance, and reporting capabilities within Enterprise Risk Management. Reporting to the Vice President, Enterprise Risk Management, this leader translates the ERM strategy, risk appetite, and governance model established by ERM leadership into practical methodologies, standards, operating routines, and decision-ready insights.
This role owns the day-to-day operation of enterprise risk measurement, governance, and reporting, including risk measurement methodologies, governance administration, enterprise risk reporting, risk appetite monitoring, and related standards. The role partners closely with business and functional leaders, risk owners, Finance, Compliance, Technology, Internal Audit, Resilience, and other stakeholders to improve the consistency, comparability, and usefulness of risk information across the organization through effective governance, independent second-line oversight, and constructive challenge.

Key Responsibilities

Risk Measurement and Methodology

  • Design, maintain, and operationalize enterprise methodologies used to identify, assess, measure, prioritize, aggregate, and monitor risk across risk categories and business functions.
  • Translate approved risk appetite statements into measurable tolerances, thresholds, indicators, and monitoring routines.
  • Establish practical standards for key risk indicators, key control indicators, risk scoring, trend analysis, scenario analysis, and risk aggregation.
  • Promote consistent application of measurement methods while allowing proportionate approaches based on risk type, available data, and decision need.
  • Partner with Finance, analytics, technology, and risk owners to use existing operational, financial, customer, technology, and compliance data to strengthen risk insight and reduce manual reporting.
  • Identify measurement gaps and recommend priorities for improved data, analytics, monitoring, or methodology.

Second-Line Governance and Oversight

  • Operate the enterprise risk governance model and supporting routines established by ERM leadership.
  • Provide independent second-line oversight and constructive challenge regarding the quality, completeness, consistency, and timeliness of risk identification, assessment, response, monitoring, and escalation.
  • Maintain and continuously improve the enterprise risk taxonomy and related classification standards to support consistent risk aggregation and reporting.
  • Establish and administer governance processes, committee support, decision rights, escalation pathways, and accountability mechanisms for the assigned portfolio.
  • Clarify and reinforce first-line ownership of risk and second-line responsibilities for oversight, challenge, aggregation, and reporting.
  • Monitor adherence to applicable ERM policies, standards, and governance expectations; identify material gaps and elevate significant issues through established channels.
  • Partner with risk stripe and functional leaders to improve alignment across risk programs without displacing their subject-matter ownership.

Enterprise Risk Reporting and Decision Support

  • Lead the development and production of enterprise risk reporting, dashboards, analyses, and materials for executive leadership and governance committees.
  • Develop clear risk narratives that explain exposure, trend, concentration, interdependency, emerging risk, response status, and changes in enterprise risk posture.
  • Integrate quantitative and qualitative information into decision-ready views that support prioritization, resource allocation, and strategic and operational decisions.
  • Establish reporting standards, data definitions, quality checks, and repeatable production processes that improve consistency and confidence in enterprise risk information.
  • Coordinate with the Vice President, Enterprise Risk Management on executive and Board-level messaging, significant escalations, and interpretation of enterprise risk posture.
  • Partner with analytics and technology teams to automate data collection, monitoring, workflow, and reporting where practical.

Program Leadership and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead execution of assigned ERM transformation priorities and convert strategic direction into sustainable operating capabilities.
  • Maintain policies, procedures, methodologies, standards, and guidance supporting risk measurement, governance, and reporting.
  • Support enterprise risk assessments and the development of governance and measurement capabilities for emerging and evolving risks.
  • Advise business and functional leaders on applying ERM standards in a practical, proportionate, and business-focused manner.
  • Lead, coach, and develop team members responsible for governance administration, risk measurement, analytics, reporting, and program support.
  • Promote risk-informed decision making through stakeholder engagement, training, consultation, and clear communication.

Decision Rights and Role Boundaries

  • Owns the design and operation of assigned ERM measurement, governance, and reporting processes within the strategy, risk appetite, policy framework, and priorities established by Enterprise Risk Management.
  • Sets working standards, methods, reporting requirements, and operating routines for the assigned portfolio, subject to established approval authorities.
  • Provides second-line review, challenge, and escalation, but does not assume first-line ownership of business risks, controls, remediation, or operating decisions.
  • Recommends material methodology, taxonomy, risk appetite, governance, and reporting changes to the Vice President, Enterprise Risk Management for approval or broader governance action.
  • Coordinates executive and Board-facing content with the Vice President, Enterprise Risk Management and other accountable leaders.

Measures of Success

  • Enterprise leaders receive timely, concise, and decision-useful risk reporting that clearly communicates changes in exposure and required action.
  • Risk assessments, indicators, thresholds, and reporting use consistent definitions and methods across the enterprise.
  • Material risk issues and changes in risk posture are identified, challenged, and escalated through established governance channels.
  • Risk appetite is translated into measurable monitoring practices that support clear accountability and informed decisions.
  • Risk data and reporting processes become more reliable, repeatable, efficient, and increasingly automated.
  • First-line risk owners understand and fulfill their responsibilities, while second-line oversight remains independent, credible, and proportionate.
  • ERM governance and measurement practices demonstrate practical business value without creating unnecessary process burden.
  • The team builds durable capabilities, clear documentation, and effective partnerships across risk and business functions.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree.

  • Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in enterprise risk management, operational risk, governance, risk measurement, risk reporting, compliance, internal audit, analytics, finance, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing teams, enterprise programs, or cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience designing or operating risk measurement, risk appetite, governance, reporting, or risk analytics capabilities in a complex organization.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise risk management frameworks, the three lines model, governance practices, risk assessment methods, and executive reporting.
  • Experience developing key risk indicators, thresholds, dashboards, risk narratives, and management reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex risk and data concepts into clear, actionable business insights.
  • Strong judgment, stakeholder management, influence, facilitation, written communication, and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to balance effective oversight and challenge with practicality, proportionality, and business value.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated and complex industry.
  • Experience partnering with Finance, actuarial, analytics, technology, compliance, audit, or business teams on enterprise risk measurement and reporting.
  • Working knowledge of capital, financial, operational, strategic, technology, third-party, and resilience risk concepts; deep actuarial specialization is not required.
  • Experience modernizing risk data, workflow, dashboarding, or reporting capabilities.
  • Advanced degree or relevant professional certification in risk, finance, audit, analytics, or a related field.

Leadership Profile

A pragmatic enterprise leader who can build structure from ambiguity, establish credible second-line challenge, and convert complex risk information into clear decisions. The successful candidate combines strong governance discipline with an operator’s mindset, works effectively through influence, and understands when to standardize, when to tailor, and when to escalate.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$168,000 - $231,000 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About Us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it.
