The Internal Audit Compliance Manager leads and performs risk-based internal audit activities focused on regulatory compliance across the Bank. The position develops and executes the compliance portion of the annual internal audit plan, evaluates the design and effectiveness of compliance controls and adherence to banking laws and regulations, and provides independent assurance on the management of compliance risk. The Manager applies professional judgment and subject matter expertise to oversee compliance audit engagements, evaluate complex regulatory requirements, identify control weaknesses and emerging risks, and develop practical recommendations. The position collaborates with Internal Audit leadership, the Compliance Department, business units, co-sourced providers, external auditors, and regulatory examiners while maintaining the independence and objectivity of the internal audit function.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Audit Planning and Risk Assessment

  • Develop and maintain the risk-based compliance portion of the annual internal audit plan, coordinating with Internal Audit leadership and considering relevant work performed by Compliance, Risk Management, external auditors, regulators, and other assurance providers.
  • Assess compliance risks associated with the Bank’s products, services, operations, systems, and regulatory obligations.
  • Ensure appropriate audit coverage of key compliance areas, including BSA/AML, OFAC, consumer lending and deposit regulations, fair lending, and the Community Reinvestment Act.
  • Update audit coverage and priorities in response to state and federal regulatory changes, emerging risks, examination results, and changes in the Bank’s business activities.

Audit Execution and Oversight

  • Lead, plan, perform, and oversee compliance-focused audit engagements in accordance with the approved audit plan, established audit procedures, applicable professional standards, and Internal Audit methodology, ensuring timely completion.
  • Define audit objectives, scope, testing strategies, resource requirements, and engagement timelines based on the assessed level of risk.
  • Conduct and oversee audit fieldwork through interviews, document reviews, transaction testing, process walkthroughs, and data analysis.
  • Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of compliance controls, policies, procedures, monitoring activities, and governance processes.
  • Review workpapers and support documentation to determine whether audit conclusions are accurate, complete, and supported by sufficient evidence.
  • Oversee co-sourced or third-party audit resources engaged to perform specialized compliance audit work.

Regulatory Compliance

  • Evaluate compliance with applicable federal and state banking laws and regulations and related internal policies and procedures and perform or oversee audits of compliance programs and processes, including BSA/AML, consumer protection, fair lending, CRA, and other applicable regulatory areas.
  • Monitor relevant regulatory developments, supervisory guidance, enforcement actions, and industry trends to identify potential audit implications, and assess their potential effect on the Bank’s control environment and internal audit coverage.
  • Communicate significant compliance risks, control deficiencies, or regulatory concerns to Internal Audit leadership and other appropriate stakeholders.
  • Reporting and Communication Prepare and review audit reports and executive summaries that clearly communicate audit objectives, scope, observations, risks, recommendations, and conclusions.
  • Present significant audit results, emerging risks, and remediation status to senior management and the Audit Committee, as requested, and communicate significant issues promptly to Internal Audit leadership and relevant stakeholders to support timely decision-making.
  • Discuss audit observations with management, evaluate management responses, and obtain appropriate corrective action plans.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and well-organized audit documentation that supports audit conclusions and reporting. Issue Management and Follow-Up

  • Collaborate with the Compliance Department, Risk Management, Legal, Operations, and other business areas while preserving Internal Audit independence

  • Coordinate with external auditors and regulatory examiners during compliance audits and examinations, as assigned.
  • Promote constructive working relationships and clear communication across all levels of the Bank.

  • Identify opportunities to improve audit methodology, documentation quality, engagement efficiency, and the use of data analytics, and support the consistent application of Internal Audit standards, procedures, quality expectations, and approved technology.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

The Opportunity:

JOB SUMMARY

By embodying our core purpose of customer obsession, new ideas, and driving innovation, you will help ensure that every touchpoint is meaningful and contributes to our mission of redefining the possible in healthcare.


As a Senior Platform Engineer, you are a hands-on technical engineer who sits at the intersection of data engineering, cloud platform, and networking — building the infrastructure and pipelines that make Ensemble's data platform reliable, secure, and scalable. You will design and implement Azure-based platform solutions, author data pipelines, harden network architecture, and apply solid software engineering discipline across everything you ship.


This is primarily a delivery role. You will spend the majority of your time writing code, configuring infrastructure, reviewing pull requests, and solving hard operational problems — not managing people or setting org-wide strategy. You bring strong opinions about platform reliability, cloud cost, and network security, and you translate those opinions into running systems.


We are open to strong cloud/platform engineers who want to go deep on data, and to strong data engineers who have grown into platform and networking responsibility. What matters is that you have done hard, hands-on work at the intersection of these disciplines — you understand both why a pipeline fails and why a Private Endpoint DNS record is wrong, and you are comfortable owning both.


JOB COMPETENCIES

Platform & Cloud Engineering — Designs, builds, and operates Azure-based platform infrastructure — compute, storage, networking, identity, and security — with a bias toward infrastructure as code, repeatability, and operational simplicity; balances speed of delivery with platform reliability and cost efficiency.

Data Engineering Depth — Delivers scalable, well-tested data pipelines and transformations on Databricks and Azure Data Factory; applies sound data modeling, performance tuning, and data quality discipline as standard practice rather than afterthoughts.

Network & Security Awareness — Understands Azure networking constructs — VNets, subnets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, DNS, and ExpressRoute/VPN — and applies them correctly in platform design; proactively identifies and closes network attack surface without creating unnecessary friction for engineering teams.

Software Engineering Craft — Writes clean, testable, maintainable code; participates actively in code and design reviews; treats CI/CD and automated testing as the default way of working; holds a high bar for version control hygiene and deployment safety.

Operational Ownership — Takes end-to-end accountability for the platform components and pipelines in scope — from initial design through production monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement; does not hand off and walk away.

Technical Communication — Communicates clearly with both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders; can explain complex networking or data platform trade-offs to a product manager or a VP without losing the audience or oversimplifying the substance.

Continuous Learning & AI Fluency — Stays current with the Azure, Databricks, and data engineering ecosystem; consistently applies generative AI tools to accelerate engineering work, improve code quality, and troubleshoot complex systems.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Customer Obsession, New Ideas, Striving for Excellence

  • Consistently deliver high-quality platform and data solutions that improve the reliability, speed, and accuracy of data reaching internal and external stakeholders.
  • Apply generative AI tools in day-to-day engineering work to accelerate development, improve code quality, troubleshoot complex systems, and design scalable solutions.

Data Pipeline & Platform Engineering

  • Design, build, test, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve scalable data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Apache Spark, and Python.
  • Implement Delta Lake patterns on Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) including table design, schema evolution, Z-ordering, VACUUM, and partition strategies.
  • Build and maintain event-driven integrations using Azure Service Bus, Event Hub, and Azure Functions to support real-time and near-real-time data flows.
  • Implement data quality monitoring frameworks — row counts, schema validation, null checks, freshness SLAs — as first-class pipeline components.
  • Develop reusable pipeline templates and platform abstractions that accelerate delivery across the data engineering team.
  • Translate product and business requirements into incremental, testable technical deliverables with clear acceptance criteria.

Azure Cloud Platform & Infrastructure

  • Provision and manage Azure infrastructure using infrastructure as code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates), treating all platform configuration as version-controlled code.
  • Design and operate Azure-native services including Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Microsoft Fabric (or Synapse), Azure Key Vault, and Azure Monitor.
  • Manage identity and access controls using Azure Active Directory, Managed Identities, RBAC, and Unity Catalog — applying least-privilege principles across all platform components.
  • Implement platform-level observability: pipeline SLAs, workload performance dashboards, alerting, and cost tracking via Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Databricks system tables.
  • Contribute to FinOps practices by monitoring compute costs, right-sizing clusters, configuring auto-termination policies, and flagging cost anomalies.
  • Support containerized workloads running on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) where data platform components require container-based deployment patterns.

Networking & Security

  • Design and implement secure Azure networking architectures for data platform workloads — VNets, subnets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Private DNS Zones, and service endpoints — eliminating unnecessary public internet exposure for PaaS services.
  • Configure, troubleshoot, and document Private Link connectivity across Azure PaaS services (ADLS, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Event Hub, Databricks); diagnose DNS resolution issues and routing problems end-to-end.
  • Apply encryption-in-transit and encryption-at-rest standards; maintain TLS configurations, key rotation policies, and secret management practices in line with security baselines; participate in security reviews and threat modeling for new platform components.
  • Partner with Cloud and Infrastructure teams on hub-and-spoke or landing zone network topologies; configure and validate firewall rules and IP allowlisting in a way that balances security posture with engineering team productivity.

CI/CD, DevOps & Engineering Standards

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps that automate testing, validation, and deployment of data pipelines, notebooks, and infrastructure code.
  • Follow and actively contribute to branching strategies, pull request standards, and code review practices; flag gaps or inconsistencies in existing workflows and propose improvements.
  • Write unit, integration, and data quality tests as standard deliverables — not optional additions after the feature is shipped.
  • Contribute to engineering standards and pattern libraries, ensuring consistency across pipelines and reducing onboarding friction for new team members.

Software Engineering & Architecture

  • Write well-structured, maintainable Python and SQL code; apply design patterns, modular decomposition, and API design principles appropriate to the problem at hand.
  • Participate in design sessions and architecture discussions, contributing hands-on perspective on what is feasible and what the operational implications of design choices will be.
  • Conduct thorough code and design reviews that raise the engineering bar across the team.
  • Identify and address technical debt within owned platform components in a planned, incremental way.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Partner with data engineering, analytics, data science, and cloud/infrastructure peers to deliver integrated platform solutions.
  • Provide mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance.
  • Communicate platform capabilities, limitations, and trade-offs clearly to product and business stakeholders.

EMPLOYMENT QUALIFICATIONS

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of hands-on engineering experience, with meaningful time spent across data engineering and cloud platform or infrastructure domains.
  • 3+ years working with Microsoft Azure services in a production environment (ADF, ADLS Gen2, Databricks, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Hub, Azure Monitor).
  • 2+ years of hands-on Azure networking experience: VNets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Private DNS, service endpoints, and firewall configurations.
  • 2+ years developing with Apache Spark and Databricks, including Delta Lake table design, schema evolution, and performance optimization.
  • 4+ years of production SQL development — complex transformations, query tuning, indexing, and data modeling at enterprise scale.
  • Strong Python development skills applied to data engineering, pipeline orchestration, or platform tooling.
  • Demonstrated experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred; Bicep or ARM acceptable).
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps; familiarity with trunk-based development and pull request workflows.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures using Azure Service Bus, Event Hub, or equivalent messaging platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Azure identity and access management: Azure AD, Managed Identities, RBAC, and Key Vault.
  • Strong understanding of engineering fundamentals: automated testing, code reviews, telemetry, iterative delivery, and DevOps.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with data platform security and governance: Unity Catalog, column-level security, data masking, and audit logging.
  • Background in software engineering (APIs, microservices, or distributed systems) that informs platform design and operationalization decisions.
  • Experience with polyglot storage architectures: relational, columnar (Parquet/Delta), key-value, or graph systems.
  • Exposure to healthcare datasets; familiarity with HL7 or EDI standards is a plus.
  • Experience supporting AI/ML or advanced analytics workloads — feature stores, training data pipelines, or model serving infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with AKS, container networking, and Kubernetes-based workload deployment patterns.
  • Azure certifications relevant to the role (e.g., AZ-305, DP-203, AZ-700) are a plus, but not a substitute for demonstrated hands-on experience.
  • Familiarity with FinOps practices, Databricks cost management, and Azure cost optimization tooling.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.


WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Remote-friendly with periodic travel for team meetings, onsite collaboration, or client engagements.
  • General office environment or work from home.

  • This position pays between $101,600 – $152,400 based on experience

We are:

Accenture Supply Chain & Operations practice who specializes at the intersection of functional consulting, data, & technology. Our Fortune 500 clients all the way through private equity-backed portfolio companies need big-picture change, so we come at their challenges from all sides with functional insights, data power, digital leadership, and extensive industry know-how. It’s our job to show clients how to take major leaps forward in planning, procurement, manufacturing, fulfillment, and service while becoming more sustainable and resilient. How do we do it? We call out the most important metrics. We cut costs, optimize capital, improve response times and consider ESG values. We connect suppliers and customers across the extended supply chain. And we create strategies and operating models that really work.

You are:

A Supply Chain and Operations professional who helps clients in implementing & optimizing the end-to-end planning process across supply chain and operations, ensuring alignment with business objectives, and driving efficiency. You will work with clients in leading & implementing Sales & Operations planning, demand planning, supply planning, production scheduling, and inventory management capabilities to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery of products.

As part of the working with the clients, you lead & advise several aspects of integrated planning including:

  • Integrated Planning Strategy: Develop and implement integrated planning strategies for clients that align with organizational goals, ensuring the optimal flow of goods and services from suppliers to customers.
  • S&OP: Lead S&OP planning including S&OP cycle of demand review, supply review, pre-Exec & Exec S&OP reviews.
  • Demand and Supply Planning: Develop Demand and supply planning processes for clients, including forecasting, production planning, procurement, and inventory management to balance supply with demand while meeting service level targets.
  • S&OE: Enable strategic and tactical plans developed during the S&OP process and ensuring they are implemented smoothly across the supply chain. This includes ensuring production schedules, inventory management, order fulfillment, and logistics are aligned with business demand.
  • Inventory Optimization: Develop inventory management strategies, ensuring optimal inventory levels across locations while reducing excess stock, stockouts, and working capital investment.
  • Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline operations, improve forecasting accuracy, and reduce lead times. Implement best practices and new technologies for enhanced planning and operations efficiency.
  • Performance Management: Identify and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for supply chain performance, including on-time delivery, inventory turnover, and order accuracy. Develop action plans to address performance gaps
  • Operating Model: Develop governance & operating model across sales, marketing, production, and logistics to integrate business needs and strategies into the planning processes.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Regularly communicate with internal stakeholders (e.g., executive team, sales, finance) to provide updates on planning performance and to ensure alignment on goals.
  • Risk Management: Proactively identify potential supply chain risks (e.g., disruptions, supplier issues) and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impact on business operations.
  • Reporting & Analytics: Provide insights into supply chain performance through data analysis and reporting, helping senior management make informed decisions on operational strategies.

The work:

  • Find solutions to clients’ supply chain and operations integrated planning related challenges
  • Advocate leading practices, policies & procedures for integrated planning
  • Spot and solve challenges using your analytical & strategy skills to dive into data and compare vs. industry peers
  • Lead workshops that look for ways to improve organizations and processes

jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. At NVIDIA, as a Principal Rack Scale Systems Infrastructure Engineer, you will build and guide the development of software systems. These systems support our upcoming rack-scale infrastructure products and services. This exceptional role sits where software meets hardware. You will work on control planes, state machines, orchestration systems, firmware, OS lifecycle, and networking fabrics. Your task is to compose infrastructure-as-a-service control plane software that converts complex rack-scale hardware into dependable, manageable, and programmable infrastructure for NVIDIA, partners, and leading cloud and enterprise clients globally.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Define the complete software architecture for rack-scale infrastructure products and services, covering control plane services, infrastructure management, firmware, operating systems, kernel drivers, networking fabrics, accelerator software, and user-mode manageability software.

  • Use Kubernetes and cloud-native primitives as an infrastructure fabric when appropriate. This includes controllers, operators, reconciliation loops, and open source components. These components can operate safely at rack and fleet scale. Build open source infrastructure software that can be embraced in different forms, including libraries, services, controllers, operators, and integration APIs for internal deployments and CSP environments.

  • Bridge hardware and software teams across firmware, BMC, BIOS, boot flows, OS images, drivers, networking, NVLink domains, InfiniBand, GPUs, DPUs, CPUs, and system management interfaces. Translate forward-looking infrastructure roadmaps into formal software requirements, architecture specifications, and execution plans that align teams across the organization.

  • Partner directly with hyperscalers, CSPs, enterprise customers, internal component leads, vendors, and business partners to align infrastructure capabilities with real-world deployment and integration needs. Establish reliability, security, validation, and left-shift strategies that reduce risk before hardware reaches production environments.

  • Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, raising the engineering bar for large-scale networked systems, foundational software, and rack-scale control plane development.

  • Make high-quality technical decisions in ambiguous environments, balancing customer needs, schedule, hardware realities, software maintainability, open source adoption, and long-term infrastructure evolution.

What We Need To See:

  • BS or MS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Proven experience (15+ years) in systems architecture, system software, distributed systems, infrastructure control planes, or infrastructure engineering.

  • Solid architectural knowledge of coordination frameworks, state machines, declarative APIs, reconciliation loops, lifecycle orchestration, failure handling, upgrade and rollback workflows, and distributed systems tradeoffs.

  • Practical coding skills in Go, C++, or Rust, encompassing the capability to write, review, and direct production-quality infrastructure software. Experience with Rust is highly valued.

  • Experience with Kubernetes or similar orchestration systems, especially as a fabric for managing infrastructure, hardware resources, or large-scale infrastructure services. Experience with Linux-based infrastructure software, OS rollout and image management, kernel or driver interactions, firmware lifecycle, and hardware bring-up workflows.

  • Strong understanding of data center networking technologies and protocols, such as Ethernet, InfiniBand, RDMA, and fabric-level manageability. Experience with complex accelerator-based systems, including GPUs, DPUs, FPGAs, custom silicon, or other high-performance computing systems.

  • Expertise in in-band and out-of-band management architectures, including BMCs, Redfish, IPMI, and related system management protocols. Ability to work with security experts to define practical tradeoffs across secure boot, attestation, access control, update safety, serviceability, and ease of operation.

  • Experience crafting software intended for open source release, including API stability, modularity, documentation, community usability, and clean separation between shared software and deployment-specific integrations.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools responsibly as an engineering multiplier for coding, test generation, debugging, build iteration, and documentation.

  • Established skill in specifying requirements, guiding architecture, and managing delivery across various engineering teams and organizations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, enabling clear explanation of complex hardware/software tradeoffs to engineering leaders, customers, partners, and executives.

Ways To Stand Out from the crowd:

  • Built software supporting multiple adoption models — internal services, CSP-integrated offerings, reusable libraries, and customer-extensible APIs. Strong Rust skills in systems, infrastructure, or hardware-adjacent software.

  • Multiplied team impact through reference implementations, design reviews, shared libraries, architecture docs, dev workflows, and AI-assisted engineering. Hands-on with fleet-scale provisioning, updates, rollback, observability, health, and remediation.

  • Led across the full data center product lifecycle: inception, pre- and post-silicon, manufacturing, deployment, and operations. Familiar with open source ecosystems, contribution models, and balancing community collaboration with product needs.

  • Deep experience with rack- or cluster-scale systems spanning compute, networking, storage, accelerators, firmware, and infra management as one operational domain. Skilled at finding simple, durable abstractions in complex systems to align teams, customers, and long-term direction.

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

  • Responsible for site management oversight, clinical monitoring and central monitoring deliverables with a focus on patient safety, protocol/GCP/regulatory compliance and data integrity.
  • Oversees site interactions post activation through site closeout. This may include patient recruitment, investigator payments or other related activities.
  • May be responsible for identification of critical data and process, protocol execution risks and risk mitigations related to completion of the Risk Assessment and Categorization Tool (RACT).
  • Reviews the study scope of work, budget and protocol content and ensures the clinical project team (CRAs/Central Monitors) is aware of the contractual obligations and parameters.
  • Uses prior clinical experience, operational data, metrics and reports to identify risks to clinical trial management deliverables.
  • Escalates to the project manager any risks to clinical trial management deliverables (timeline, quality and budget) and any activities and requests which are out of contracted scope.
  • Employs strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to propose and implement risk mitigations.
  • Participates and presents in key meetings such as Kick Off Meeting.
  • Serves as an escalation point for communications with investigator site staff and may be required to interact on the phone or in person with principal investigators or other site staff members. This may include accompanying CRA team members to sites for observation or conflict resolution.
  • Collaborates with other functional leaders such as Study Start Up, Patient Recruitment and Data Management to coordinate delivery handoffs and meet expected study milestones such as site activation targets, enrollment targets and database lock timelines. Reviews and provides feedback on other functional plans (e.g. Data Management Plan, Communication Plan) as they relate to the clinical trial management activities.
  • Responsible for development and ongoing maintenance of clinical study tools and templates, including the Clinical Monitoring Plan. Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.
  • Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.
  • Oversees resourcing allocations for CRAs and Central Monitors, site assignments and study team members' conduct, and identifies risks to delivery or quality.
  • Ensures quality of the clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management deliverables within a project and maintain proper visibility of its progress by the use of approved systems and / or tracking tools.
  • Reviews the project oversight dashboards and other clinical trial systems (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Data Capture (EDC), eDiary, Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes (ePROs),Trial Master File (TMF), IVRS/IWRS, Central Monitoring dashboards), to oversee site and patient activities, study team conduct and to ensure the data has been updated to reflect timely execution of all operational aspects (required visits/calls, duration, and frequency) according to plan.
  • Understands the monitoring strategy required for the study and, where required, participates in the development of the study risk assessment plan. Is accountable for their assigned clinical team members' understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP/SMP, and risk plans.
  • Reviews the content and quality of site and central monitoring documentation (site monitoring calls, site visit reports, site letters, central monitoring reports and pertinent correspondence), to ensure they represent site management activities and conduct and that they appropriately convey any risks to protocol/GCP compliance, trial conduct, patient safety or data integrity. Document requested revisions and approvals in CTMS. Ensures these deliverables are provided according to company and/or sponsor specifications, including delivery deadlines.
  • Interacts with the client and other functional departments related to clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management activities and deliverables. Provides status updates on the clinical deliverables and risks to clients, project management and leadership as per departmental or study agreements. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.
  • Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations. This may include data management, study start up, patient recruitment, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance and Quality Assurance (QA). Supports Inspection Readiness for clinical trial management scope.
  • Oversees CRAs and Central Monitors assigned to the study and routinely assesses study-specific process and training compliance, CMP compliance, and identifies emerging risks. May develop and support execution of corrective action plans at site and study level. Supports and completes activities to achieve data cut and lock deadlines.
  • Provides feedback to line managers on staff performance including strengths as well as areas for development. May be assigned to larger,more complex trials.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align teams in the achievement of project milestones
  • Demonstrated capability of working in an international environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in site management and monitoring (clinical or central)
  • Preferred experience with risk-based monitoring
  • Demonstrates understanding of clinical trial management financial principles and budget management
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills
  • Good communication, presentation and interpersonal skills among project team and with sites
  • Strong conflict resolution skills
  • Demonstrated ability to apply problem solving techniques to resolve complex issues, and apply a risk management approach to identifying and mitigating potential threats to the successful conduct of a clinical research project.

The purpose of this position is to assist the Patient Account Supervisor in working with patients and third-party payers regarding payments made to patient visits. The position handles a specific group of accounts (credit balance and requests for refunds) and ensures timely and accurate resolution. This position is responsible for resolving third party payer and patient overpays or requests for refunds. This involves researching insurance benefits, understanding coordination of benefits between payers, distributing/reapplying or transferring payments to the appropriate date of service or account, generating refund requests, overpayment notifications or denying refund request according to guidelines. Accurate and timely resolution of overpays and requests for refunds is based on a knowledge and understanding of contractual obligations as well as regulatory requirements. This position is expected to work alongside staff as well as provide direction to less experienced staff in conjunction with the Patient Account Supervisor.

Essential Job Functions

  • Assists in assigning staff workloads and shifts priorities as necessary.
  • Monitor activities performed by Credit Balance team to make sure that credit balances and requests for refunds are reconciled appropriately and timely.
  • Routinely communicate with payers regarding overpayments, request recoupment, void claims with payer if necessary
  • Conduct timely and accurate review of overpayments, credit balances and request for refunds.
  • Responsible for reviewing, validating, and correcting adjustments on accounts based on insurance reimbursement and coverage, contracted payers and services provided.
  • Validate and update patient demographic and insurance to ensure accuracy of future claims.
  • Initiate refunds to patients/guarantors, insurance companies, and other third parties by following established refund procedures, contractual obligations, payer and regulatory requirements.
  • Utilize on-line/telephonic resources to verify benefits and ensure claims are processed according to the appropriate benefit levels.
  • Assists in the review of refund request for accuracy and submits as necessary
  • Assists in the review of adjustment requests for accuracy and submits as necessary
  • Assists in the development and training of workflow process for staff and as deemed necessary for payer behavior responses
  • Works special projects and provides ad hoc review of claims as assigned by Supervisor/Director/CFO
  • Works closely with CBO intra departments to ensure resolution of pending claim activities.

Other Job Functions

  • Meet position’s goals and objectives related to accuracy and productivity (e.g. days in AR, cash collections, etc.)
  • Attend staff meetings or other company sponsored or mandated meetings as required
  • Perform additional duties as assigned

Basic Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED, required
  • 3+ years relevant experience in a provider inpatient or outpatient setting, required
  • Requires advanced knowledge of claims processing, appeals, medical terminology, accounts receivable, claim forms, claims billing, insurance verification, adjustments and refunds, claims status, and reimbursement
  • 2+ years previous Team Leader/Supervisory experience or equivalent , required
  • Advanced knowledge of all payer insurance groups, including a Medicare, Medicaid and government managed care experience, is required
  • Previous coaching and or training experience and the ability to create training manuals and training tools and materials, preferred
  • Experience with medical records or patient accounting systems, required
  • Knowledge and understanding of state and Federal payment laws to ensure prompt and accurate reimbursement, required
  • Advanced knowledge and understanding of healthcare ‘explanation of benefits’ (EOB’s), required
  • Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office products (Outlook, Excel, Word). Excel experience should include (vlookup/xlookup, pivot tables, basic formulas), required

  • Position requires fluency in English; written and oral communication

ISN is hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to lead AI-first platform work at the intersection of agentic systems and production infrastructure. jobs.excerpt: Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Health Care space is seeking a commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative function across our ecommerce business.
jobs.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Health Care space is seeking a commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative function across our ecommerce business.

This role will own the complete creative direction of the brand across paid advertising, website and landing pages, email, organic social media, marketplaces, product launches, and other customer-facing channels.

The Creative Director will be responsible not only for maintaining a strong and consistent brand identity, but also for improving commercial performance. The primary objective of the role is to develop creative strategies and assets that increase conversion rates, improve advertising performance, strengthen customer engagement, and support profitable growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine creative judgement, customer insight, performance data, and strong team management.

Key Outcomes

Improve Ecommerce Conversion Performance

  • Develop creative strategies that improve conversion across paid media, websites, product pages, marketplaces, and email.
  • Turn customer insights, performance data, and competitor research into clear briefs and testable concepts.
  • Partner with ecommerce teams to improve client acquisition and conversion.
  • Establish a structured process for creative testing and optimisation.

Lead Performance Creative Strategy

  • Own creative strategy across paid social, video, display, and other acquisition channels.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of concepts, hooks, angles, scripts, and formats.
  • Ensure sufficient creative volume and variation for testing and scaling.
  • Use performance data to identify, improve, and scale winning concepts.
  • Balance direct-response effectiveness with strong brand presentation.

Strengthen Website and Product Pages Creatives

  • Lead creative direction across the website, landing pages, collection pages, and product pages.
  • Improve how product benefits, differentiation, use cases, and customer proof are communicated.
  • Create clear visual and messaging hierarchies that make pages more persuasive.
  • Collaborate with ecommerce, UX, development, copywriting, and CRO teams on improvements and testing.
  • Ensure consistency between advertising and onsite customer experience.

Own Brand Creative Across All Channels

  • Maintain a consistent creative direction across paid media, website, email, organic content, marketplaces, packaging, and launches.
  • Develop practical brand guidelines that support quality, consistency, and speed.
  • Ensure creative work reflects the brand's positioning, audience, and commercial goals.
  • Raise the overall standard of design, copy, video, photography, and storytelling.
  • Protect brand consistency while encouraging experimentation.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Creative Team

  • Lead and develop designers, editors, creators, copywriters, freelancers, and agencies.
  • Set clear responsibilities, quality standards, workflows, and performance expectations.
  • Provide constructive feedback and support team development.
  • Manage the balance between internal and external creative resources.
  • Build a culture of accountability, speed, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Improve Creative Operations and Output

  • Build an efficient process from research and briefing through production, approval, launch, and iteration.
  • Establish clear systems for priorities, deadlines, feedback, approvals, and asset management.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with business priorities.
  • Maintain an organised creative asset library.
  • Improve output and efficiency while maintaining quality and brand consistency.
  • Manage creative budgets and external resources effectively.

Lead Product Launch and Campaign Creative

  • Develop creative strategies for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and major events.
  • Translate product positioning into strong customer-facing concepts.
  • Define clear messaging, creative direction, asset requirements, and channel execution.
  • Coordinate creative production across paid media, website, email, marketplaces, and organic content.
  • Review results and apply learnings to future campaigns.

Responsibilities

  • Own the overall creative vision and execution across the ecommerce business.
  • Translate company goals into clear creative priorities and plans.
  • Develop quarterly and monthly creative roadmaps.
  • Lead creative concept development and campaign planning.
  • Review and approve high-priority creative assets.
  • Create clear, actionable briefs for internal and external creative teams.
  • Partner with growth, marketing, ecommerce, product, customer service, and leadership teams.
  • Analyse creative performance using advertising, website, email, and marketplace data.
  • Monitor customer behaviour, category trends, competitors, and emerging creative formats.
  • Present creative strategies, results, challenges, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Ensure the creative team remains focused on work that has the greatest commercial impact.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Website and landing-page conversion rate.
  • Product-page conversion rate.
  • Advertising creative performance.
  • Customer acquisition cost.
  • Return on advertising spend.
  • Click-through rate and hook rate.
  • Creative testing volume and testing velocity.
  • Percentage of creative tests producing meaningful improvements.
  • Revenue generated from new creative concepts.
  • Email engagement and conversion performance.
  • On-time completion of creative projects.
  • Creative production efficiency.
  • Brand consistency and quality across channels.
  • Performance and development of the creative team.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is both creatively ambitious and commercially disciplined. They understand that ecommerce creative must capture attention, communicate value quickly, address customer objections, and motivate action.

They are comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed execution. They can confidently lead a team, evaluate creative work, interpret performance data, and collaborate with commercial stakeholders.

They do not rely solely on personal taste. They use customer insight, brand strategy, testing, and business results to make decisions.

Required Experience

  • Significant experience in a senior creative leadership role within ecommerce, DTC, retail, consumer products, or a performance-focused agency.
  • Demonstrated experience improving conversion and advertising performance through creative strategy.
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce customer journeys, product pages, landing pages, paid social, email, and organic content.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating both brand-building and performance-focused creative work.
  • Experience creating and evaluating direct-response advertising concepts.
  • Ability to interpret creative, advertising, and ecommerce performance data.
  • Strong understanding of design, copywriting, video, photography, content production, and visual storytelling.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and production partners.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and feedback skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with physical consumer products.
  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Shopify, and email marketing platforms.
  • Experience with conversion-rate optimisation and structured experimentation.
  • Experience producing user-generated content, creator-led advertising, product demonstrations, and testimonial creative.
  • Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, studios, photographers, and creators.
  • Familiarity with creative analytics and project-management tools.
  • Experience scaling an established ecommerce brand across multiple products, markets, or countries.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the Creative Director will have assessed the current brand, creative team, workflows, performance data, customer journey, and existing asset library. They will have identified the largest creative and conversion opportunities and introduced a clear testing and production roadmap.

Within six months, the company should have a stronger creative pipeline, clearer brand direction, faster testing cycles, improved collaboration between creative and growth teams, and measurable improvements in conversion and creative performance.

Within the first year, the Creative Director will have built a scalable creative function that consistently produces high-quality, commercially effective work across every major ecommerce channel.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • A senior leadership role with direct ownership of the company's ecommerce creative direction and growth.
  • High level of autonomy and the opportunity to shape creative strategy, processes, and team development.
  • Direct impact on ecommerce performance, conversion, and creative effectiveness across multiple channels.
  • Opportunity to build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary creative team.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture where creative decisions are connected to business results.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded Creative Director who wants to take ownership of a growing ecommerce creative function, combine creative leadership with performance-driven decision-making, and build a scalable creative operation with a direct impact on business growth.

At Citadel, diversity and inclusion are at the heart of our culture. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds—regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, religion, lifestyle, or disability—and embrace the unique perspectives and experiences they bring. Through teamwork, innovation, and continuous professional development, we empower our employees to thrive and drive progress within the organization.

About the Role

We are seeking a compassionate and highly organized Behavioral Health Case Manager to support patients receiving advanced interventional psychiatric treatments for conditions such as Treatment-Resistant Depression (TRD), PTSD, and OCD. This role serves as a critical liaison between patients, families, providers, and insurance carriers to ensure seamless care coordination, treatment access, and long-term recovery support.

The ideal candidate is passionate about mental health, patient advocacy, and delivering exceptional care throughout the treatment journey.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Intake, Screening & Care Coordination

  • Conduct initial psychosocial and clinical intake assessments to evaluate patient eligibility and readiness for advanced interventional treatments.
  • Educate patients and families regarding treatment processes, timelines, safety protocols, potential side effects, and expected outcomes.
  • Coordinate appointments and treatment schedules with psychiatrists, nurse practitioners, nursing staff, and other multidisciplinary team members.
  • Maintain accurate patient records and ensure timely documentation within the electronic health record (EHR) system.

Care Pathway Management & Patient Support

  • Develop, monitor, and adjust individualized care plans for patients undergoing interventional psychiatric treatment.
  • Conduct regular patient follow-ups to assess treatment progress, identify barriers to care, and promote adherence.
  • Utilize standardized clinical assessment tools, including PHQ-9, GAD-7, and other outcome measures.
  • Provide crisis intervention, safety planning, and appropriate escalation for patients experiencing acute psychiatric distress.
  • Collaborate with clinical providers to address emerging patient needs and treatment concerns.

Utilization Review & Insurance Advocacy

  • Prepare and submit clinical documentation required for prior authorizations and insurance approvals.
  • Coordinate utilization review activities and communicate directly with insurance carriers regarding coverage determinations.
  • Manage appeals for denied services by gathering supporting clinical information and advocating for patient access to care.
  • Assist patients in identifying financial assistance programs, manufacturer support programs, and community-based resources.

Transition & Discharge Planning

  • Develop comprehensive discharge and aftercare plans following completion of intensive treatment programs.
  • Coordinate continuity of care with community psychiatrists, therapists, primary care providers, and support services.
  • Facilitate access to ongoing mental health resources aimed at reducing relapse risk and promoting sustained recovery.

Qualifications

Education

Description

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This position reports to the Senior Supervisor of Call Center Operations. The Real Time Analyst is responsible for the successful intra-day monitoring of all Call Center Representatives. This includes the effective management, of the Call Center Representative’s schedules, queues, systems and offline operation support; with a focus on maintaining service levels across all lines of businesses and creating reports as needed.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Call Center Operations

  • Monitor real-time contact center activity, including call volumes, staffing, and service levels, to identify areas for improvement and make timely adjustments.
  • Manage staffing levels dynamically to maintain optimal service levels and meet performance targets.
  • Monitor key metrics such as service levels, average speed of answer (ASA), schedule adherence, average handle time (AHT), and after-call work (ACW), ensuring compliance with defined thresholds.
  • Perform real-time queue management, including agent assignments and skill adjustments, based on established protocols.
  • Coordinate and manage short-term or same-day off-line events for call center agents, ensuring minimal impact on call center performance.
  • Monitor the Attendance Line and update schedules accordingly.
  • Communicate proactively with agents and supervisors via instant messaging to ensure adherence to schedules, resolve real-time issues, and provide timely feedback.
  • Escalate operational issues when necessary to minimize service disruption.
  • Maintain a detailed daily log of actions taken to optimize service levels (e.g., re-skilling agents, reallocating calls, adjusting schedules, initiating or cancelling events).
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with other departments to ensure seamless coordination of workforce management activities.
  • Continuously assess and enhance real-time workforce management processes for improved efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Complete reporting or ad hoc analytics as needed.
  • Provides first-level technical support and creates IT support tickets for timely resolution.

Process Improvement

  • Partners with WFM Analyst to manage and implement response plan to ensure schedule adherence, respond to unplanned call outs, and handle staffing time variances.

  • Partners with WFM Analyst forecasting and scheduling team to plan for and understand upcoming anticipated events. Also actively participates in post-event analysis and improvement planning.

Other

Do everything possible to help members succeed by being curious and striving to understand what others are trying to achieve, planning and executing work in a helpful and collaborative manner, being willing to adjust efforts to ensure that work and attitude are helpful to others, being self-accountable, creating positive impact, and being diligent in delivering results.

  • Ability to learn and adapt to current WFM tools.

Meta Description:Register your interest in advising SME CEOs through Rutherford International’s Enterprise Advisory Board programme. Share your leadership and specialist expertise.

Enterprise Advisory Board — Remunerated Adviser
Evergreen Expression of Interest — Rutherford Talent Guild™
Canada · United States · United Kingdom

Owner-managed and founder-led businesses regularly face decisions that stretch the experience available within their teams: entering a new market, securing financing, planning succession or transforming operations.

Rutherford International welcomes expressions of interest from experienced professionals who can provide relevant expertise, practical perspective and candid, independent challenge to an SME owner or CEO.

This is an Evergreen Expression of Interest, not an advertisement for a current vacancy or advisory appointment.

Who should register
  • Executives, former business owners and senior specialists with demonstrated expertise in growth, financing, operations, technology, people, succession or transformation.
  • Professionals who can adapt their experience to the resources and operating realities of an owner-managed business.
  • Experienced advisers interested in serving individually or within a small advisory group.
  • Professionals with the experience to chair an advisory group and encourage productive discussion.

Professionals based in Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom may register.

The adviser’s contribution

Depending on the mandate, advisers may help an owner or CEO examine strategic and operational decisions by:

  • Understanding the business, its objectives and constraints before offering recommendations.
  • Testing assumptions and identifying practical alternatives.
  • Explaining the evidence, trade-offs and limitations behind their advice.
  • Challenging candidly and respectfully while leaving decisions with the authorised decision-maker.
  • Preparing thoroughly for meetings and following through on agreed contributions.
  • Maintaining confidentiality and declaring potential conflicts of interest.
  • Working constructively with other advisers while allowing differing views to be heard.

Advisory appointments provide non-binding recommendations. They do not, by themselves, confer the authority of a statutory director or responsibility for managing the business.

Relevant experience and qualities

There is no single career route into this role. We look for specific examples of sound judgement, useful advice and contribution to consequential business decisions.

A senior title alone is insufficient. Relevant experience must translate into practical advice suited to the enterprise’s circumstances.

Qualities we value include clear thinking and communication, independent judgement, candour delivered with tact, reliable preparation, openness to contrary evidence and an understanding of the limits of one’s expertise.

Applicants interested in chairing an advisory group should also demonstrate the ability to set focused agendas, balance participation and manage disagreement.

Remuneration

The enterprise pays appointed advisers for their agreed contribution.Remuneration is established for each mandate according to expertise, preparation, time commitment and responsibilities. Arrangements may include retainers, meeting fees or time-based fees.

Advisers do not pay to occupy an advisory seat. This differs from the separate CEO Peer Advisory / Mastermind programme, where members pay to participate.

Registration and consideration

Select“I’m interested”to submit your résumé and professional information through Rutherford International’s Talent Registration form.

Following initial review, a curator may invite you to provide further information and undertake the RutherfordINTEL Assessment. Assessment findings are considered alongside your experience, achievements, objectives and suitability for particular mandates.

Registration is not admission. Progression and membership remain subject to curator review.

Registering does not guarantee membership, representation, an introduction or an advisory appointment.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

The Motorola Solutions Glasgow software development centre is the leading developer of mobile workflow solutions for MSI Software Enterprise. We are developing CC Responder, a new handheld solution running on Android, iOS and Windows that provides record management, search and Command & Control capability integrating through the Azure Cloud Platform.

The CC Responder Cloud services team are developing a number of microservices to run on the MSI Software Enterprise Azure Cloud Platform that will enable the CC Responder mobile applications. These microservices are typically written in Java and run in Docker containers, making use of Azure platform services such as Cosmos DB and Azure Service Bus.


Job Description

This role is primarily remote, however, there would be a benefit to be located closer to the Glasgow area.


You will work as part of the CC Responder Cloud services team developing cloud-based microservices for CC Responder. As a Software Engineer in an agile Scrum team you will be involved in:

  • Working on the full software development life cycle for the new services - including design, development, testing, and documentation.
  • Working with other teams across Motorola Solutions to integrate CC Responder microservices with other Motorola Solutions software components, creating a richer, more powerful integrated solution.
  • Continuing to support our existing customers, adapting the product to meet their evolving needs.


Basic Requirements

Basic Requirements


The Software Engineer will have the following skills & experience:

  • A formal qualification (Degree) in Computing Science or equivalent experience with a high level of academic achievement.
  • Experience developing server-side Java applications.
  • Good communication skills.

Desired Requirements


Ideally the Software Engineer will also have the following skills & experience:

  • Java SpringBoot, Kubernetes, Python and BDD testing frameworks.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Azure or similar cloud technologies.

In return for your expertise, we’ll support you in this new challenge with coaching & development every step of the way. Also, to reward your hard work you’ll get:

  • Competitive salary and bonus schemes.
  • Two weeks additional pay per year (holiday bonus).
  • 25 days holiday entitlement + bank holidays.
  • Attractive defined contribution pension scheme.
  • Employee stock purchase plan.
  • Flexible working options.
  • Private medical care.
  • Life assurance.
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay.
  • Career development support and wide ranging learning opportunities.
  • Employee health and wellbeing support EAP, wellbeing guidance etc.
  • Carbon neutral initiatives/goals.
  • Corporate social responsibility initiatives including support for volunteering days.
  • Well known companies discount scheme.

None

None

Experienced

Yes

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

The Team

Chronosphere, a Palo Alto Networks company, is the observability platform built for control in the modern, containerized world. Chronosphere empowers customers to focus on the data and insights that matter by reducing complexity, optimizing costs, and remediating issues faster. Chronosphere reduces data volumes and associated costs by 84% on average while saving developers thousands of hours. Recognized as a leader by major analyst firms, Chronosphere is trusted by the world's most innovative brands, including DoorDash, Affirm, and Zillow.

Job Summary

The #1 reason organizations invest in an observability tool is to know when something is broken so they can fix it. This has been the case for over 25 years. The Alerting Platform & Workflows team focuses on providing a reliable, fast and intuitive experience for configuring, receiving, and responding to alerts.

Our users—software developers—need to troubleshoot issues that impact their own users. We build products that help suggest possible next steps to investigate, narrow down possibilities, and quickly root–cause issues. We are seeking experienced engineers who can craft intuitive, fast, and reliable user experiences empowering software engineers to diagnose and resolve incidents with confidence.

Qualifications

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and ship enhancements and new features to core product capabilities using Go, deployed on Kubernetes across cloud platforms such as AWS and GCP

  • Design, implement, and deliver complex product features that address key customer pain points, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams—including product management, design, and engineering—to ensure alignment and impact throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Work closely with talented engineers in a fast-paced environment that fosters accelerated learning, continuous growth, and career development

  • Think beyond implementation—challenge assumptions, refine designs based on user feedback, and take ownership of delivering polished, effective user experiences.

  • Lead development of user experiences that surface critical insights at a glance, streamline troubleshooting, and reduce cognitive load during high-pressure situations.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to turn complex data into actionable, easy-to-understand visualizations and workflows.

  • Share accountability with other engineers across the company to build and maintain automated tests, tooling, and deployment infrastructure that improve efficiency.

  • Mentor your colleagues in engineering reliable, performant, high-quality user experiences through direct mentorship, program development, and engineering infrastructure improvements.

Required Qualifications

  • The ability to own projects from inception to delivery either independently or as a technical leader of a small team, all while collaborating with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers.

  • Experience in working with large scale distributed systems

  • A passion for solving complex problems and ability to empathize with customers

  • The curiosity and motivation to learn deep complex domain areas

  • The habit to seek feedback to improve your work and the ability to ask for help when you need it

  • A flexible, collaborative working style. We’re a small team working in a rapidly evolving space, and we’re looking for people that will help build a positive, supportive environment

  • Fluency in a system level language such as Go, C++, Java, C#, or Rust. Knowing a specific language isn’t important; what matters is that you’ve become fluent in one by spending a lot of time on the types of projects where these languages are used

jobs.description:
WHO IS RATEHUB?

We’re a company on a mission. We are a unique Canadian Fintech that is the one-stop shop for all financial needs of the consumer: Save, Spend, Borrow, Invest, and Protect. Every single team member — from Product & Engineering to Sales & Marketing, Finance, Operations, and everything in between — is obsessed with one thing: helping Canadians make better financial choices. And we’re pretty great at it, too. Via our digital application technology and our award-winning in-house brokerages, we help over 2M Canadians per month make a positive impact on their finances. We have many unique businesses: a mortgage brokerage, a life insurance brokerage, a home and auto insurance brokerage, a mortgage originations and servicing business, a Financial Services Marketplace, and a content business across Ratehub and MoneySense. 365 days a year, we deliver our users the best online mortgage experience, personalized credit card and loan options, and cheaper auto and home insurance policies than they typically get from their existing financial adviser.

Changing how people make financial choices isn’t easy, though. We know that achieving our mission is full of challenges — challenges that can be complex and often unexpected but that are always interesting, rewarding, and fun to solve as a team. This is where you come in. We are on the hunt for the right candidate to join us and help lead us forward to continued growth.

We’re looking for a Senior Accountant to join our growing Finance team. Reporting directly to the Controller, you will be an integral member of the department, working across all Business Units at a moment of evolution and scale for the organisation.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Full cycle accounting including reconciliations, consolidation, and draft financial statements
  • Prepare, monitor, verify, and maintain accounting journals, ledgers, and other financial records.
  • Support the month end and year end close with the preparation and maintenance of working papers
  • Assist with the ongoing development, improvement, and implementation of financial procedures and processes.
  • Assist with year-end audit requirements including preparing annual audit working papers and supporting documents.
  • Support all members of the finance team when ad-hoc opportunities arise

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3+ years of experience in a relevant accounting role required
  • Solid knowledge of, and experience applying, IFRS is required.
  • Accounting designation (CPA or equivalent) or close to CPA designation.
  • Experience completing Canadian corporate income tax, payroll tax, and sales tax returns (experience with SLFI’s is an Asset)
  • Detail oriented - obsessed with accuracy
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Intermediate/Advanced experience with Excel and/or Google Sheets (VLOOKUP’s, nested formula functions, Pivot Tables, Charts)
  • Well organized with ability to prioritize and follow-up; great time-management skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and willingness to work in collaboration with various team members
  • Ability to identify and implement new ways of working, including automating functions, finding scalable solutions, and driving continuous improvement; impact oriented
  • Resourceful, proactive, dependable, and ambitious mindset, willing to challenge the status quo to improve the business and identify solutions as needed; a quick learner with a growth mindset

CULTURE FIT:

Members first - we prioritise the interests and needs of our members above all else.We solve member pain points and focus on member satisfaction. We start with members, and end with the P&L.

Growth mindset - we set ambitious goals and challenge the status quo. We take responsible risks and are accountable for our actions.

Better together - we are One team with One common goal. We make our footprint bigger than our foot, leave our egos at the door, support each other to achieve great results as One company.

Run after problems - we tackle problems head on and focus on finding solutions. Obstacles are seen as opportunities for growth and innovation. We have the hard conversations and choose the harder right over the easier wrong. And we do it with a smile.

Measure Learn Iterate Innovate - we focus on getting things done. We measure what matters, iterate, learn, iterate many times in a data-driven way, which is how we will innovate.

JOB PERKS:

Competitive Compensation: A salary that reflects your experience and the Canadian market.

Remote-First Environment: The flexibility to work from anywhere in Canada, with occasional in-person team gatherings for collaboration.

Flexible Hours: Autonomy to manage your schedule to support work-life balance.

Professional Development: An individual training allowance to help you grow your skills and career.

Team Socials: Regular events, both remote and in-person, to build connections across the organization.

The estimated compensation range for this position, inclusive of a discretionary performance bonus, is $75,000 - $100,000.

jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.


We are hiring a Senior Systems Software Engineer to join our Applied Systems Engineering team and improve storage development in AI systems. This opportunity involves software development, practical experimentation, and systems integration to refine storage on next-generation NVIDIA platforms. You will lead technical analyses, transform workload insights into engineering fixes, and guide the formulation and implementation of storage policies. You will handle storage integration, testing, and rollout while coordinating with engineering groups on hardware and software projects. This role supports the efficiency and dependability encouraged at datacenter scale.


What you'll be doing:

  • Engineer and integrate storage systems for large-scale HPC and AI clusters, including Lustre, NFS, and their interaction with compute nodes, networks, and storage hardware.
  • Examine performance and reliability issues throughout the I/O stack, supervising application behavior across filesystem clients, Linux kernel paths, network protocols, servers, and storage devices.
  • Develop software fixes and performance improvements, working with NVIDIA engineering teams, storage partners, and open-source maintainers to bring changes through review, testing, and deployment.
  • Characterize real application I/O, including training-data access, checkpoint and restart, metadata-intensive operations, and concurrent workloads. Translate findings into improvements to software, and system configuration and design.
  • Build reproducible benchmarks, diagnostic tools, and regression tests that measure efficiency, latency, metadata performance, scalability, and behavior under contention.
  • Lead storage qualification and commissioning, validating functionality, data integrity, failure recovery, and sustained performance at cluster scale.
  • Define and implement storage placement, caching, and data lifecycle policies informed by workload requirements, capacity, and operational evidence.

What we need to see:

  • Deep engineering experience with Lustre, NFS, or comparable shared storage systems, including implementation-level debugging in at least one stack and experience integrating storage into Linux clusters.
  • Strong C programming and Linux debugging skills, with experience reading, modifying, and diagnosing kernel or user-space storage software.
  • Understanding of filesystem and distributed-system behavior, including metadata operations, caching and consistency, locking, concurrency, client/server communication, and recovery.
  • Experience analyzing application access patterns and tuning filesystem or storage-stack behavior to deliver performance improvements.
  • Ability to take a complex performance or correctness problem from initial symptoms through reproduction, root-cause analysis, implementation, and validation.
  • Proficiency in Python and shell scripting to build maintainable diagnostic, test automation, and analysis tools.
  • Ability to independently lead technical efforts, influence design decisions across teams, and communicate findings and tradeoffs clearly.
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or equivalent practical experience, with 12+ years of relevant experience.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Contributions to Lustre, Linux filesystems, NFS implementations, or other storage projects, including features, performance improvements, bug fixes, or technical reviews.
  • Expertise in Lustre metadata and client I/O, Linux VFS and page cache, NFS protocol and client/server internals, or distributed locking and recovery.
  • Experience with hierarchical storage management, policy engines, or migration between filesystems and object storage, including data recall and recovery from interrupted transfers.
  • Experience with RDMA storage transports, GPUDirect Storage, or optimizing data loading and checkpointing for GPU workloads.
  • Experience with storage security and multi-tenancy, including authentication, identity mapping, permissions, and encryption.

Deployment opportunities are not guaranteed and may vary in duration, location, and frequency.

Reservists are typically activated for disaster events, emergency exercises, planning projects, and surge support requirements. Due to the seasonal or project-specific nature of our disaster and emergency management work, ICF hires professionals as "On-Call" employees. Individuals may work on concurrent projects outside of their ICF assignments, provided there is no conflict of interest.
