jobs.excerpt: The Team Lead - Acute Billing Operations is responsible for day‑to‑day operational performance and execution for assigned clients, serving as the primary operations liaison between client facilities and internal delivery teams.
jobs.description:
The Team Lead - Acute Billing Operations is responsible for day‑to‑day operational performance and execution for assigned clients, serving as the primary operations liaison between client facilities and internal delivery teams. This role focuses on tactical revenue cycle outcomes, ensuring accurate reporting, effective communication, and consistent execution across full-cycle claims processing. (billing, follow‑up, collections, denials, and claim resolution workflows)


This position is accountable for operational monitoring and client relationship management. The Team Lead translates client needs into clear operational priorities, monitors key performance indicators, identifies risks and trends, and supports timely issue resolution to protect cash, A/R performance, and client satisfaction.


The role also provides operational mentorship to staff by reinforcing daily best practices, supporting training and performance efforts, and helping remove execution barriers. Success is measured by client retention, escalation volume, and core revenue cycle performance indicators.


These Goals and objectives are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed; employees will be required to perform other job-related duties as required. Goals and objectives are subject to change.


All activities must be in compliance with Equal Employment Opportunity laws, HIPAA, ERISA and other regulations, as appropriate.


Essential Functions: In addition to meeting performance expectations, this role includes the following specific responsibilities:


Discrete Responsibilities (Primary Accountability)

  • Operational Performance Monitoring: Monitor daily operational performance, battle cards, action plans, and key KPIs for assigned clients, including A/R days, cash performance, denial trends, and accuracy measures.
  • Primary Operations Liaison: Act as the primary operational point of contact between clients and internal delivery teams, ensuring timely, accurate, and consistent communication.
  • Operational Translation: Translate client needs, issues, and requests into actionable operational priorities and execution plans.
  • Risk & Trend Identification: Identify operational risks, analyze performance trends, and support issue resolution to prevent revenue leakage and service disruption.
  • Reporting & Communication: Ensure accurate reporting, clear status updates, and effective issue communication to internal stakeholders and, as appropriate, client contacts.
  • Client Scope: Lead operational work for domestic‑only clients as needed.

Reporting, Trend Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

  • Trend Monitoring & Corrective Action: Review statistical reports and dashboards to identify operational trends, risks, and deficiencies; develop and implement corrective action plans to improve timeliness, quality, and outcomes.
  • Operational Efficiency: Lead tactical efforts to maximize operational efficiency and optimize reimbursement through standardized workflows, issue triage, and collaboration with cross-functional partners.

Client & Stakeholder Relationship Management (Tactical)

  • Liaison & Communication: Act as the primary operational point of contact between facility management and internal teams, ensuring smooth, timely communication and resolution of day-to-day issues.
  • Service Responsiveness & Escalation: Ensure client inquiries are addressed promptly (including providing timelines to resolution), and proactively escalate risks such as unbilled accounts, claim issues, and operational blockers to leadership.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Partner with internal teams (e.g., operations, finance, payer relations, technology, and strategic client management/sales counterparts) to drive resolution and maintain a consistent client experience.
  • Contract Awareness & Compliance: Understand contract terms and ensure operational billing, invoicing, and service delivery remain within negotiated requirements.

Compliance & Professional Standards

  • Regulatory Knowledge: Maintain current knowledge of hospital billing systems, government payer programs, third-party reimbursement policies, and applicable federal/state regulations.
  • Confidentiality: Maintain confidentiality of patient and client information without exception.
  • Continuous Learning & Industry Awareness: Attend required meetings and remain current on industry trends, legislative changes, and best practices.
  • Customer Invoicing & Accuracy: Ensure accuracy of customer invoices and support monthly invoicing processes as required; validate supporting detail and address discrepancies.
  • Management Expectations / Additional Duties: Perform all functions in alignment with management expectations and complete other duties as assigned.

Key Measures of Success

  • Client Retention and Stability
  • Reduction in Client Escalations
  • Cash Performance vs. Goal
  • A/R Days and Denial Trends

Staff Management

Responsible for ensuring area of responsibility has the talent and resources to meet short- and long-term organizational goals as well as ensuring maximum productivity and performance. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Proactively recruit, screen, and select candidates for current and future resource requirements.
  • Effectively orient new hires to ensure a positive and productive employee engagement experience.
  • Ensure structure and hiring plans (within budget) are appropriate for performance and productivity levels required.
  • Utilize the company’s performance management program as designed to align individual performance to overall performance objectives. Meet all completion requirements at a high quality level. Provide ongoing performance feedback. Identify and take appropriate action for non-performance.
  • Ensure each employee has a yearly performance review that is reviewed with employee and the review to be sent to Human Resources each year.
  • Ensure each employee has a clear and thorough understanding of their role and responsibilities. Keep job descriptions current for each position.
  • Actively support and participate in organizational development and training programs. Meet all completion requirements at a high quality level.
  • Mentor, guide, and coach direct reports in order to expand their capabilities and performance.
  • Communicate all corporate matters in a positive and timely manner as directed by Corporate Communications or senior managements.
  • Administer all internal policies and procedures in accordance with corporate, human resources, budgetary, and finance guidelines. Ensure accuracy of staff data records.
  • Comply with all employment laws and regulations including, but not limited to, equal employment opportunities for all.

Minimum Requirements:

Education/Experience/Certification Requirements

  • Experience leading/managing a team of 5-10 direct reports (Claims Billers)
  • 5+ years of experience in Acute hospital revenue cycle functions with strong exposure to FULL-CYCLE billing and follow-up/collections and claim resolution.
  • Working knowledge of insurance regulations, reimbursement practices, procedure and diagnosis coding, and automated billing workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to work issues to resolution, including complex account research, root cause identification, and corrective actions.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to explain operational findings, timelines, and next steps clearly.
  • Excellent critical thinking, organizational, and time-management skills with strong attention to detail, accuracy, and follow-through.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word) and comfort working across multiple systems and reporting outputs.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience (to support internal flexibility for hiring and promotion).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years Medicare hospital billing experience and/or demonstrated expertise with government payers (Medicare/Medicaid).
  • Experience supporting hospital billing platforms and/or EHR/RCM systems (e.g., Thrive, Epic, Cerner, or comparable tools).
  • Advanced revenue cycle analytics capability (e.g., trending denials/underpayments, operational KPI reporting, dashboard interpretation).
  • Prior experience in a role requiring client management, escalations, service recovery, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Exposure to invoicing processes, contract compliance validation, and operational performance governance.

You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Khmer-English Video-Phone Interpreter


Job Title: Khmer Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

Pay: $20 - $23 per hour.

  • Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.

We Offer:

  • Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.
  • Incentives for meeting attendance targets.
  • Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.
  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview:


The Khmer Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Khmerand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**


Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.
  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inKhmer and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.

Position Overview


GDIT is seeking a dynamic and highly technical Network Engineering Sr Manager to lead cloud and data center network teams across project delivery and operations. This role blends engineering expertise, strategic thinking, and leadership to drive successful program execution, modernize network platforms, and support the growth of our business.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead and manage project‑delivery network engineering teams and network operations teams supporting cloud and data center infrastructures.
  • Define and delegate engineering and project tasks; oversee project budgets, schedules, resource planning, and quality objectives.
  • Mentor and develop engineering managers and staff, enhancing both technical capabilities and essential soft skills.
  • Serve as escalation point for critical issues; assess situations and deliver timely, effective resolutions.

Technical Strategy & Architecture

  • Design, develop, and review technical network solutions aligned to customer requirements and organizational goals.
  • Drive innovation by researching emerging technologies, conducting pilots, evaluating vendors, and developing business cases.
  • Build scalable, resilient architectures using Cisco Data Center technologies, Palo Alto firewalls, cloud networking, and modern automation approaches.

Business Engagement & Growth

  • Support proposal development, solutioning, and service delivery efforts to help secure new business and re‑compete contracts.
  • Translate customer and program requirements into actionable technical and service solutions.
  • Work collaboratively across leadership, stakeholders, and clients to communicate program status, trends, risks, and opportunities.

Operational Excellence

  • Evaluate and improve existing policies, processes, and operational practices to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and overall performance.
  • Measure and assess product, process, and team performance; develop strategies and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to financial planning, ensuring technology decisions align with budget expectations and long‑term business impact.

Required Qualifications


  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years managing network engineering teams required; 7+ years strongly preferred
  • 3+ years hands‑on Network Engineering/Architecture experience
  • Experience with Cisco Data Center technologies
  • Experience with Palo Alto firewall platforms
  • Familiarity with enterprise and cloud networking solutions
  • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder‑management skills
  • Exceptional attention to detail, documentation, and requirements interpretation

About the team

Zillow Group is seeking a Director, Marketing AI & Automation to lead a new team within Marketing, Technology & Operations. This role will be accountable for delivering Marketing AI big bets, responsible for the roadmap, the platform, the governance, and the path that carries use cases into scaled production.

This role is responsible for shepherding AI big bets from strategy development to scaled implementation, including the platform and integration work they depend on, the measurement that proves impact, the change management that makes them stick, and the handoff to the teams who will run them day to day. The role also owns what comes next: sourcing and shaping the next generation of bets as the technology and the business shift, building the case for what to invest behind, and deciding what to retire.

This role will be responsible for building and leading a multidisciplinary team responsible for scaling AI use cases. The team is expected to have a mix of strategic, technical and operational skills.

About the role


Key Responsibilities


  • Own the Marketing AI roadmap: Setting and defending the use-case portfolio, including what gets built, in what order, and for whom, prioritized against reclaimed capacity and business impact

  • Run the path from idea to production: Building and operating the intake stage-gate from idea to pilot to production to owned, including the handoff model that transfers run-state to the team accountable for the outcome

  • Stand up the agent and orchestration platform: Owning the shared layer, reusable components, and the data and vendor integration that AI use cases depend on, focused on integration and orchestration rather than model building

  • Own AI governance for Marketing: Running agent audits, brand-risk scoring, and exclusion zones in partnership with Legal and Brand, aligned to Zillow's AI Principles and to external standards

  • Drive adoption across the org: Running the adoption program and the network of embedded AI liaisons so that capability is embedded in day-to-day workflows rather than sitting unused

  • Build and lead the team: Hiring into net-new technical and strategic roles, integrating talent redeployed from across Marketing, and setting the performance bar for a newly formed team

  • Report value to leadership: Owning the measurement of capacity gained, speed to market, and business impact, including a clear account of what did not work
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $231,000.00 - $369,000.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $219,500.00 - $350,600.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 10+ years in marketing technology, growth engineering, applied AI, or technical product, including 4+ years leading teams.

  • Production track record: Has moved AI use cases from proof of concept to scaled operation, and can speak specifically to what was built, what broke along the way, and what the measured impact was

  • Marketing fluency: Strong understanding of how Marketing operate, with enough depth to hold a substantive conversation with a channel leader about where AI helps and where it does not

  • Technically credible: Able to go deep with engineers on agent orchestration, data integration, and evaluation, and to distinguish a serious architecture from a demo, without needing to build models directly. Familiarity with a modern composable stack (CDP, reverse ETL, cloud data platform, enterprise LLM tooling) highly valued

  • Enablement mindset: Track record running a center-led function that transferred capability outward as it matured, rather than accumulating ownership. Experience standing up a center of excellence or platform team from zero a plus

  • Governance judgment: Experience managing brand, legal, and privacy risk in AI systems, and building the review mechanisms rather than resisting them

  • Influence without authority: Able to drive outcomes that land inside other teams, on other roadmaps, without direct control

  • Build-versus-buy judgment: Experience evaluating and managing AI and martech vendors, with a clear view of when a platform partner beats an internal build

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in a technical or business field (MBA, Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics) a plus

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

jobs.description:
At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting-edge technology to transform people’s lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.


Job Purpose

The Director of US Oncology Portfolio Delivery (“US Local Delivery Lead Director”) provides leadership, oversight and local US delivery of studies in support of global oncology R&D programs. The LDL-Director is accountable for a portfolio of assets, and manages the activities of US Program Leads (PLs) and US Local Delivery Leads (LDLs) to ensure the delivery of all oncology clinical studies to the required quality standards, GSK written standards and ICH GCP. The LDL-Director operates independently and effectively in a highly complex, high volume, strategic market.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Leads a team of LDLs operating in a highly complex environment due to scale (number of subjects/sites per study) and volume (number of studies assigned to contry) of studies conducted, providing training, coaching, mentoring, line and performance management.
  • Responsible for effectively managing capacity utilisation of LDL resources and contributes to resourcing solutions including multi-country support by LDLs, ensuring alignment of capabilities with study requirements, resource availability and business priorities. Contribute to overall management of clinical research within the LOC via involvement in applicable leadership teams to ensure consistency and utilisation of resources and best practice.
  • Accountable for ensuring the completion of all project management deliverables for all studies assigned to the LOC to agreed timelines, budget and quality standards. The LDL manager works with the LDLs to identify and resolve or escalate risks and issues that may impact study delivery.
  • Responsible for identifying and sharing best practices, standardizing across the LOC / region and representing local/regional clinical operations on global and cross functional initiatives. Ability to understand and respond to unique challenges in managing workload due to size and scale of studies.
  • Recruits and develops LDLs. Evaluates capabilities and competencies of internal staff, identifies and coordinates implementation of personal development plans for direct reports.
  • Partners with local and central teams to ensure robust study feasibility with reference to study complexity, clinical facilities and monitoring resource.
  • Establishes and manages key strategic relationships with external vendors to ensure clinical studies are appropriately resourced and executed as necessary.
  • Ensures that critical study timelines related to study activities are accurately forecasted and achieved and that recruitment targets, patient recruitment cycle times, data and audit quality and site related milestones are met. Provides trouble-shooting and problem resolution support for LDLs to ensure productive, efficient study delivery.
  • In collaboration with Clinical Operation Director and Local/Regional Quality, Capability & Risk Manager identifies management monitoring process checks linked with LDL activities that require inclusion in the local quality plan to ensure quality and integrity of clinical studies conducted in the LOC.
  • Assists with audits/inspections of local clinical operations department & study / sites in the country, as required.
  • Continuous development of knowledge in the areas of GCP, internal company guidelines, SOPs, new monitoring technologies and capabilities. Serves as an expert in ICH GCP and GSK written standards for LDLs.
  • Leads or participates in regional/global clinical operations projects (as appropriate).
  • Available and willing to travel as job requires.

Why You?

Basic Qualifications:


  • University degree in Sciences (Medicine, Pharmacy, Biochemistry, Biology or related fields) or equivalent demonstrable professional experience in the area
  • At least 10 years of experience in clinical operations delivery within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, including leadership of complex, multi‑site clinical studies in the US.
  • At least 5 years of experience leading and developing clinical operations leaders or managers (e.g., LDLs, study managers, CTMs) in a high‑volume, high‑complexity environment.
  • At least 5 years of experience delivering oncology clinical trials in the US, including studies with large site networks, complex protocols, and competitive enrollment environments.
  • At least 3 years of experience leading delivery of a portfolio of oncology studies across multiple asset teams.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Demonstrated accountability for study delivery to timelines, quality standards, and regulatory requirements, including risk identification, issue escalation, and problem resolution.
  • Strong working knowledge of ICH‑GCP, GSK written standards, and US regulatory expectations.
  • Experience leading delivery across late phase and/or registrational oncology studies is highly valued.
  • Familiarity with oncology specific operational challenges, such as:

o High protocol complexity and amendment frequency

o Specialized site types and networks

o Competitive enrollment and site capacity constraints

  • Experience operating across multiple oncology indications or programs within a portfolio.


Skills

Agile Thinking, Business Acumen, Clinical Data Management, Clinical Development, Clinical Research, Clinical Trials, Communication, Creativity, Decision Making, Pharmaceutical Industry, Project ManagementThe US annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges from $169,500 to $282,500. The US salary ranges take into account a number of factors including work location within the US market, the candidate’s skills, experience, education level and the market rate for the role. In addition, this position offers an annual bonus and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program which is dependent on the level of the role. Available benefits include health care and other insurance benefits (for employee and family), retirement benefits, paid holidays, vacation, and paid caregiver/parental and medical leave. If salary ranges are not displayed in the job posting for a specific country, the relevant compensation will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Please visit GSK US Benefits Summary to learn more about the comprehensive benefits program GSK offers US employees.

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

NextLink Labs is a technical consulting firm that helps companies build, scale, and secure their technology through custom software development, DevOps, and application security services.

We work with startups and public companies, especially in regulated, high-stakes industries like healthcare, finance, and government. We’re hiring an Account Executive with a partnerships-first mindset, someone who knows how to build pipeline from existing partner relationships and independently create new opportunities when needed.

We have strong partnerships and channel relationships that can be a source of warm introductions but we’re looking for someone who takes ownership of their territory and doesn’t wait for leads to land in their inbox. If partner-sourced pipeline is light, you’ll be responsible for driving pipeline through outbound efforts, referrals, and uncovering new prospects.

You’ll be focused on building relationships, developing target accounts, and closing high-value technical consulting deals. This is a consultative role where your ability to build trust, position value, and navigate complex sales cycles matters more than running a script.

  • Conduct account mapping and relationship development across target accounts in your assigned territory.

  • Collaborate with marketing and delivery to ensure aligned messaging and quality engagements.

  • Navigate complex sales cycles involving multiple technical and executive stakeholders.

  • Scope engagements in collaboration with our consultants and engineers to ensure alignment and set clear expectations.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in technical consulting, custom software development, or professional services.

  • A proven ability to generate pipeline independently, even in the absence of high lead volume.

  • Experience selling to technical buyers - CTOs, CISOs, Directors of Engineering, especially in regulated environments.

  • Strength in relationship-building, listening, and consultative selling.

  • Comfortable speaking about DevOps, cloud infrastructure, or software development solutions from a strategic or outcomes-based perspective (without needing deep technical expertise).

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with channel partners or building pipeline through alliances.

  • Familiarity with sales tools like HubSpot, Sales Navigator, Clay, Lemlist, or Instantly.

  • Background in or selling into regulated industries like healthcare, finance, or government.

Why Join NextLink Labs

  • We’re a technical consulting firm that values clarity, ownership, and outcomes

  • Compensation includes a competitive base salary and uncapped commission.

  • You’ll earn long-tail commission on any deal you source, even after it’s handed off. As a result, you’re rewarded for initiating valuable relationships.

  • Remote-first culture, flexible work schedule, and autonomy to do your best work.

  • Healthcare (Medical, Dental, and Vision) and 401k

  • Characterize node, rack, and cluster performance using microbenchmarks and representative applications. Measure throughput, latency, and scaling efficiency to identify compute, memory, communication, and storage bottlenecks.
  • Identify Linux performance problems related to CPU scheduling, NUMA locality, CPU and memory affinity, interrupt handling, and resource contention. Assess their impact on GPU usage and application efficiency.
  • Examine distributed workload scaling, considering collective communication, synchronization delays, slow nodes, and the interplay between computation and communication. Assess how GPU and NIC positioning, interconnect structure, and network traffic impact performance.
  • Combine application profiles, system traces, hardware counters, and cluster telemetry to isolate root causes. Develop focused reproductions and collaborate with hardware, firmware, driver, library, and application teams to implement and verify fixes.
  • Develop and maintain Python tools for automated benchmark execution, data collection, and performance analysis. Set up repeatable baselines, assess run-to-run variability, and spot regressions across hardware configurations and software releases.
  • Define and complete performance validation for new platforms and cluster deployments. Identify underperforming nodes, links, or storage paths, and verify that corrective actions restore encouraged workload performance.

What we need to see:

  • Extensive practical experience in Linux performance analysis, including knowledge of processes and threads, CPU and memory architecture, NUMA, I/O, and networking.
  • Experience investigating performance in multi-node HPC or GPU-accelerated systems, distinguishing local resource bottlenecks from communication overhead, load imbalance, and shared-resource contention.
  • Deep expertise in at least one relevant area: GPU application performance, Linux systems performance, high-speed networking and collective communication, parallel storage, or HPC performance tooling.
  • Proficiency in Python to build maintainable automation and analysis tools. Experience in developing and debugging performance-sensitive code in C, C++ and CUDA.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience working with profiling and tracing tools like Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, Linux perf, or eBPF-based tools.
  • Practical experience with RDMA and MPI or NCCL, and analyzing performance across PCIe, NVLink, InfiniBand, or Ethernet interconnects.
  • Experience with Slurm, container runtimes, and cgroups, including understanding how workload placement, resource isolation, and CPU/GPU/NIC affinity impact performance.
  • Experience improving distributed training, inference, or scientific applications by conducting strong- and weak-scaling studies, or building automated performance regression frameworks using tools such as ReFrame.

jobs.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Health Care space is seeking a commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative function across our ecommerce business.

This role will own the complete creative direction of the brand across paid advertising, website and landing pages, email, organic social media, marketplaces, product launches, and other customer-facing channels.

The Creative Director will be responsible not only for maintaining a strong and consistent brand identity, but also for improving commercial performance. The primary objective of the role is to develop creative strategies and assets that increase conversion rates, improve advertising performance, strengthen customer engagement, and support profitable growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine creative judgement, customer insight, performance data, and strong team management.

Key Outcomes

Improve Ecommerce Conversion Performance

  • Develop creative strategies that improve conversion across paid media, websites, product pages, marketplaces, and email.
  • Turn customer insights, performance data, and competitor research into clear briefs and testable concepts.
  • Partner with ecommerce teams to improve client acquisition and conversion.
  • Establish a structured process for creative testing and optimisation.

Lead Performance Creative Strategy

  • Own creative strategy across paid social, video, display, and other acquisition channels.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of concepts, hooks, angles, scripts, and formats.
  • Ensure sufficient creative volume and variation for testing and scaling.
  • Use performance data to identify, improve, and scale winning concepts.
  • Balance direct-response effectiveness with strong brand presentation.

Strengthen Website and Product Pages Creatives

  • Lead creative direction across the website, landing pages, collection pages, and product pages.
  • Improve how product benefits, differentiation, use cases, and customer proof are communicated.
  • Create clear visual and messaging hierarchies that make pages more persuasive.
  • Collaborate with ecommerce, UX, development, copywriting, and CRO teams on improvements and testing.
  • Ensure consistency between advertising and onsite customer experience.

Own Brand Creative Across All Channels

  • Maintain a consistent creative direction across paid media, website, email, organic content, marketplaces, packaging, and launches.
  • Develop practical brand guidelines that support quality, consistency, and speed.
  • Ensure creative work reflects the brand's positioning, audience, and commercial goals.
  • Raise the overall standard of design, copy, video, photography, and storytelling.
  • Protect brand consistency while encouraging experimentation.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Creative Team

  • Lead and develop designers, editors, creators, copywriters, freelancers, and agencies.
  • Set clear responsibilities, quality standards, workflows, and performance expectations.
  • Provide constructive feedback and support team development.
  • Manage the balance between internal and external creative resources.
  • Build a culture of accountability, speed, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Improve Creative Operations and Output

  • Build an efficient process from research and briefing through production, approval, launch, and iteration.
  • Establish clear systems for priorities, deadlines, feedback, approvals, and asset management.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with business priorities.
  • Maintain an organised creative asset library.
  • Improve output and efficiency while maintaining quality and brand consistency.
  • Manage creative budgets and external resources effectively.

Lead Product Launch and Campaign Creative

  • Develop creative strategies for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and major events.
  • Translate product positioning into strong customer-facing concepts.
  • Define clear messaging, creative direction, asset requirements, and channel execution.
  • Coordinate creative production across paid media, website, email, marketplaces, and organic content.
  • Review results and apply learnings to future campaigns.

Responsibilities

  • Own the overall creative vision and execution across the ecommerce business.
  • Translate company goals into clear creative priorities and plans.
  • Develop quarterly and monthly creative roadmaps.
  • Lead creative concept development and campaign planning.
  • Review and approve high-priority creative assets.
  • Create clear, actionable briefs for internal and external creative teams.
  • Partner with growth, marketing, ecommerce, product, customer service, and leadership teams.
  • Analyse creative performance using advertising, website, email, and marketplace data.
  • Monitor customer behaviour, category trends, competitors, and emerging creative formats.
  • Present creative strategies, results, challenges, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Ensure the creative team remains focused on work that has the greatest commercial impact.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Website and landing-page conversion rate.
  • Product-page conversion rate.
  • Advertising creative performance.
  • Customer acquisition cost.
  • Return on advertising spend.
  • Click-through rate and hook rate.
  • Creative testing volume and testing velocity.
  • Percentage of creative tests producing meaningful improvements.
  • Revenue generated from new creative concepts.
  • Email engagement and conversion performance.
  • On-time completion of creative projects.
  • Creative production efficiency.
  • Brand consistency and quality across channels.
  • Performance and development of the creative team.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is both creatively ambitious and commercially disciplined. They understand that ecommerce creative must capture attention, communicate value quickly, address customer objections, and motivate action.

They are comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed execution. They can confidently lead a team, evaluate creative work, interpret performance data, and collaborate with commercial stakeholders.

They do not rely solely on personal taste. They use customer insight, brand strategy, testing, and business results to make decisions.

Required Experience

  • Significant experience in a senior creative leadership role within ecommerce, DTC, retail, consumer products, or a performance-focused agency.
  • Demonstrated experience improving conversion and advertising performance through creative strategy.
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce customer journeys, product pages, landing pages, paid social, email, and organic content.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating both brand-building and performance-focused creative work.
  • Experience creating and evaluating direct-response advertising concepts.
  • Ability to interpret creative, advertising, and ecommerce performance data.
  • Strong understanding of design, copywriting, video, photography, content production, and visual storytelling.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and production partners.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and feedback skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with physical consumer products.
  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Shopify, and email marketing platforms.
  • Experience with conversion-rate optimisation and structured experimentation.
  • Experience producing user-generated content, creator-led advertising, product demonstrations, and testimonial creative.
  • Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, studios, photographers, and creators.
  • Familiarity with creative analytics and project-management tools.
  • Experience scaling an established ecommerce brand across multiple products, markets, or countries.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the Creative Director will have assessed the current brand, creative team, workflows, performance data, customer journey, and existing asset library. They will have identified the largest creative and conversion opportunities and introduced a clear testing and production roadmap.

Within six months, the company should have a stronger creative pipeline, clearer brand direction, faster testing cycles, improved collaboration between creative and growth teams, and measurable improvements in conversion and creative performance.

Within the first year, the Creative Director will have built a scalable creative function that consistently produces high-quality, commercially effective work across every major ecommerce channel.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • A senior leadership role with direct ownership of the company's ecommerce creative direction and growth.
  • High level of autonomy and the opportunity to shape creative strategy, processes, and team development.
  • Direct impact on ecommerce performance, conversion, and creative effectiveness across multiple channels.
  • Opportunity to build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary creative team.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture where creative decisions are connected to business results.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded Creative Director who wants to take ownership of a growing ecommerce creative function, combine creative leadership with performance-driven decision-making, and build a scalable creative operation with a direct impact on business growth.

jobs.description:
The Company
At Spartan Investment Group our mission is to improve lives through our values. We do this by finding value-add and opportunistic investments offering solid returns to our investors. Providing an opportunity to grow for our partners and creating lasting wealth for everyone with whom we conduct business is how we make our greatest contribution.
We specifically focus on self-storage projects capitalizing on amazing deals in other asset classes. In 2021, we were listed as the 5th fastest growing real estate company in the US and joined the list of the top 100 owners of self-storage. We are members of the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing private companies in America and in 2023 we were #13 in Denver Business Journals list of top places to work.

Mission

The mission of the Facilities & Capex Manager is to lead capital expenditure planning, budgeting, and project coordination across Spartan Investment Group's real estate portfolio. This role will oversee capital improvement initiatives from planning through completion, coordinating with Spartan Construction (SC), external vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are executed on time, within budget, and in alignment with property business plans and investment objectives. This is a remote position.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  1. Budget Adherence: Percentage of capital projects completed within approved budgets.

  1. Project Timeliness: Percentage of capital projects completed within established timelines.

  1. Capital Budget Accuracy: Variance between forecasted and actual capital expenditures.

  1. Project Completion: Percentage of planned capital projects completed within the established reporting period.

  1. Reporting Accuracy: Timeliness and accuracy of capital project tracking, forecasting, and reporting.

Outcomes

  • Capital Planning: Develop and maintain annual capital expenditure plans for 100% of portfolio properties, prioritizing projects based on property needs, business plans, and investment objectives.

  • Budget Management: Own capital project budgets, maintain monthly forecasts, and ensure projects are completed within 5% of approved budgets.

  • Project Coordination: Coordinate multiple capital improvement projects simultaneously, ensuring at least 90% are completed within established timelines through SC and external vendors.

  • Construction Oversight: Serve as the primary Asset Management liaison to SC and external contractors, conducting weekly project reviews to monitor progress, deliverables, timelines, and execution challenges.

  • Acquisition Integration: Coordinate capital improvement plans for 100% of new acquisitions, aligning project scopes, budgets, and timelines with due diligence findings and approved business plans.

  • Vendor Management: Coordinate vendor selection, proposal reviews, and contract requirements, ensuring competitive pricing, quality execution, and accountability for project deliverables.

  • Project Reporting: Maintain accurate project budgets, schedules, and documentation, providing monthly portfolio-level reporting and weekly updates on active projects, risks, and budget variances.

  • Project Closeout: Coordinate the closeout of 100% of completed capital projects, including final documentation, invoice reconciliation, and handoff to Operations within 30 days of project completion.

Competencies

  • Project Management: Ability to coordinate multiple complex projects while maintaining accountability for timelines, budgets, deliverables, and competing priorities.

  • Financial Acumen: Strong understanding of capital budgeting, cost analysis, forecasting, and financial reporting to support effective investment decisions.

  • Communication: Ability to clearly communicate project expectations, progress, challenges, and outcomes across internal teams, leadership, contractors, and external partners.

  • Collaboration: Ability to build productive relationships, coordinate across departments, and align stakeholders toward common project objectives.

  • Problem Solving: Ability to identify project challenges, evaluate alternatives, and implement practical solutions to minimize delays, costs, and operational disruptions.

  • Accountability: Demonstrates ownership of project outcomes, maintains accurate documentation, follows through on commitments, and holds stakeholders accountable for agreed-upon deliverables.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Real Estate, or a related field preferred.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in capital project management, construction project management.

  • Experience coordinating multiple capital improvement or construction projects simultaneously, preferably across a multi-site commercial real estate portfolio.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and managing capital budgets, tracking expenditures, forecasting costs, and analyzing budget variances.

  • Working knowledge of construction processes, project schedules, scopes of work, and vendor management, with experience coordinating contractors and external partners.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and project management tools, with strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills.

  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% of the time.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Base Salary: $126k–$138k annually, full-time, exempt.

  • Performance-Based Bonus Opportunities: Target bonus of 20% of annual base salary, based on performance.

  • Promote Share Program: Opportunity to participate in the long-term success and growth of Spartan's investment portfolio.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Company-paid health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, with company contributions toward dependent and family coverage.

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Company matching contributions.

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off: Flexible, unlimited PTO and 8 paid holidays.

  • Cafeteria Plan: Annual reimbursement allowance for a variety of approved expenses, including entertainment, wellness, vehicle maintenance, and more.

  • Continuing Education: Reimbursement allowance to support continued professional development and skill-building related to your role.

  • Performance & Wellness Incentives: Incentive programs that reward performance and personal well-being, supported by a dedicated performance and wellness coach to help employees achieve their personal and professional goals.

Description

About Acadia.io

2024 AdAge A-List - Performance Marketing Agency of the Year

2022 Best Places to Work, The Atlanta Business Chronicle

Small Ad Agency of the Year – AdAge (

Acadia is a modern media and growth agency. We have a bottom-up, audience-based approach to media that is very accountable and addressable. Media is not “one thing” at Acadia, but many. Acadia is a very agile agency environment, with a "roll up your sleeves" mentality needed across all employees.

Our Core Values

  • Can-Do - We dedicate ourselves to helping our clients and co-workers reach their fullest potential. We demonstrate courage and urgency to find solutions and take ownership.
  • Curiosity - We show genuine interest. We are the first to ask why, the first to research, and the first to understand. We ask questions until we find the path to conquer obstacles and build solutions.
  • Candor - We are honest and transparent in all our actions. We strive to foster positive and mutually beneficial relationships — where respect and humanity thrive.
  • Community - We will make lives better for those people, clients, and other deserving causes that we care deeply about.

As a Retail Media Specialist, you will be vital in continuing our efforts as an industry leader by implementing best in-class retail media PPC and display strategies across Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Target, Kroger, Chewy, Ulta and more.

This role is one that is challenging and rewarding as you develop your Amazon PPC skills and stay up-to-date with new paid search features, leveraging Acadia’s industry leading position within the space. The successful candidate has an opportunity to develop an exciting career in a dynamic, growing digital marketing company.

This position reports directly to a Retail Media Manager.

A week in the life of a Retail Media Specialist

A snapshot of a typical week for a Retail Media member captures:

  • No-stress commuting.You work from home so your daily commute is only the amount of time it takes for you to walk into your home office or travel to your favorite coffee shop for a change of scenery.
  • Advertising Optimization. You use our ad management software and native advertising dashboards to identify opportunities and optimize our clients’ advertising campaigns on a daily / weekly basis. You use additional third party software to perform keyword research and implement automated optimization tactics.
  • Communication. Your work calendar has internal & client appointments to present the latest results, activities and planned tactics for the upcoming 90 days. You’ve gotten to the essence of clients’ needs and identified the ways Acadia can be their guide to achieving them.
  • Collaboration. Acadia is a team of go-getters, innovators and industry experts. Over the week, you communicate with colleagues to exchange experiences, coordinate with team members who work on other aspects of the client business (brand protection, SEO, organic marketing) and define strategies that are aligned with one another.
  • Innovation. You check out the competition to see what strategies they’re employing to drive growth.
  • Reporting.You report to clients in your portfolio on a weekly / bi-weekly basis delivering the data but also the story behind the data, as well as next steps to improve performance further.
  • Trends. You can quickly identify trends within the account you manage and take appropriate action to course correct.
  • Thought Leadership. You contribute to the company owned blog, attend company hosted webinars and other live events where you share your latest views on Amazon advertising’s latest developments and opportunities.

Before you know it, another week has come to a close and you go into the weekend energized knowing you’ve once again contributed to the growth and success of Acadia and the brands we support.

Qualifications

Job Expectations

The successful candidate will have a proven track record of ability in the following areas:

  • Managing complex advertising campaigns with thousands of targeting options per account.
  • Working in a collaborative team culture.
  • Ability to coordinate several projects simultaneously.
  • Identifying opportunities for clients’ growth, and new services for existing markets.

Candidates must quickly become comfortable articulating the value of Acadia to clients and prospects by representing our company’s services while maintaining a deep client focus. A lifelong learner with a strong drive for results is essential.

Candidates should possess

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or marketing is preferred
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Ability to work well independently and be self-motivated
  • Excellent analytical, oral and written communication
  • Attention to detail while also having the ability to handle multiple priorities
  • 1+ years of experience with Pay Per Click advertising (Amazon Advertising, Google Ads, Bing Ads, Facebook Ads…) strongly preferred
  • 1+ years of experience with Amazon Advertising is required

Our interview process consists of 3 virtual interviews and a brief technical assessment for successful candidates. We will also ask candidates for 2-3 professional references from past employers when making our offer.

This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. Senior Google Media Buyer MVR Digital | Remote | Full-Time

About MVR Digital

MVR Digital is a performance marketing agency recognized by Adweek as one of the Fastest Growing Agencies. We manage paid media for growth-stage DTC and e-commerce brands spending $100K to $1M+ monthly across Meta, Google, TikTok, and more.

We're remote-first with roots in New York, Denver, and Canada. Our clients come to us after being burned by agencies that overpromise. They stay because we own outcomes and tell them the truth.

The Role

You'll manage Google Ads campaigns across multiple e-commerce and DTC accounts, working closely with strategists and client success. This role is non-client-facing, but it's not purely executional either.

We want someone who understands Google's ecosystem well enough to have opinions. You know when the campaign structure is working against the algorithm, when Performance Max is cannibalizing Search, and when the bidding strategy needs a reset. You bring that thinking to the team, and you execute on it with precision.

EST hours preferred, with required overlap from 10 AM to 1 PM EST. As the agency scales, strong buyers get access to larger and more complex accounts.

What You'll Do

  • Own Google Ads execution across e-commerce accounts, including Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube, and Demand Gen
  • Monitor daily pacing and performance, adjusting budgets and bids as needed
  • Troubleshoot issues quickly and execute optimizations without waiting to be prompted
  • Contribute strategic input on account structure, testing approach, and campaign architecture
  • Run structured tests across bidding strategies, audiences, and creative formats
  • Stay current on Google platform changes, algorithm behavior, and best practices, and apply them proactively
  • Maintain tracking integrity across GA4, GTM, and conversion events, and flag data quality issues before they affect decisions
  • Build and maintain Looker Studio reporting that gives the CSM and strategist what they need without extra asks
  • Maintain clean campaign structures, naming conventions, and documentation across all accounts
  • Collaborate in Slack and ClickUp to stay aligned with strategists and client success

What You Bring

Google (Required)

  • 4+ years of hands-on Google Ads buying experience for DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Deep expertise across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and YouTube, including the strategic rationale behind each
  • Strong understanding of Google's machine learning systems and how campaign structure decisions affect them
  • Experience managing accounts with $100K+ monthly ad spend across multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Ability to diagnose performance issues at the structural, bidding, and creative level
  • Solid command of GA4, GTM, conversion tracking setup, and attribution windows
  • Current on Google platform changes and able to translate them into account decisions
  • E-commerce background

Nice to Have

  • Meta Ads experience for DTC or e-commerce brands
  • TikTok Ads Manager experience
  • Microsoft Ads experience

Working Style

  • You work autonomously and follow through without reminders
  • You bring observations and recommendations, not just status updates
  • You communicate clearly in writing in an async-first environment
  • You flag performance shifts before they show up on someone else's radar

How We Work

Our values shape how we operate day to day, not just what we put on a website.

  • Act Like an Owner. You spot problems and bring solutions. Waiting to be told is not the standard.
  • Clarity Over Complexity. Clean structures, clear communication, simple systems. If it's complicated, we make it simpler.
  • Serve Clients' Best Interest. Your execution directly fuels client outcomes. That connection matters here.
  • Data-Informed, Human-Led. Numbers guide decisions. Judgment closes them.
  • We Win Together, We Lose Together. Strategists, creatives, and buyers succeed as a unit. Credit and accountability are shared.

Compensation and Perks

  • Full-time contractor arrangement
  • PTO, paid sick leave, and local holidays observed
  • Flexible Fridays
  • Fully remote

You're a Good Fit If

  • You know Google well enough to push back when the structure or strategy isn't right
  • You can spot whether underperformance is a bidding problem, a structure problem, or a tracking problem
  • You flag issues before they show up in client calls

Military Exercise Planner (JOMIS)

Location: Remote — United States
Security Clearance: Active Secret Required
Travel: Regular domestic and international travel

Support Military Medical Readiness Through Exercise Planning

Rackner is seeking an experienced Military Exercise Planner to support the planning and execution of military medical exercises involving Joint Operational Medicine Information Systems (JOMIS).

In this role, you will help turn operational requirements into coordinated exercise plans, working alongside military stakeholders, training professionals, and technical teams. From initial planning conferences through live execution and after-action review, your work will contribute to realistic exercise preparation and operational medical readiness.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who understands military exercise operations, takes ownership of complex planning activities, and enjoys collaborating across mission-focused teams.

What You'll Do

  • Plan and coordinate JOMIS participation in military medical exercises throughout the planning, execution, and after-action phases.
  • Maintain integrated exercise plans, including planning conferences, schedules, milestones, deliverables, assigned responsibilities, and operational dependencies.
  • Develop concepts of operations (CONOPS) and supporting planning materials in collaboration with military and technical stakeholders.
  • Partner with training environment engineers to establish exercise data and scenario requirements, including injects and data-seeding specifications.
  • Organize execution schedules, personnel coverage, backup assignments, and operational handoffs to support live exercise activities.
  • Serve in primary or backup exercise support roles when needed, including participation in domestic and overseas planning conferences and exercise events.
  • Lead after-action reporting, document lessons learned, and coordinate follow-up activities with training and technical teams.

What You'll Bring

  • At least four years of military exercise planning experience, including work with relevant joint exercise planning processes and products such as Joint Event Life Cycle (JELC), MSEL/MESL, and Globally Integrated Exercise (GIE) activities.
  • Professional familiarity with JOMIS products and their use in military medical operations.
  • Experience developing exercise plans, coordinating operational activities, and preparing planning documentation.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with military stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • An active U.S. Government Secret security clearance.
  • Ability and willingness to travel worldwide to support planning conferences and military exercises.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Joint Staff J7 or military Service exercise programs.
  • Background supporting military medical exercises, including Ultimate Caduceus, Global Medic, or comparable events.

Why Rackner?

At Rackner, we develop and support technology solutions that help federal organizations carry out important missions. Our teams bring together technical expertise, practical problem-solving, and a commitment to meaningful mission outcomes.

You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of military exercise planning activities, collaborate with experienced operational and technical professionals, and contribute to the readiness of military medical technology.

Benefits & Perks

  • Company-supported certifications and professional development opportunities
  • 401(k) with 100% company match up to 6%
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Home-office equipment and remote-work support
  • Fitness and wellness reimbursement
  • Weekly pay and company team events

Work Arrangement

This is a remote-based position within the United States requiring regular domestic and international travel. Candidates must be able to support assigned exercise activities at military planning and exercise locations worldwide.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Rackner is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

Executive Talent Accelerator Programme
Canada · United States · United Kingdom

Put your experience to work developing others

Rutherford International welcomes expressions of interest from experienced executives, professional coaches and subject-matter specialists who can help professionals strengthen their performance, develop their judgement and prepare for greater responsibility.

Through the Executive Talent Accelerator, Rutherford matches assessed employees of enterprise clients with development expertise suited to their objectives, behavioural profiles and organisational circumstances.

This posting recruits independent providers of mentoring, coaching and specialist consulting services. It is an Evergreen Expression of Interest, not a current vacancy or a guaranteed assignment.

Augmenting internal career development

The Executive Talent Accelerator augments employers’ internal career and leadership development programmes with dedicated mentoring capacity, structured coaching and targeted specialist expertise.

Annual reviews can establish clear development priorities, but managers’ operational responsibilities may leave limited time for consistent guidance, practice and follow-up. Effective mentoring and coaching also require capabilities and interpersonal qualities that differ from those needed to manage performance.

Rutherford provides additional support to help employees act on agreed development objectives, working alongside their employer’s internal programme.

Three distinct ways to contribute

Executive Mentors

Provide longer-term, holistic guidance grounded in personal experience, career wisdom and relevant leadership responsibilities. Mentors help participants examine career direction, navigate organisational challenges, strengthen judgement and prepare for broader responsibilities.

Effective mentors explain their reasoning, share relevant experience and help participants develop their own judgement.

Executive Coaches

Provide structured, focused support for short-term skill development and performance improvement. Coaches help participants establish specific objectives, practise new approaches and review progress against agreed outcomes.

Assignments may address communication, delegation, stakeholder relationships, leadership behaviours or readiness for a defined responsibility.

Subject-Matter Specialist Consultants

Provide focused expertise addressing a particular functional, technical or business need. Specialists may explain a method, examine a decision, review work or help participants apply unfamiliar knowledge.

The scope, intended contribution and limits of the advice are established for each assignment. Implementation work is agreed separately.

Professionals may offer more than one service. Suitability and engagement scope are considered separately for each role.

Who should register

We welcome:

  • Current and former executives with relevant leadership experience and a demonstrated ability to develop others.
  • Professional coaches who can explain their methods, qualifications and evidence of contribution.
  • Senior functional and technical specialists who can translate expertise into practical learning.
  • Experienced consultants interested in supporting enterprise-sponsored development.

A distinguished career or senior title alone does not establish mentoring or coaching capability. We look for evidence that you can listen, explain, challenge appropriately and adapt your approach to another person’s needs.

Assessment and matching

Rutherford evaluates providers across three complementary areas:

  • Functional expertise:demonstrated knowledge, judgement and relevant experience.
  • Development capability:the ability to mentor, coach or teach effectively within the service offered.
  • Service orientation and relationship fit:the motivation and interpersonal capacity to support another person’s progress.

The RutherfordINTEL Assessment informs curator review alongside professional history, qualifications, references and examples of developmental work.

Matching considers the employee’s objectives, behavioural profile, enterprise context and practical needs, together with the provider’s expertise, approach and availability.

Working with Rutherford and enterprise clients

Rutherford International markets the Executive Talent Accelerator, holds and manages the enterprise client relationship, coordinates development mandates and matches providers to participating employees.

Providers deliver agreed services as independent contractors to Rutherford International. Each assignment establishes the scope, objectives, professional fees, time commitment, reporting requirements and engagement terms.

Providers are expected to:

  • Prepare thoroughly and deliver relevant, actionable guidance.
  • Maintain accurate timesheets and submit them through the agreed process.
  • Support development objectives aligned with the client’s internal programme.
  • Respect confidentiality and agreed information-sharing boundaries.
  • Disclose conflicts and work within their professional competence.
  • Distinguish developmental support from management authority or separately commissioned implementation work.
  • Review progress and raise concerns when the match or scope needs to change.

Employer sponsorship does not automatically provide access to private assessment results or confidential development discussions.

Assessment, membership and assignment fees

Initial expression of interest — Free

Registering creates no payment obligation.

Assessment and feedback — USD $250

If invited to proceed, this stage includes behavioural and leadership profiling, relevant benchmark interpretation and professional feedback.

Clearinghouse directory membership — USD $125 per month, with a 12-month term

For accepted members, membership includes assistance with the Rutherford Consultant Thesis™, business-development profiling, talent promotion, lead generation, sector research community access and career or project-success advisory support.

Rutherford-managed Accelerator assignments

Rutherford invoices the enterprise client for agreed services delivered by the provider.

Rutherford retains20% of professional billings, excluding applicable taxes. The provider receives the remaining80% of professional billings, subject to the agreed engagement terms.

This service fee isadditional to the monthly directory membership feeand reflects Rutherford’s client acquisition, matching, programme coordination, client relationship management and billing responsibilities.

Membership does not guarantee assignments or income.

Conversion to employment

If a consulting assignment converts to employment with the contracting client, the client pays a conversion fee of25% of annual salary and bonus income before six months from the assignment’s start, or20% from six months to one year.

Rutherford International retains agency rights for12 months after the consulting assignment ends.

Register your interest

Select“I’m interested”to complete Rutherford International’s Talent Registration form.

Indicate whether you wish to be considered as an executive mentor, executive coach, subject-matter specialist consultant or a combination of these roles.

Following initial review, a curator may invite you to provide further information and proceed to assessment and membership consideration.

Registration does not guarantee acceptance, representation, a client introduction or an assignment.
