6. Year-end and CPA collaboration: tax-ready books, a year-end package a CPA can work from directly, and Forms 1099 prepared on time.

7. AI-assisted bookkeeping. Providers should demonstrate at least one year of AI-assisted bookkeeping in their practice (for example, AI-assisted categorization, reconciliation or reporting). We look for:

  • Tools:any mainstream assistant, such as Intuit Assist in QuickBooks, Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.
  • A clear method for checking AI output: tying every AI-proposed category or match back to the bank statement or source document, reviewing each AI-proposed entry before it posts, and keeping client financial data inside tools the client approves.

8. Clear written communication: concise month-end summaries, precise questions, and plain-language explanations a busy CEO can act on quickly.

Where a qualification names years, equivalent depth gained in fewer years counts; tell us how.

Fee, service levels and term

How to respond

Submit your practice's qualifications: a capability statement, résumés of the people who would personally perform the work, and answers to the response questions. The questions cover your legal business name and form, years in practice, the number of current clients and their industries, ProAdvisor status, insurance in force, who personally performs the work, your proposed monthly fee, your licenses, where the practice performs its services, one example of AI-assisted bookkeeping, and any existing relationship with goCloudOffice®. Job Description

Atlas - Property and Construction Lead

Work Schedule: Full-Time, Remote with regular travel to properties globally (domestic and international travel required)

Location: San Francisco Bay Area

Start Date: ASAP

Salary Range: $250,000 - $325,000

Overview

A distinguished family office seeks an exceptional Property and Construction Lead to oversee a prestigious global portfolio of residential estates and high-value construction projects. This executive-level position serves as the principal's strategic representative across all property operations, ensuring the family's vision for excellence is realized while maintaining the highest standards of quality, discretion, and operational efficiency.

The successful candidate will be the cornerstone of property portfolio management, seamlessly coordinating between architects, owners representatives, contractors, designers, and property managers while representing ownership interests in all construction and development matters. This role demands someone who can navigate complex construction projects with sophisticated mechanical systems, anticipate challenges before they arise, and deliver solutions with minimal principal involvement.

We seek a meticulously caring professional who combines deep construction expertise with exceptional foresight and the ability to see around corners. The ideal candidate thrives in autonomous environments, demonstrates extraordinary attention to detail, and approaches challenges with creative problem-solving capabilities. This position requires someone who understands the nuances of refined residential properties and can maintain the principal's vision while managing diverse stakeholders across multiple time zones.

This opportunity offers the chance to shape and protect a family's real estate legacy while working in an environment that values autonomy, innovation, and work-life balance. The role is perfect for someone who appreciates the art of refined living spaces and believes in creating seamless property experiences that exceed the highest expectations.

Expectations
  • Minimum eight years of progressive leadership experience in estate management, high-end construction oversight, or property portfolio management with demonstrated success managing complex residential projects featuring advanced mechanical systems and integrated technologies.
  • Proven expertise in construction management with the ability to represent ownership interests effectively in OAC meetings, architectural reviews, and contractor negotiations while ensuring adherence to design intent, quality standards, and project timelines.
  • Exceptional ability to autonomously solve problems and think creatively with minimal information, demonstrating the foresight to anticipate challenges and develop comprehensive solutions before issues arise.
  • Meticulous level of care and attention to detail with the ability to retain complex information, think through scenarios others might miss, and identify potential concerns in architectural plans, construction specifications, and property operations.
  • Advanced proficiency in modern communication platforms, particularly Signal and Google Workspace, with demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools and technology to enhance operational efficiency and decision-making.
  • Strong financial acumen with experience managing multi-million dollar construction budgets, capital expenditure planning, and vendor contract negotiations while identifying cost optimization opportunities without compromising quality.
  • High emotional intelligence with exceptional discretion and the ability to work effectively with private families, maintaining appropriate professional boundaries while building trust and demonstrating genuine care for the principal's interests.
  • Demonstrated thoughtfulness and strategic thinking with the ability to provide comprehensive problem analysis and solution recommendations, clearly articulating the rationale behind each recommendation to leadership.
  • Experience working in autonomous, remote environments with the self-discipline to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously while maintaining clear communication channels and meeting aggressive deadlines.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally and domestically as required, with flexibility to be available for urgent matters and the understanding that proximity to properties requires immediate availability when needed.
  • Spanish language proficiency is highly valued for effective communication with international teams and vendors across the global property portfolio.
  • Bachelor's degree required; background in construction management, engineering, architecture, or hospitality preferred with additional value placed on startup experience or entrepreneurial mindsets.
Responsibilities
  • Portfolio Excellence: Oversee a distinguished global portfolio of residences across multiple locations, ensuring each property consistently operates at the highest standards while maintaining the principal's aesthetic vision and quality expectations through regular site visits and comprehensive oversight protocols.
  • Construction Leadership: Serve as the principal's authoritative voice in weekly OAC meetings and construction reviews, ensuring all projects align with design intent, budget parameters, and timeline requirements while proactively identifying and resolving potential challenges before they impact project delivery.
  • Strategic Property Operations: Develop and implement comprehensive maintenance programs across all properties, including quarterly preventative maintenance protocols, long-term capital planning, and immediate response systems for critical issues while ensuring minimal disruption to the principal's use and enjoyment of the properties.
  • Team Orchestration: Lead and coordinate a distributed team of property managers, maintenance professionals, and specialized vendors across multiple time zones, serving as the escalation point for maintenance requests, renovation approvals, and capital project decisions while fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.
  • Vendor Excellence: Source, evaluate, and manage relationships with premier vendors across diverse disciplines including landscape architecture, security systems, AV/IT integration, MEP systems, and specialty residential technologies, ensuring all partners meet the family's exacting standards for quality and service.
  • Automobile Stewardship: Oversee the maintenance and logistics of the vehicle collection, ensuring proper care, service scheduling, and operational readiness while coordinating with specialized mechanics and service providers for unique vehicle requirements.
  • Financial Oversight: Track and analyze capital expenditures, operational budgets, and construction costs across the portfolio, providing regular reporting on financial performance, upcoming maintenance requirements, and potential cost optimization opportunities while maintaining complete transparency with leadership.
  • Communication Hub: Function as the primary liaison between the principal, architects, general contractors, designers, and other stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, aligned expectations, and seamless coordination across all parties while filtering information appropriately to minimize principal involvement in routine matters.
  • Technology Integration: Implement and maintain sophisticated digital solutions for project management, communication, and property oversight, ensuring all systems are optimized for efficiency and accessibility while maintaining the highest standards of digital security and privacy
Benefits
  • Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: 100% employer-paid health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Retirement Planning: 401(k) program currently being established
  • Philanthropic Matching: 100% matching for charitable contributions
  • Time Off: 2-3+ weeks paid vacation plus holidays, with the understanding that urgent matters may require availability
  • Professional Growth: Professional development opportunities and exposure to world-class construction and design professionals
  • Work Environment: Remote work flexibility with the autonomy to manage your schedule while meeting property and project requirements

Important Note: This role operates within a lean, high-performing team environment where self-direction and creative problem-solving are essential. The successful candidate will have access to substantial resources and support while maintaining the autonomy to drive results independently.

jobs.title: ERP Program Manager
jobs.excerpt: Who we areWELL Health Technologies is an innovative technology-enabled healthcare company whose overarching objective is to positively impact health outcomes by leveraging technology to empower and support healthcare practitioners and their patients.
jobs.description:
Who we are

WELL Health Technologies is an innovative technology-enabled healthcare company whose overarching objective is to positively impact health outcomes by leveraging technology to empower and support healthcare practitioners and their patients.

WELL has built an innovative practitioner enablement platform that includes comprehensive end to end practice management tools inclusive of virtual care and digital patient engagement capabilities as well as Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and data protection services. WELL Health Technologies, uses this platform to power healthcare practitioners both inside and outside of WELL Health Technologies’ own omni-channel patient services offerings.

WELL owns and operates Canada’s largest network of outpatient medical clinics serving primary and specialized healthcare services and is the provider of a leading multi-national multi-disciplinary telehealth offering. WELL Health Technologies is publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol “WELL”.

To learn more about the company, please visit: www.well.company.

The opportunity

Reporting to theSystem Lead - Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP, we are hiring an ERP Program Manager to lead the delivery of ERP initiatives across WELL Health. As the new ERP Program Manager, you will bring structure and momentum to a growing portfolio of ERP initiatives. You will take ownership of different project work streams, bringing together business teams and external technology partners to deliver agreed outcomes. Working closely with Finance, Operations, IT, and vendors, you will manage priorities, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables, address challenges that affect progress, and ensure commitments translate into results. As WELL establishes its dedicated ERP function, you will help shape how projects are managed, strengthen vendor accountability, and create greater visibility into delivery across the organization.

This is a newly created, full-time, one-year contract role based in Canada.

What’s in it for you

Impact. You will join WELL at an important stage in establishing its dedicated ERP function, with the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution from the outset. Over the course of your contract, you will help strengthen project delivery, establish vendor accountability, and advance ERP initiatives that support the business.

Ownership. You will be trusted to lead ERP initiatives, manage external technology partners, and represent the ERP function in project discussions. You will have the opportunity to influence decisions, resolve delivery challenges, and see the results of your work in completed projects and improvements across the business.

Exposure. You will work on a mix of ERP enhancements, integrations, and larger initiatives, partnering with Finance, Operations, IT, and external technology providers. As WELL develops its ERP function, you will contribute to projects at different stages, bringing structure to new priorities and helping turn business needs into delivered solutions.

As our new ERP Program Manager, you will:

  • Deliver ERP initiatives. You will take ownership of multiple ERP projects, coordinating plans, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables from initiation through completion. Working with business and technology stakeholders, you will establish priorities, resolve issues, and ensure projects meet agreed requirements.
  • Strengthen vendor relationships. You will manage project relationships with external technology partners, establishing clear expectations for scope, timelines, and deliverables. You will monitor commitments, address gaps in performance, and escalate issues when needed to keep work progressing.
  • Connect business needs with technology delivery. You will collaborate with Finance, Operations, IT, and external partners to clarify requirements, align priorities, and coordinate the work needed to deliver ERP improvements. You will help teams navigate dependencies and make decisions that move initiatives forward.
  • Manage priorities and provide visibility. You will maintain a clear view of progress, risks, outstanding decisions, and next steps across multiple initiatives. You will lead project discussions, identify potential delays, and provide the ERP leader and stakeholders with timely updates and recommendations.
  • Improve how ERP projects are delivered. You will help establish practical project management, tracking, and reporting processes as the ERP function develops. You will create consistency in how work is organized, commitments are monitored, and outcomes are communicated.

Here’s what you bring:

  • The ERP experience. You have managed or taken ownership of ERP projects, implementations, enhancements, or integrations, coordinating activities and deliverables across business and technology teams. You understand how ERP systems support business processes. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations is an asset, but experience with other ERP platforms is welcome.
  • The vendor management skills. You have worked directly with external implementation partners, consultants, or technology vendors, managing expectations, tracking commitments, and addressing delivery challenges. You can hold partners accountable while maintaining productive working relationships.
  • The project management approach. You can organize multiple priorities, establish realistic plans, manage dependencies, and identify risks before they affect delivery. You know when to resolve an issue, involve stakeholders, or escalate a decision. Familiarity with Azure DevOps, monday.com, or similar tools is an asset.
  • The relationship-building skills. You can work effectively with Finance, Operations, IT, business leaders, and external partners, communicating clearly and building alignment around shared priorities. You are comfortable leading discussions, asking questions, and addressing competing expectations constructively.
  • The ownership and adaptability. You are comfortable working in a developing function where priorities and processes continue to evolve. You can create structure, make informed recommendations, and follow through on commitments while remaining responsive to business needs.

Why join us?

Healthcare is our sector, and we know that for WELL to be a winning team, we must provide an open environment to prioritize health and wellbeing and multiple resources to discuss mental, physical, and psychological needs openly. From the CEO to the newest hire, everyone comes together as part of our culture of respect, openness, support, and communication. We unite to empower each other to be the best we can be.

We recognize that the best way to serve our diverse patient communities is by reflecting that diversity. With almost 65% of our team members identifying as female and 70% of our leadership identifying as a visible minority, we are proud of our diverse, equitable and inclusive organization.

Apply now

Interested in applying but worried you don't have it all? At WELL, we know not everyone gains their experience following a traditional path. If you share our values, want to make a difference in healthcare technology solutions, and meet 70% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. Express your interest here.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • A virtual interview with the System Lead to discuss your ERP project delivery experience, approach to vendor management, and ability to manage priorities and resolve delivery challenges.
  • A final interview with the VP, Business Transformation to explore how you collaborate, approach problem-solving, and contribute to a developing ERP function.

Compensation

The anticipated annualized salary range for this full-time, one-year contract position is $90,000–$120,000 CAD. The salary will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and the needs of the organization. At WELL, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation and aim to provide a competitive salary that reflects the value and expertise of the successful candidate.

WELL is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace. We welcome and celebrate the diversity of applicants and team members across ability, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, and lived experience. We strive to create an environment where differences are valued and contribute to our collective success – this is the WELL Way.

WELL has been independently certified as a Great Place to Work® by the Great Place to Work Institute® Canada. This recognition reflects our commitment to building a workplace culture rooted in trust, inclusivity, and employee well-being. It also aligns with our Healthy Place to Work pillar and the priorities outlined in our annual Sustainability Impact Report.

About CodeRoad

CodeRoad provides end-to-end software development services, helping businesses scale with ideal infrastructure solutions. From staff augmentation to dedicated IT teams and general software engineering, our nearshore technology services empower businesses to thrive in an ever-evolving digital landscape

About the Role

As a Senior Agentic AI Developer, you will serve as the technical backbone of our AI engineering initiatives, designing, building, and deploying production-ready AI agents and agentic workflows. You will architect autonomous systems leveraging cutting-edge LLM frameworks, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to seamlessly connect AI agents with complex enterprise infrastructures and data ecosystems.

This role is critical to transforming business requirements into scalable, secure, and highly reliable agentic solutions on AWS. You will anchor technical execution and architectural strategy, establishing robust evaluation, observability, and human-in-the-loop guardrails while guiding nearshore development teams through the entire lifecycle of production AI deployment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect & Build: Design, develop, and scale autonomous agentic workflows and multi-agent systems using LangGraph, CrewAI, or Agent Development Kit (ADK).

  • Anchor Cloud Infrastructure: Own the cloud deployment and security architecture of LLM-powered applications on AWS, using Amazon Bedrock and scalable microservices.

  • Integrate & Orchestrate: Connect AI agents to enterprise APIs, data sources, and deterministic tools via Model Context Protocol (MCP) and workflow platforms like n8n.

  • Optimize Knowledge Systems: Build high-performance RAG pipelines and vector database integrations using Pinecone or Weaviate to optimize contextual retrieval and reranking.

  • Evaluate & Secure: Implement end-to-end evaluation, guardrails, and security measures—including task-success metrics, hallucination checks, and protection against prompt injection.

  • Monitor & Mentor: Lead system observability using tools like LangSmith, Langtrace, or AgentOps while mentoring engineering PODs in Python and AI development best practices.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years in professional software engineering, with 2–3+ years dedicated to LLM application engineering and agentic AI systems.

  • Tech Stack: Advanced Python, AWS (Amazon Bedrock), LangGraph / CrewAI, Vector DBs (Pinecone, Weaviate), RAG architecture, and MCP integration.

  • Observability & Eval Tools: Hands-on experience with LangSmith, Langtrace, or AgentOps, along with evaluation frameworks for LLM groundedness and accuracy.

  • Soft Skills: Strong ownership mindset, technical leadership, and the ability to mentor developers and articulate complex architecture to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Language Skills:Advanced English (written and spoken) is mandatory.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to reinforcement learning and advanced multi-agent coordination architectures.

  • Hands-on experience building user-facing AI interfaces with Chainlit, Streamlit, or React.

  • Multicloud experience with Azure AI or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

What You’ll Love

  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in Latin America.

  • Holidays Off: Observe local national holidays.

  • Paid Time Off: Generous PTO policies for rest and personal time.

  • Health Insurance Assistance: Financial support for your healthcare coverage.

  • Competitive USD Compensation: Earn top-tier market rates pegged to the US Dollar.

  • Growth Opportunities: Continuous career evolution within high-impact global projects.

jobs.description:
Our Client is a long-established and highly-regarded Central and Eastern European technology provider specialising in designing, building, and operating advanced, mission-critical software solutions for large international organisations. With over 25 years of history and a team of 600+ top-tier software engineers across Europe, they are a certified partner for high-stakes industries including Aerospace & Defence, Automotive, Telecommunications, and Financial Services. They hold rigorous quality and security certifications such as NATO AQAP and TISAX.

This specific role involves working with a leading European client to develop and maintain their sophisticated cloud platform. You will be responsible for defining the DevOps architecture and strategy for solutions built primarily on Microsoft Azure and Kubernetes. You will be a key player in ensuring that highly available, scalable, and secure cloud-native architectures are implemented, managing the full lifecycle from Infrastructure as Code (IaC) development through to CI/CD and observability. This is a chance to apply your senior expertise to complex, enterprise-grade cloud environments.

Responsibilities

As a Senior DevOps Engineer specialising in AI and Data, you will be key to architecting and maintaining the infrastructure that supports large-scale AI/ML workloads. Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Platform Deployment and Management: Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure cloud infrastructure for AI and Big Data solutions, ensuring high availability and performance in a production environment.
  • AI/ML Infrastructure Automation: Implement end-to-end automation for the complete Machine Learning (ML) lifecycle, including infrastructure for model training, real-time inference, and data processing.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop, manage, and optimise Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform to provision and configure cloud resources consistently and efficiently.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Development: Create, manage, and improve robust Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to enable rapid and safe deployment of code, models, and infrastructure changes.
  • Kubernetes for AI/Data: Manage and optimise Kubernetes clusters (e.g., AKS, EKS, or GKE) specifically tailored for running containerised data processing frameworks and GPU-enabled ML workloads at scale.
  • Monitoring and Observability: Establish advanced monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to ensure the health, performance, and cost efficiency of the data and AI platforms.
  • Security and Governance: Implement security measures, access controls, and compliance frameworks to ensure data privacy, model governance, and adherence to security best practices across all environments.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Scientists, AI Engineers, and Software Development teams to translate complex AI requirements into robust, deployable infrastructure solutions.

Requirements

  • Proven DevOps Experience: Strong professional background (5+ years) in a DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Engineering role, focusing on mission-critical production systems.
  • Cloud Platform Expertise: Extensive, hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP), particularly related to infrastructure and networking.
  • Kubernetes for Production: Expert-level knowledge of Kubernetes administration, operation, and optimisation for high-performance workloads, including scaling and resource management.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Deep practical experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and state management.
  • CI/CD Systems: Proficiency in designing and managing automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI).
  • Data/ML Tooling: Experience with tools and frameworks commonly used in the Data/AI domain, such as Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Databricks, or specific AI/ML tooling infrastructure.
  • Scripting: Solid proficiency in scripting languages like Python or Bash for automation, testing, and system integration.
  • Monitoring: Experience implementing and working with observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or cloud-native monitoring).

Our Client Offers

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT EVERYDAY DOSEEveryday Dose is a functional coffee company on a mission to help people feel better, think clearer, and perform at their best, without the crash that comes with regular coffee.
jobs.description:
ABOUT EVERYDAY DOSE

Everyday Dose is a functional coffee company on a mission to help people feel better, think clearer, and perform at their best, without the crash that comes with regular coffee. We're a fast-growing, nine-figure D2C brand with a loyal, high-retention subscriber base, and we're scaling our retention function to match our ambitions.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Shopper Marketing Manager to own shopper marketing across Everyday Dose’s conventional and regional grocery accounts, including Kroger and its banners, Publix, Hy-Vee, Raley’s, Dierbergs, Fareway, and other regional retailers.

Reporting to the VP, Product & Retail Marketing, you’ll build and execute each account’s shopper marketing plan and budget—from promotions and retail media to in-store programs, demos, retailer content, and creator activations.

You’ll work closely with Sales to translate account priorities into strong shopper programs, while partnering cross-functionally with Field Marketing, Brand, Finance, and agency partners. This role requires someone who can think strategically about the business while staying close enough to the execution to make sure programs launch successfully and deliver measurable results.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. The position is fully remote and open to candidates based in the U.S., with approximately 10% travel for store visits, trade shows, and team gatherings.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You’ll take primary ownership of four core areas of our grocery shopper marketing program:

  • Shopper Strategy & Planning: Build the shopper marketing plan and budget for each grocery account, including the marketing portion of joint business plans and account-specific launch strategies.
  • Retail Media & Activation: Lead retail media, promotions, in-store programs, demos, retailer content, and creator activations that drive awareness, trial, and conversion.
  • Measurement & Budget Management: Own shopper marketing spend, accruals, and performance measurement, turning results and retail data into clear recommendations.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Sales, Field Marketing, Brand, Finance, and agency partners to develop and execute programs that support retailer and business priorities.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build shopper plans: Develop the shopper marketing strategy, annual plan, and budget for each grocery account, including the marketing section of joint business plans.
  • Own the promotional calendar: Partner with Sales and Finance to build promotional and in-store calendars spanning digital coupons, aisle offers, signage, displays, and other account-specific programs.
  • Support new launches: Build shopper marketing toolkits and activation plans for new product launches across grocery accounts.
  • Lead retail media: Brief and manage retail media across platforms such as Kroger 84.51 and other retailer media networks in partnership with media partners.
  • Own retailer content: Manage retailer brand pages, product page copy, and supporting content while ensuring execution stays consistent with Everyday Dose brand guidelines.
  • Manage creator programs: Lead influencer and creator programs for retail accounts, including briefing, creator selection, content development, and performance measurement in partnership with the Brand team.
  • Drive in-store activation: Set demo priorities with Field Marketing and manage programs such as Catalina and Inmar across regional retailers.
  • Manage the budget: Own shopper marketing spend tracking and accruals in partnership with Finance and make thoughtful decisions about where to allocate investment.
  • Measure performance: Analyze program and promotional results, including SPINS data, and turn findings into clear recommendations for future investment and activation.
  • Partner with Sales: Keep account managers informed before programs go live and bring performance results and learnings into retailer line reviews.
  • Work cross-functionally: Partner closely with Brand, Field Marketing, Finance, Sales, and agencies to keep programs aligned, on brand, and moving forward.

Requirements

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5–8 years of shopper marketing or retail marketing experience within a CPG brand or shopper marketing agency.
  • Hands-on experience within conventional grocery, including major accounts such as Kroger or similar retailers, along with regional grocery accounts such as Publix or comparable banners.
  • Food and beverage CPG experience, ideally within a mid-sized or high-growth consumer brand.
  • Experience building shopper marketing plans and owning budgets across multiple programs and retailer accounts.
  • Working knowledge of retail media and offer platforms, with experience using platforms such as Kroger 84.51 or similar networks.
  • Comfortable working with SPINS or similar retail data and translating performance into clear business recommendations.
  • Familiarity with retailer portals, brand page and content tools, and influencer or creator programs.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to evaluate promotional effectiveness and make thoughtful budget allocation decisions.
  • Strong strategic thinking with the ability to connect individual shopper programs to broader account and brand objectives.
  • A strong eye for design and the judgment to recognize whether shopper marketing materials and retailer content are clear, compelling, and on brand.
  • Clear, confident communication skills and the ability to work effectively with Sales and other cross-functional partners.
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple retailers, programs, deadlines, budgets, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities may shift and you’ll need to balance strategy with hands-on execution.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and Excel.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within your first two quarters, you’ve taken ownership of the shopper marketing plans and budgets across our grocery accounts and built strong working relationships with Sales, Field Marketing, Brand, Finance, and agency partners.

Our promotional and in-store calendars are clearly planned, retail media and creator programs are executing smoothly, and account teams have visibility into what’s launching and why. You’re consistently measuring results, using SPINS and other available data to understand what’s working, and translating those insights into clear recommendations about where we should invest next.

Most importantly, you’re helping us build a more strategic and measurable grocery shopper marketing program that strengthens our retailer partnerships and drives sustainable retail growth.

Benefits

COMPENSATION RANGE

The typical salary range for this position is: $110,000 - $130,000

This role is also eligible for a 10% bonus.

The actual salary offer will take into account multiple factors, including skills, experience, education, and location. Please note that the salary details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, not total compensation, which includes bonus and benefits.

BENEFITS

Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance

Everyday Dose offers comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and prescription plan coverage for all team members working 32+ hours per week. Eligibility begins on the first of the month following your start date, and we cover 75% of employee premiums.

401K Match

Starting on the first day of your fourth month with the company, you are eligible to participate in our company-sponsored 401(k) plan. The company offers a match of up to 80% of your contributions, capped at 5% of your salary.

Flexible Wellness Credits

At Everyday Dose, we prioritize your health and well-being. To support you, we provide salaried employees a $500 monthly wellness credit through JOON, which can be used for a variety of health and wellness-related services.

Helpr Support for Families

At Everyday Dose, we know that supporting our team means supporting their families too. That’s why we partner with Helpr — a modern backup childcare and family support platform that gives employees access to vetted, reliable caregivers. Helpr is here to make sure our team has trusted childcare support when they need it most — at home and at work.

About Chainlink Labs

Chainlink Labs is one of the primary contributing developers of Chainlink, the standard for onchain finance enabling high-quality data, secure cross-chain interoperability, and compliant connectivity across global markets. Chainlink powers leading tokenized assets, financial institutions, market infrastructures, and decentralized applications by providing secure access to real-world data, cross-chain messaging, and blockchain connectivity across any network. The Chainlink standard has enabled tens of trillions of dollars in transaction value and is helping unify global markets onchain. Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, Aave, Polymarket, Lido, and many others.

Chainlink Labs is a world-class team of developers, researchers, and capital markets experts, and has ranked among Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology, Fortune's Best Medium Workplace, and the Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces. Learn more at or.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior People Operations Generalist to support the People Relations and Compliance workstreams across our global team. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on hands-on ownership of complex employee relations matters and investigations, alongside stewardship of People policies and execution of the People Operations compliance program.

You’ll manage investigations from intake through findings and recommendations, help strengthen the existing investigations program, and own the People Operations contribution to SOC 2 personnel controls and audit readiness. You’ll also support compliance-related escalations, including conflict-of-interest reports and accommodation requests. You’ll partner closely with the Director of People Operations, Legal, Security, and other People team members, and serve as an experienced thought partner to other People Generalists. This role is designed for someone who wants to deepen their impact as a practitioner and mentor, rather than move into people management.

Our AI strategy: We’re building an AI-forward People team. In this role you’ll use AI daily, and build with it: designing agents and workflows that make investigations, compliance, and case management faster and more consistent, while keeping human judgment at the center of every sensitive decision.

Your Impact

  • Manage complex employee relations matters and investigations end to end, including intake, investigation planning, interviews, documentation, findings, and recommendations.

  • Partner with the Director of People Operations on case strategy, outcome decisions, and executive-level escalations.

  • Support employees, consultants, and other worker types across the company’s global footprint, applying sound judgment across varied local contexts.

  • Own the People Operations contribution to SOC 2 personnel controls, including evidence tracking, audit support, and follow-up on remediation items in partnership with Legal, Security, and other stakeholders.

  • Own the day-to-day stewardship of People policies, including maintaining documentation, coordinating reviews, and recommending updates in partnership with Legal and Security. Bring substantive policy decisions to the Director of People Operations.

  • Support compliance-related escalations, such as conflict-of-interest reports and accommodation requests, in partnership with the Director, Legal, Security, and other People team members as appropriate.

  • Contribute to the ongoing improvement of the investigations program, including its processes, documentation, and guidance.

  • Serve as a thought partner to other People Generalists, sharing expertise and helping them navigate complex cases and investigations.

  • Identify practical opportunities to improve consistency, quality, and efficiency across People Relations and Compliance work.

Requirements

  • At least 8 years experience in People Operations, Employee Relations, HR, or a related field, with deep hands-on experience managing employee relations matters and workplace investigations.

  • Experience conducting investigations end to end, including interviews, evidence gathering, documentation, and developing clear findings and recommendations.

  • Experience with HR policy stewardship and compliance work, including audit support, control evidence, or related program execution.

  • Experience supporting a globally distributed workforce and navigating complex employee relations matters across multiple jurisdictions and employment arrangements.

  • Strong judgment and discretion when handling sensitive, confidential, or high-impact matters.

  • Ability to work across different jurisdictions and worker types, partnering effectively with Legal, Security, and business leaders.

  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear, thorough investigation documentation and practical guidance.

  • Ability to influence and mentor through expertise and collaboration, without relying on formal people-management authority.

  • Demonstrated fluency with AI tools, including the ability to assess when their use is appropriate, verify outputs, and follow safeguards for sensitive employee information.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience supporting employees and consultants across multiple countries and employment arrangements.

  • Familiarity with SOC 2 personnel controls and evidence requirements.

  • Experience improving an established investigations or compliance program.

  • Experience supporting compliance-related matters such as conflict-of-interest reports or accommodation requests.

  • Experience using HR systems, case-management tools, and documentation platforms to manage sensitive work accurately.

  • Experience working in a remote or highly distributed organization.

Chainlink Labs is a remote-first organization and employment eligibility is contingent upon residing in an approved hiring jurisdiction. Team members may work outside their primary country of legal residence for a maximum of 90 days per calendar year. Please discuss your current location, legal residence, and work authorization with your recruiter during your initial conversation. Unless otherwise stated for a specific role, we require working hours that overlap with Eastern Time (ET).

We carefully review all applications and aim to provide a response to every candidate within two weeks after the job posting closes. The closing date is listed on the job advert, so we encourage you to take the time to thoughtfully prepare your application. We want to fully consider your experience and skills, and you will hear from us regarding the status of your application shortly after the closing date.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Chainlink Labs is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us via this form.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants

Information collected and processed as part of your Chainlink Labs Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to our Recruiting Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required.

Teach English Online!

  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income
  • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing
  • Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

We Are:

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world's leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services, creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent and innovation led company with 750,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries.

As a leader in Intelligent Operations, we help clients reimagine and transform their supply chains, making them faster, more resilient, and more sustainable. Our Operations practice brings together deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, AI-powered tools, and a global delivery network to help clients move from reactive operations to predictive, outcomes-driven enterprises. We don't just design solutions, we build and run them alongside our clients, driving measurable impact across every stage of the supply chain.


You Are:

Accenture is seeking an Operations Solution Architect Senior Manager, Supply Chain to play a pivotal role in designing and implementing complex, outcomes-driven solutions for our clients. You are a seasoned supply chain professional who combines deep functional expertise with sharp commercial instincts and the ability to build trusted relationships at the senior client level.


You thrive in a client-facing environment, are comfortable leading conversations at the C-suite level, and have the credibility to position yourself as a subject matter advisor. You know how to listen, ask the right questions, and translate what a client is telling you into a solution that draws on the best of what Accenture has to offer, including its people, processes, technology, and AI capabilities.

You operate as a single point of contact, or as part of a team on larger deals, accountable from Stage 1 through deal closure and transition to the delivery organization.


The Work:

  • Architect end-to-end solutions for large-scale managed services deals, with a focus on planning and forecasting, materials planning, sales and operations planning, order management and fulfillment, logistics coordination, inventory analysis, warranty and aftersales services, reverse logistics, and master data management
  • Lead client discovery and requirements-gathering sessions, building confidence with senior buyers by demonstrating deep domain knowledge and an ability to connect their business challenges to concrete, deliverable solutions
  • Orchestrate Accenture's full range of assets, including talent, processes, technology platforms, and AI and agentic tools, to design solutions that are commercially viable, operationally sound, and aligned to the client's desired business outcomes
  • Manage all industry group and vertical relationships, senior client buyer interactions, and functional owner engagements for the designated solution
  • Drive the necessary sign-off of the solution with proper input from industry groups and verticals on client business objectives, industry context, risk assessment, budget, and preferences
  • Manage the sales team and Subject Matter Experts required during the sales process, and coordinate communication and collaboration with the delivery organization
  • Direct and coordinate with legal, commercial and regulatory teams to ensure all solution components adhere to standards and contractual requirements
  • Collaborate with industry groups and verticals to provide input to Terms and Conditions, and in some cases be accountable for specific contractual terms
  • Develop cost model estimates working with delivery organizations and the pricing and commercial team to deliver the defined scope of services
  • Align the final solution architecture, including statement of work, schedules, and other contractual documents, with final terms and conditions
  • Identify leadership contacts for service transition and operations, and ensure appropriate solution plan handover for closed deals
  • Apply knowledge of AI and agentic tools to identify where intelligent automation, AI-assisted workflows, and autonomous process agents can be embedded within client solutions to drive efficiency and outcomes
  • Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and evolving best practices in supply chain managed services, bringing market-leading perspectives to every client engagement

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's What You Need

  • Minimum of 8 years of experience as a Solution Architect, Business Consultant, or similar role within supply chain, operations, or managed services, with hands-on knowledge across planning, fulfillment, logistics, and aftersales services
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Supply Chain As-a-Service or supply chain managed services
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in business development, sales strategy, and/or proposal development roles
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience with outsourcing, solution planning, and deal shaping
  • Minimum of 1 year and working knowledge of leading supply chain technology platforms, including but not limited to SAP (S/4HANA, IBP), Blue Yonder, o9 Solutions, and Oracle SCM Cloud. Candidates are not expected to be implementation specialists, but should have sufficient platform familiarity to engage credibly with a client's IT and supply chain technology teams on integration requirements, system connectivity, and the role each platform plays within a managed services operating model
  • Minimum of 1 year and demonstrated proficiency in working with AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, GPT, or Copilot as part of day-to-day work, and an understanding of how AI and agentic solutions can be applied within supply chain operating models
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus Points:

  • Advanced degree such as an MBA or equivalent
  • Knowledge of source-to-pay functions including strategic sourcing, category management, procure-to-pay, tail spend management, and accounts payable, as a complement to supply chain expertise
  • Experience with Negotiate to Close and Win Strategy Development
  • Value Proposition Development and Business Case Development
  • Solution Configuration and Solution Planning for Outsourcing Methodology
  • Pricing Strategy and Execution
  • Service Transition and Solution Realization methodology
  • Understanding of automation and agentic AI trends in the supply chain and operations marketplace
  • Strong analytical skills with advanced expertise in Excel and PowerPoint

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

About the role

Our team acts as the engine that ensures our leaders use their time on the most highly-leveraged work.

You’ll be responsible for the leadership team’s calendars, travel, and relationships and provide other operational, strategic, and project support as needed. You'll be incredibly close to the leaders helping to bring AI products to the world.

This role is based in Malaysia. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. Occasional travel may be needed for this unique role.

Your responsibilities would include

  • Act as a confidante and strategic partner to our leadership staff by ensuring their time is spent on the most leveraged activities

  • Make recommendations regarding time management, prioritization, and delegation

  • Coordinate meetings and clear conflicts for our senior leadership team; ensure critical meetings aren’t missed or delayed and are prioritized accordingly

  • Arrange flight, hotel, car, and restaurant reservations for members of this group, and perform other administrative tasks as needed

  • Work with our recruiting team to coordinate interviews for technical/business leaders and collect their timely feedback

  • Work on special projects on an as-needed basis


Experience we're seeking

  • You have 5-7 years of experience in an executive support role or similar support function

  • You've worked with technical or business leaders and supported multiple leaders in the past

  • You’ve worked in a high-growth startup, investment banking, or similar environment

  • You've managed and optimized extremely busy calendars

  • You're fluent in Google Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Gmail, and other modern productivity software, and are excited to learn and use new tools


Our team & culture

We’re a lean, high-performance team that moves fast and holds a high bar. Titles don’t matter here - output, integrity, and ownership do. Everyone is expected to roll up their sleeves, contribute meaningfully, and take initiative.

We reward people who think like owners. We value speed, clarity, and relentless ownership. If you’re hungry to grow and care deeply about excellence, this is your kind of environment.


What will you get

  • Competitive salary and trusted position supporting a high-level leader

  • A dynamic, fast-moving environment where you’re valued for your reliability and ownership

  • Occasional exposure to business-side support for broader growth and experience


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Hong Kong. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Hong Kong.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Data Center Demand Planning Specialist

Location: Remote

Role Overview

We are seeking a Supply Chain Operations / Data Center Demand Planning Specialist with hands-on planning expertise and experience supporting operational excellence, analytics, and business transformation. The role combines demand forecasting, supply and inventory planning, cross-functional execution, and continuous improvement with opportunities to support Global Capability Center (GCC) operating models, data centers, and technology-enabled transformation.

Key Responsibilities

Supply Chain Operations & Demand Planning

  • Develop and optimize demand forecasts, supply plans, inventory strategies, and service-level performance
  • Analyze historical demand, market trends, capacity, lead times, stocking models, safety stock, and inventory risk
  • Collaborate with procurement, manufacturing, logistics, sales, and regional stakeholders to align demand and supply; support planning and execution
  • Align procurement plans with deployment schedules for servers, racks, networking equipment, power systems, cooling infrastructure, and other critical components
  • Balance inventory availability, safety stock, and working capital while minimizing shortages, excess inventory, and obsolescence

Supply Chain Transformation & Global Capability Center (GCC) Enablement

  • Assess current-state processes and design future-state workflows, governance, controls, and scalable operating models
  • Support GCC setup, expansion, process transitions, knowledge transfer, and capability development where relevant
  • Contribute to transformation roadmaps, operational standardization, process optimization, and automation initiatives

Analytics, Planning Systems & Technology

🎯 Mission-driven engineering: Every service you build helps expand financial inclusion for under-banked populations

🏆 Global recognition: Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest-growing companies for five consecutive years (2022–2026)

What You'll Do

At M-KOPA, you'll build and operate distributed C# and .NET microservices on Azure, working within an event-driven architecture at significant scale. This is an outcomes-driven role: we care far more about the value you create than where you sit or how many hours you're online. You'll own what you build end-to-end — from idea, through implementation and deployment, into production and iteration.

Technical Environment 💻

  • Modern C# stack: Distributed C# and .NET microservices

  • Own it beyond the pull request: Design for idempotency, retries, out-of-order events, and failure modes, and know how your services behave in production

  • The Campfire Rule: Leave the systems you touch a little better than you found them

  • On-call as feedback, not heroics: Engineers who build our systems also help operate them, using incidents to make the platform more resilient

What You Need

We're looking for a senior engineer who's curious, autonomous, and highly trusted. You're comfortable owning the entire software stack — including supporting infrastructure — throughout its lifecycle, and you see production data, not just deployment, as the real measure of "done."

Required Experience:

  • Strong grasp of C# and .NET development

  • Experience with event-driven systems - We use Azure Service Bus, but would love to hear from you if you have experience with similar messaging technology (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)

  • Microservices architecture experience, ideally on Azure and Kubernetes

  • Experience using observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Application Insights) to understand production behaviour

  • Comfort using AI tools as part of a daily engineering workflow (design, code review, testing, incident investigation)

  • DevOps culture mindset, including on-call/production ownership

  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams across time zones

  • Continuous learning mindset and openness to feedback

Location & Benefits

  • Fully remote role, collaborating during core GMT working hours

  • Benefits package, which includes Bonus, Growth Shares & On-Call Allowance

  • Work with diverse teams distributed across UK, Europe, and Africa

  • Personalised training budget to support your development

  • Home office setup budget

  • Professional development programs and coaching partnerships

  • Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

Our technology has created measurable change:

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000 livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided since 2010 through clean energy, refurbished devices, and e-mobility

Ready to build C#/.NET systems — with AI as part of your craft — that create real-world financial inclusion? Apply Now!

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

jobs.excerpt: Duties & Responsibilities • Design and implement back-end services using .
jobs.description:
Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design and implement back-end services using .NET / ASP.NET Core (Web API) with clean, testable code.
  • Build responsive, maintainable Angular front-ends (routing, state, RxJS, forms, performance).
  • Model data and write efficient SQL Server queries, views, stored procedures, and indexes.
  • Apply secure-by-default practices: authentication/authorization, input validation, OWASP, and secrets.
  • Design modular architectures (DDD-inspired layering); document decisions (ADR).
  • Integrate with internal/external systems via REST/JSON (and SOAP when required).
  • Own code reviews, CI/CD quality gates, and observability (logging, tracing, dashboards, alerts).
  • Collaborate with PMs, designers, QA, and DevOps; break down epics into deliverable increments.
  • Troubleshoot production issues (query tuning, memory/CPU profiling, dependency bottlenecks).
  • Mentor engineers, contribute to shared libraries, templates, and engineering playbooks.


Qualifications, Skills & Abilities

  • 7+ years of professional software development, including 4+ years with ASP.NET Core.
  • Proficiency in C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, dependency injection, middleware, and configuration.
  • Strong Angular (v13+) experience: components, modules, RxJS, state management, lazy loading.
  • Solid SQL Server skills: schema design, query tuning, indexing strategies, transactions.
  • Practical experience with Git, code reviews, branching, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps).
  • Strong understanding of REST, HTTP, caching, pagination, and API versioning.
  • Testing mindset: unit/integration tests (xUnit/NUnit), front-end tests (Jasmine/Karma/Jest).
  • Ability to decompose problems, estimate, and deliver iteratively.

Nice to have (Big Plus)

  • ABP Framework (modular monolith, permission/feature management, multi-tenancy, auditing, background jobs, localization).
  • Message brokers (RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus), Redis for caching, Hangfire/Quartz for jobs.
  • Security: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, IdentityServer/Entra ID, role/claim-based authorization.
  • Cloud (Azure preferred): App Service, Key Vault, Storage, SQL Managed Instance, App Insights.
  • Front-end tooling: Nx, ESLint, Prettier; performance profiling and Core Web Vitals awareness.
  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, log aggregation (ELK/Seq).
  • Experience in regulated or enterprise environments (auditing, compliance, SDLC controls).


    (The ability to quickly join is a big plus)

Our client is a leading global payments platform that connects businesses and consumers across 260 payment types in over 40 countries. With over 20 years of experience and an annual transaction volume exceeding $150 billion, it is a powerhouse in digital wallets, eCash solutions, and merchant acquiring.

In 2026, our client is undergoing a massive AI transformation. You will be joining the Intelligent Automation & AI Engineering initiative with the goal of replacing manual decision-making workflows with reliable, auditable AI-assisted systems.

You will work in an automation COE, collaborating with a centralised AI Platform team, IT, Dev Ops etc.

  • Ability to independently drive technical initiatives from discovery through implementation and deployment
  • Strong English communication skills, comfortable working directly with business stakeholders and explaining technical decisions
  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and Microsoft Graph API
  • Familiarity with Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar agent orchestration frameworks
  • Experience designing reusable AI agent skills, custom instructions, MCP servers, and agentic SDLC workflows

  • Knowledge of LLM evaluation, prompt optimization, tracing, monitoring, and cost management
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as financial services, with security, compliance, and governance constraints
  • Experience mentoring engineers, creating reusable engineering standards, and enabling teams to adopt new technologies
  • Experience exploring emerging AI technologies, running technical experiments, and turning successful prototypes into reusable solutions

jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

About us:

Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Data Science team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

  • Growth Marketing

  • Product Development

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

  • No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.

  • First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"

  • Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

What You'll Bring

  • 1+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.

  • Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

  • Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

  • Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.
